༄khya/ /yul dus las 'das pa'i sun ci'i dmag gi bstan bcos/bkra gis dbang phyug gis bskyur/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chaga'agyur gyi sngon 'gro/ (1)rtsis thing brtag pa rnam par bshad pa/ (1)g.yul la 'jug tshul rnam pa bshad pa/ (25)thabs kyis rgol ba rnam par ba da pa/ (41)gzugs rnam par bshad pa/ (3 9)skabs bab kyi stobs rnam par bshad pa/ (70)dngos dang zol gyi rnam par bshad pa/ (84)rtsod cing len pa rnam par bshad pa/ (101)thabs 'phrul rnam par bshad pa/ (118)dpung 'jug pa dang bcas pa rnam par bshad pa/ (133)sa bab rnam par bshad pa/ (148)sa dgu rnam par bshad pa/ (166)me yis rgol ba rnam par bshad pa/ (186)myul ma gtong thabs rnam par bshad pa/ (198)sun tsi'i dmag gi bstanab bcos dang po ho'i yi mtha' thag mi chod pa'i 'thab 'khrug (217)sun tsi'i lo rgyus dang mdzad rjes/ (234)ming tshig zhan sbyar zur bkod/ (2rdo5)

dkar chaga'agyur gyi sngon 'gro/ (1)rtsis thing brtag pa rnam par bshad pa/ (1)g.yul la 'jug tshul rnam pa bshad pa/ (25)thabs kyis rgol ba rnam par ba da pa/ (41)gzugs rnam par bshad pa/ (3 9)skabs bab kyi stobs rnam par bshad pa/ (70)dngos dang zol gyi rnam par bshad pa/ (84)rtsod cing len pa rnam par bshad pa/ (101)thabs 'phrul rnam par bshad pa/ (118)dpung 'jug pa dang bcas pa rnam par bshad pa/ (133)sa bab rnam par bshad pa/ (148)sa dgu rnam par bshad pa/ (166)me yis rgol ba rnam par bshad pa/ (186)myul ma gtong thabs rnam par bshad pa/ (198)sun tsi'i dmag gi bstanab bcos dang po ho'i yi mtha' thag mi chod pa'i 'thab 'khrug (217)sun tsi'i lo rgyus dang mdzad rjes/ (234)ming tshig zhan sbyar zur bkod/ (2rdo5)

'gyur gyi sngon 'gro/bod rig pa'i yig sgru ra bya gzhag gi 'phel rim nas bltas na sngar sam skyi ta'i skad nas nang chos kyi rig gzhung bsgyur ba'i dus skal yongs su mjug 'gril nas da bar dus rabs phyed ka lhag 'das zin zhing /bsgyur 'bras kyang ha cang ngo mtshar che ba dang / da ni rgya skad nas 'jig rten gyi nyer mkho'i rig gnas ci rigs bsgyur ba'i dus su slebs pa 'di'ang dgos gal che la/ phyis da dung rang pha mes kyi skad yig 'di sbyar dar yong thabs thog dbyin skad sogs skad rigs gzhan nas tshan rig bsgyur ba'i dus skabs shig 'char du yod par yang cis nasakyang re brtson gang yod bya dgos pa 'di ni kha ba ri pa'i skyes gnas dar gsum gyi rtsa ba'i khe phan yin pa gang zhig 'phel rim gyi sarga ma 'chol ba'i chos nyid cig kyang yin dgos nges lags/ /de ltar mi rigs sam rgyal khab gzhan gyi rig gzhung legs gras rang rigs kyi yi ger phabs tsa na rang rigs kyi rig gzhung la gyur ba ma zad/ rang rigs rig gzhung gi 'phel stabs 'dzam gling sbyi bgrod dang mthun pa bya rgyur dge phan bsams las 'das pa dang / rang sger gyi ngos nas bshad na yang a na u 'tshugs kyis bcom bya thabs chag cig gsar du bcoms pa las/ gzhan gyi gzhung yag gras rang yig la gang legs bsgyur na de ni mi rigs la phan shas che la rang gi ngal 'dis

kyi rim thang yang de bzhin che bar sems/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir phran gyis lo bzhi lhag tsam gyi 'ar zhor dus tshod nang sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa mi 'dra ba deb bcu grangs la lta sdur zhib dpyad byas rjes/ yul dus las rnam par 'das pa'i sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos zhes pa 'di rtsom skur zhus pa yin/ /sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos 'dir khyon rnam bshad bcu gsum yod cing / 'di ni rgya'i khrun chi'u dus rabs te spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo lnga brgya'i gong na dngos ming du sun wu'u dang rgyun ming du sun tsi zhes bya bas bcoms pa dang / da bar lo ngo nyis stong lnga brgya lhag tsam 'das zin mod/ 'on kyang bstan bcos 'dir bstan pa'i thabs 'phrul dang / sgrub byed mang po zhig da deng yang spyod go che chod kyi yul dus gang rung las rnam par 'das pa'i g.yul 'thab kyi gzhung phul rtser song ba zhig yin par ma zad/ rjod byed tshig sbyor thad nas bshad na'ang brjod pa thin tu bde ba'i tshigs su bcad nas go bde la ngag la 'dzin bde ba'i legs bshad cig yin pa dang / legs par bshad pa'i don gyi sgrub byed ni gtan tshig rig pa dang rang byung chos nyid kyi thog nas bstan yod pas nyo tshong dang lus rtsal sogs 'gran rtsod dang ldan pa'i khyab khongs ci rigs thad lung dang tshad mar 'dzin du rung ba dang / tha na go dbang 'dzin skyong dang / 'brel ba bya thabs/bdag skyong bya thabs sogs la yang phan thogs shin tu che/ /2 lhag par du mig lnga'i dus ni rgyal spyi nas bshad na brda 'phrin gyi

dus rabs dang / 'gran rtsod kyi dus rabs thig yin pa dang / rgyalanang nas bshad na 'char gzhi'i dpal 'byor nas khrom ra'i dpal 'byor la brje 'gyur byed bzhin pa'i dus mtshams shig yin pa 'dis 'gran rtsod kyi rang ba'in sngar bas je cher 'gro ba dang / tshul mthun gyi 'gran rtsod dam/ yang na don gang sgrub kyang gtso cher thabs dang blo rig dang / 'jon thang la brten dgos pas ji ltar bya ba'i dka' rkyen mang po 'phrad srid pa de'i tshe na/ sun tsi'i drungs nas thabs kyi dngos grub zhus na/ gzhan ldan rnam par gcod pa'i blo gros 'phel ba dang /ma mthar yang bsam pa'i sgo 'phar phye ba sogs phan pa bla lhag tu che/ /de lta bu'i nyer spyod kyi don snying ldan pa 'i sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos 'di rang gangs can yu la du dar khyab byung tshul da bar mthong thos ma byung zhing / ljar pan la spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa tsam nas dar zin pa de'ang phyi rgyal la dar snga thos yin skad dang / spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i rjes su rim gyis de lnga'i su'u len dang /dbyin ji/ h+pha ran si/ 'jar man/ a me ri kha sogs yo rob dang a me ri kha gling gi rgyal khab mang por dar khyab chen po byung thog de thad kyi zhib 'jug tshogs pa mang po btsugs nas dmag don dang / phyi 'brel/ tshong las sogs khyab khongs su bed spyod byas mthar mos ngos mtshar ba'i phan 'bras gzangs su smin pa la bsngags brjod kyi bstod dbyangs mgrin gcig tu phul bar byed/ /dper na tshong las thad/ ljar pan san cing tshong tshogs spras

sun tsi'i dmag gi bstag bcos nang gi/ rang gzhan gnyis ka dpogs pa na/ /zhes pa'i thabs jus la gzhigs te ming grags che ba'i san cing 'dzam gling brda 'phrin ma lag ces pa btsugs nas 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab dang sa khul brgyad cu gya bdun bar glog 'phrin brgyud tshong don cha 'phrin 'phral rtogs thub pa byas rjes khe spogs ha cang chen po byung ba dang /gzhan yang a ri'i spru the rlangs 'khor kung si'i ma rkang 'go 'dzin ( phra)gyis sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos nang gi/ de phyir rang dmag gdams mkhas la/ /bab dang bstun te bkol bar bya zhes pa'i thabs jus gzhir bzung ste spyi gnyer rnying pa snying rje med par gnas dbyungs nas spyi gnyer gsar pa bsko gzhag byas rjes/ ma rtsa //sdu nyer thug pa'i kung si de dus thung nang skyar dar byung bar dmag don gyi ngos nas bshad na/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi dmag don rig pa smra ba rnams kyis dmag gi bstan bcos 'dir de bas — gdengs 'jog chen po gnang 'dug pa dper na/ 'dzam gling gi dmag chen dang po slong mkhan/ 'jar man gyi rgyal thog gnyis pa/we'u lan gnas dbyungs btang rjes/ phyi rgyal du spos sdod byed bas sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos sgyur ma zhig lag tu 'byor/ /khong gis sun tsi'i me rgol rnam bshad kyi dum mtshams mjug ma ste/rje bo khro bas dpung ma 'dren/ /dpung 'go sdang bas 'thab mi bgyi/ /khe do/ mchis na 'dren pa dang / /ma mchis rang sor 'jog par byed/ /khro

ba spro bar 'gyur srid la/ /sdang ba dga' bar 'gyur yang srid/ /'thor ba'i khab ni slar mi grubs/ /'chi ba 'das log 'byung mi srid/ /de phyir rje bo blo ldan gyis/ /cis nas de la nan gyis gzigs/ /dpung gi sne mo 'dzin pa yis/ /nges par de la gzab zon gyis/ /de ni rgyal khams bde ba'am/ /dpung tshogs srung ba'i thabs kyi mchog /ces pa 'di bklag rjes zhal nas dbang med du ngas lo nyi shu'i gong na sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos 'di bltas yod na/ rang gi rgyal khab brlags pa'i sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba myong dgos don mi 'dug ces gsungs yod/'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i rjes su/ dbyin ji'i skad grags ldan pa'i 'thab jus mkhas pa ca le ter ha thes sbyar du bsgyur ba'i sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos kyi gling gzhi'i nang / mi rigs phan tshun sdug tsub kyis gsod res dang / mi gshes dmigs med du gtong ba'i rdul phran mtshon cha bzos rjes/ de bas kyang sun tsi'i /sdu/ / bstan bcos 'di sbyar du bsgyur rgyu'i dgos gal che zhes —'e rdo/ ba/zhin a ri'i rtsom pa po mkhas can kun mu si la wer gyis spyi lo 1989lor 'tshogs pa'i skabs dang po'i sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos skor gyi rgyal spyi'i rig gzhung gros bsdur tshogs 'du'i thogagal srid nga tsho nye rabs kyi dmag srid zhi drag dpon rigs rnams kyis mos ngos mtshar ba'i sun tsi'i bstan bcos 'dir 'ib 'jug byas yo da tshe/ 'dzam gling gi dmag chen dang po dang gnyis pa mi 'byung ba sdun

tan bzo chog cing / ma mthar yang 'dzam gling gi dmag chen gnyis po de sdug tsub chen po de 'dra rang yong mi srid pa dang / gzhon nu khri tsho brgya phrag dmag 'khrug gi rkyen lam du shor mi srid pa kha tshon bcad nas bshad chog ces gsungs yod 'dug/spyi lo 1989lo'i mtsho khug dmag 'khrug mjug 'gril rjes/ a ri'i gsar 'god pa zhig gis spyir mtsho khug dmag 'khrug nang krung go srid gzhung nas dpung mi gcig kyang btang med na yang / rdzu 'phrul gyi ngo mtshar dang ldan pa'i krung go'i mi gcig gis mtsho khug gi sayul ngo mdun mar phyin te dmag 'thab la bkod 'doms byed bzhin 'dug pa /shā /sa ༵ sdo nyis stong lnga brgya'i gong gi sun tsi zhes pa de yin zhes su mtsho khug dmag 'khrug ni rang tsho'i dus rabs su byung zhing /rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul la thugs 'dogs cung zad gnang mkhan yin phyin mtsho khug dmag 'khrug gi thog ma'i 'byung rkyen dang / bar du ji ltar 'khrug pa/ mtha' mjug gang 'dra 'gril tshul la cha rgyus gang tsam yod nges khar/ sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos la blta sdur zhib dpyad byas na gong gsal gsar 'god pa de'i bka' sol mi bden pa med cing / a ris gtsos pa'i rgyal mang dpung sde dang / dbyi rag 'thab ya phyogs gnyis ka nas sun tsi'i thabs dang jus mi nyung ba jig bed spyod byas yod pa rtogs thub/ dper na rgyal mang dpung sdes thog mar ska/ mtsho mkha' gsum gyi 'bum sde'i dpung tshogs drangs thog drag

tan bzo chog cing / ma mthar yang 'dzam gling gi dmag chen gnyis po de sdug tsub chen po de 'dra rang yong mi srid pa dang / gzhon nu khri tsho brgya phrag dmag 'khrug gi rkyen lam du shor mi srid pa kha tshon bcad nas bshad chog ces gsungs yod 'dug/spyi lo 1989lo'i mtsho khug dmag 'khrug mjug 'gril rjes/ a ri'i gsar 'god pa zhig gis spyir mtsho khug dmag 'khrug nang krung go srid gzhung nas dpung mi gcig kyang btang med na yang / rdzu 'phrul gyi ngo mtshar dang ldan pa'i krung go'i mi gcig gis mtsho khug gi sayul ngo mdun mar phyin te dmag 'thab la bkod 'doms byed bzhin 'dug pa /shā /sa ༵ sdo nyis stong lnga brgya'i gong gi sun tsi zhes pa de yin zhes su mtsho khug dmag 'khrug ni rang tsho'i dus rabs su byung zhing /rgyal spyi'i gnas tshul la thugs 'dogs cung zad gnang mkhan yin phyin mtsho khug dmag 'khrug gi thog ma'i 'byung rkyen dang / bar du ji ltar 'khrug pa/ mtha' mjug gang 'dra 'gril tshul la cha rgyus gang tsam yod nges khar/ sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos la blta sdur zhib dpyad byas na gong gsal gsar 'god pa de'i bka' sol mi bden pa med cing / a ris gtsos pa'i rgyal mang dpung sde dang / dbyi rag 'thab ya phyogs gnyis ka nas sun tsi'i thabs dang jus mi nyung ba jig bed spyod byas yod pa rtogs thub/ dper na rgyal mang dpung sdes thog mar ska/ mtsho mkha' gsum gyi 'bum sde'i dpung tshogs drangs thog drag

shusas kho nar brten nas dbyi ras pham kha shor ba bzo rtsis byas kyang dbyi ras nas sun tsi'i dmas gi bstan bcos nang / sa yul gyi thabs 'phrul sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can zhes bstan spo ltar rdo snum gyi me chen spar te de gar rang dmag si dpung dang go mtshon bcas pa yo da khul dang /'thab 'khor dang mtho 'phen me rgyo sas rdzusam bsgrisas te/ der phar rtsol gyi gnam grus 'bar mdel dbyugs pa dang / me phyogs 'phen du bcus pa sogs pha rol rbad de 'khrul bar byas/ don dngos thog dbyi rag gi dpung dmag ni sun tses/ gang 'ag srung bar mkhas pa na/ /'os sa'i klu yi yul du yib/ /ces sasungs pa ltar sa 'og dang dong ka sogs su yib ste mi mngon par byed pa'i byi ba lta bu'i 'thab jus bzung nas yod pa dang / ga'an yang rgyal mang dpung sdes mkha' thog nas 'bar mdol dbyugs skabs/ dbyi rag gis sun tsi'i dmas gi bstan bcos nang / 'thab ya'i stobs la gdod ma'i zon gra bsgrigs/mi bzod rgol ba'i shugs la g.yol bar byas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar snga sa nas zon gra bsgrigs pa'i phar rgol gnam gru brgya phrag yod rung /de das gis rgyal mang dpung sdes glasas mi rnyed pa shes te rang gi phar rgol gnam gru de dag tshang ma dbyi rang du bros su btang ba'am g.yol nas ba'ag pas/ de'i mtshams su dbyi rag gi dpung mang sge tshe sros dang go mtshon thad gyong tshabs che ba sang yang phogs med la/ yongs su pham kha 'khur dgos pa de bas kyang byung med/ 'on kyang tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar/ gal te rgyal mang dpung sdes grong khyer gyi khang ltam

gtor brlags dang nyes med kyi grong mi thi rmas kyi rjes 'bras tshab zhin tu che ba bzo nges par ma bltos par drag shugs yod tshad kyi thog nas 'thab ra spras na/ rgyal mang dpung sder de ma nyid du rgyal kha thob srid kyang / de ltar byas na rang gzhan gnyis ku'i gyong tshabs che ba dang /lhag par du mi chos las 'gal bas kun gyis dma' 'bebs pa dang kha rdung gtong ba'i gnas su gyar ba smos mi dgos/ des na rgyal mang dpung sdes sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos nang / lan brgya 'thab pa lan brgyar rgyal na yang / /mchog pa'i mchog tu dge ba ma yin te/ /ma 'thab thabs kyis rgyal ba kun tu dge/ /zhes bstan pa ltar/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs dpung gnyen du brten nas/ chab srid dang phyi 'brel thad kher 'jog byed pa dang / dpal 'byor thad bkag 'doms byed pa/ phyogs mtshungs drag shugs thad rgol rdung gtong ba sogs bya thabs ci rigs thog nas mtha' ma'i rgyal kha blangs pa red/zhib phra'i 'thab jus de dag kyang sun tses thabs kyis rgyal bar byed pa'i rnam bshad du bstan pa'i/ 'thab ya thabs kyis brtul ba dang po ste/ /'brel bas bkugs te brtul ba gnyis pa'o/ /drag po'i dpung gis brtul ba gsum pa ste/ /dpung tshogs grong du rgol ba tha ma'o/ /zhes pa// ༵ ṭ+wā / ༵ / kā smra/ med pa dang phyin ci ma log pa'i ngang bod spyod mdor na/ sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos nang thabs 'phrul sna /gas pa mang du bstan pa 'di dag rang gzhan gyi mthu stobs dang

dge mtshan che chung dang / dus tshod dang khor yug bzang ngan gyi khyad par la nan gyis gzhigs te 'os shing mtshams pa'i ngang bed spyod bya dgos phyir/ thog mar 'dir bstan pa'i thabs 'phrul phra rags tshang ma phyin ci ma log pa'i ngang go rtogs thub pa bya rgyu gal shin tu che/ gal te thabs 'phrul 'di dag khong du chud cing lag tu len mkhan zhig yin phyin/ dper na nyer mkho'i thad nas cha mtshon na 'thab ya dang 'phrad tshe/ snga na thob dang rjes su 'thab pa'i shes rab bam yang na/ thob zin 'thab pa'i shes rab ste/ sngon la phyogs gang nas bltas kyang rang nyid pha rol las rgyal kha tan tan thob nges pa'i mthun rkyen tha dag tshang ba byas thog de rjes gzhi nas dngos su 'thab lag sbyor ba las mun thom gyis 'thab par mi bya ba'i shes rab 'phel ba dang / de bzhin du bya ba gang byed kyang grubs zin sgrub pa'i shes rab 'phel ba sogs dge mtshan mang po 'dug kyang zhib cing phra ba 'dir zhus 'khom ma mchis pas klog pa po gang nyid nas gzigs dpyad yod pa mkhyen/ /dmag gi bstan bcos 'di bod yig tu phab sgyur bya thabs nas brjod na/ de yang rtsa ba'i tshig la gsal 'grel yod pa'i rnam pa can yin zhing / ma gzhi bod yig gi rtsa tshig phal mo che ni go sla yang / tshig bcad kyi don khag cig 'dzam gling gi gna' deng lo rgyus thog byung ba'i dmag 'khrug dang don rkyen che rigs dpe ru drangs nas gsal 'grel zhus yod/ gsal 'grel gyi dpe mang che ba deb rigs sna tshogs nas legs btus dang khag cig rang nyid nas thad kur sbyar ba 'di /ga

nang / rgyal rabs gsum ska bas kyi dmag 'khrug nas thang rgyal rabs skabs rgya bod ma tha' mtshams su byung ba'i dmag bi 'khrug rtsod dang /'dzam gling dmag chen dang po dang gnyis pa/ mtsho khus dmas 'khrugade ba'in da dung mtha' thas ma chod pa'i po nye'i 'thab 'khrug dang 'i 'jags byung ma thas pa'i u ru su'u dang khra khyen bar gyi 'gal rtsod sogs mdor stabs su bkod yod/ dpe mtshon de dag gis sun tsi'i bstan bcos sngar bas go rtogs zhib gsal thub sla ba'i khar/ 'dzam gling gi 'khrug rtsod dang don rkyen che gras 'ga' zhig cha rgyus gang tsam yong ba bya rgyur yang phan pa cung zad yod par sems/ /tshig gibasgyur stangs thad/ ma yig gi don dang mi 'gal ba gtso gzhir bzung thog sgyur thabs sna tshogs la brten nas go bde la klog bde ba dang ngag la bzung bde ba'i rang chos mngon gang thub byas yod rung / ma yig gi tshig 'ga' shas go ba len stangs la rgya rigs mkhas dbang mang po'i bar la yang mi 'dra ba'i ho bag che tsam 'dus pa de rigs ni mkhas dbang mang che bas go ba ji ltar len pa de ltar bod yig tu phabs sgyur zhus yod snyams kyang / rang nyid ci thad kyi byang tshad dman pas gang dang gang la nor 'dzol dbasgyur rtsal mi 'dang ba'i cha mchis srid na/ mkhyen ldan rnams kyis gzigs pa zab pos skyon se la dag bcos gnang ba'i thugs 'dosas 'tshal/— ) rtsom sgyur pa bkra shes dbang phyug gis/10 spyi lo 1997lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 29nyin pe cin du/

rtsis shing brtag pa rnam par bshadapa/dmag ces khab kyi don mo che/ /'chi gson zung gi gnad nyid dang / /chags dang 'jig pa'i chos nyid can/ /brtag par ma bgyis thabs su med/ /ces tshig sgros kyi don ni/ rgyal khab cig gi ngos nas bshad na/dmag ces bya ba 'di rgyal don thams cad nang nas gal 'gangs che thos su gyur ba'i don gnad la 'jog dgos/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na 'chi gson gnyis kyi gnas te/ rgyal khab 'di ga'i 'bangs mi ser rnams rgyal khab ga'an gyi drag shugs 'og 'chi rgyu yin pa'am/ yang na zhi zhing bde ba'i ngang 'tsho sdod bya rgyu yin pa gnyis gang la nges pa'i mtha' gnyis thag gcod byed du 'gyur ba ma zad/ rgyal khab 'di khrims sgo rang btsan thog ji srid bar nyams med du gnas thub pa'am/ yang na gzhan dbang du yongs su rgud de thor zhig tu 'gro rgyu yin pa gnyis gang la nges pa'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa zhig kyang yin na/ dmag don dis

sanas su 'dzin pa rnams kyis zhib tu brtag cing dpyad pa ra ma byed thabs med yin zhes bstan/ 'dir bstan pa'i dmag ni thab kyi don mo che/ 'chi gson zung gi gnad nyid dang ces pa'i rgya yig gi tshig don 'grel tshul la khyad par che tsam 'dus ste/ mkhas dbang kha cis gis 'dir dmag ces pa dmag dpung dang dmag 'khrug rang du go ba dang / 'chi gson zung gi gnadanyid ces pa'i gnad la rgya'i skad dod du gnas (7)kyi don yang yod na/ de ni spyir rgol srung dang 'jug shol byed mi bde ba'i sa char 'chi ba'i gnas dang rgol srung dang 'jug bshol byed bde ba'i sa char gson pa'i gnas zhes bya mod/ 'dir dmag dpung dang dmag 'khrug ni mnga' 'bangs 'chi gson la thug // // //nā /sdo chen zhig yin tshul bstan pa tsam las gzhan gyi go kru'u cun gyis mdzad pa'i sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos kyi don 'grel zhes pa'i nang / dang thog dmag (2)ces pa'i rgya'i skad dod 'dir dmag mi dang / dmag chas/ dmag dpung / dmag 'khrug sogs go don mang po yod pa dang / de bzhin 'chi gson zung gi gnad nyid ces pa ni/ sa cha'i gnas la go dgos pa dang de yang rtsi zhing tsam yang mi skye ba'i sa char mi dang bya ri dwags sogs 'tsho dka' bas 'chi ba'i gnas dang / de las ldog ste rtsi shing mang zhing thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa'i sa char mi dang bya ri dwags sogs 'tsho sdod byeswā thub pas de la gson pa'i gnas zhes bya/ 'on kyang mi'i rigs kyi

tshan rig lag rtsal gong 'phel phyin pa yis de snga mi rnams kyis 'chi ba'i gnas la ngos bzung ba'i sa cha dag / da cha gson pa'i gnas la gyur pa yang yo da de dper na gsar spel byas dang byed bzhin pa'i bar snang phyi ma (1ba'i tsho〉/ci/ /)dang / lho sne gling / 'khyags rum rgya mtsho byang ma lta bu red/ der brten don dam du rgyal khab kyi rang byung thon khungs gsar spel dang ben spyo da bya rgyur lus pa'i sa cha la 'chi ba'i gnas dang /byas zin pa'i sa cha la gson pa'i gnas zhes bshad kyang chog /dpal 'byor ni dmas 'khrug gi rmang gzhi yin gshis/ des na sun tsis 'dir dpung sdes dus rgyun du rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor gsar spel dang 'dzug skyong la mthong chen dang rogs skyor bya dgos tshul bstan yod ces gsungs/ gang ltar na yang chis bcad hril por go ba len na dmag 'khrug gi ngo bo'am dmag dpung 'dzugs skyong bya rgyu ni rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor chab srid dang 'brel ba zab mo ldan pa gsal por bstan yod/'dzam gling gi lo rgyus la rjes dran byas tshe/ rgyal khab gang 'dra 'ig yin rung dpung dmag 'dzugs skyong la brtsi mthong ma byed mkhan gcig kyang med/ dper na a ri'i lo rgyus thog rang btsan gyi don du dbyin 'bog dmag 'khrug byed skabs dmag dpung la brten pa dang / a ris kho re ya byang ma dang / wa de nam/ pha na ma bcas la btsan 'dzul dang / ri pi ri yar 'jab rgol/ mtsho khug dmag 'khrug bcas tshang mar dpung dmag bkol spyod byas yod/ de'i thog nas rgyal spyi'i thog 'gal zla dang 'khrug rkyen ci rigs yongs khyab tu sa/sa

tshan rig lag rtsal gong 'phel phyin pa yis de snga mi rnams kyis 'chi ba'i gnas la ngos bzung ba'i sa cha dag / da cha gson pa'i gnas la gyur pa yang yo da de dper na gsar spel byas dang byed bzhin pa'i bar snang phyi ma (1ba'i tsho〉/ci/ /)dang / lho sne gling / 'khyags rum rgya mtsho byang ma lta bu red/ der brten don dam du rgyal khab kyi rang byung thon khungs gsar spel dang ben spyo da bya rgyur lus pa'i sa cha la 'chi ba'i gnas dang /byas zin pa'i sa cha la gson pa'i gnas zhes bshad kyang chog /dpal 'byor ni dmas 'khrug gi rmang gzhi yin gshis/ des na sun tsis 'dir dpung sdes dus rgyun du rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor gsar spel dang 'dzug skyong la mthong chen dang rogs skyor bya dgos tshul bstan yod ces gsungs/ gang ltar na yang chis bcad hril por go ba len na dmag 'khrug gi ngo bo'am dmag dpung 'dzugs skyong bya rgyu ni rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor chab srid dang 'brel ba zab mo ldan pa gsal por bstan yod/'dzam gling gi lo rgyus la rjes dran byas tshe/ rgyal khab gang 'dra 'ig yin rung dpung dmag 'dzugs skyong la brtsi mthong ma byed mkhan gcig kyang med/ dper na a ri'i lo rgyus thog rang btsan gyi don du dbyin 'bog dmag 'khrug byed skabs dmag dpung la brten pa dang / a ris kho re ya byang ma dang / wa de nam/ pha na ma bcas la btsan 'dzul dang / ri pi ri yar 'jab rgol/ mtsho khug dmag 'khrug bcas tshang mar dpung dmag bkol spyod byas yod/ de'i thog nas rgyal spyi'i thog 'gal zla dang 'khrug rkyen ci rigs yongs khyab tu sa/sa

pa'i dus rabs su/ rgyal khab gang 'dra zhig yin rung tshang mas rang gi rgyal srung 'dzugs skyong bya rgyu de bya ba gal chen zhig la 'dzin pa mtshon thub/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang dper na/ gna' rabs su khren sang gi rgyud pa (rma cha )zhes pa'i rgyal po zhig yod pa des/ 'i spyod kho na gtso don du bzung ba las/ drag po'i tshul spyod yongs su spangs pa dang / byang sems dang zhi bde kho na don du gnyer ba las/ 'thab 'khrug la thugs 'dogs mi bya bas dpung dmag 'dzugs skyong la snang chung shor te/ mthar rang gi rgyal khab rtsa brlags su song ba lta bu red/der brten mar khe sis 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang sgor 'dzin gyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni/ 'byor med gral rim gyi dpung sde yin zhes gsungs yod pa dang / ma'o tse tung gis srid dbang ni me mda'i kha nas byung zhes gsungs yod pas/ de'i thog nas g.yul zhes lab kyi spyan mo ༵ zhes pa'i sgrub byed la yo ngas khyab kyi don snying ldan pa mtshon cad pa / / don lnga gzhi ru bzung ba dang / /bzang ba'i cha la bsdur ba yis/ /g.yul gyi spyi khog dpogs par bya/ /don lnga'i don yang blo dang dus/ / sa dang 'go dpon khrims su nges/ /blo ni dpon dmag bsam sems gcig /4 'chi gson mnyam du skyong ba dang / /

nyen du dolas pa'i 'jigs pa med/ /dus ni sprin dang sprin bral dang / /tsha grang dus ba'i'i 'gyur ba'o/ /sa / nye 'gyangs g.yardo gzar dang / / /bye sdu zlo/ r+shasna zlo ga~X/ la/ bya/ /'bo dpon zhes pa blo gros mchog / yid rton rung zhing skyong sems can/ /brtul phod che la nan pa'o/ /khrims ni dpung gi sazhi srol dang / / brka' gtan 'dzin spyod sogs pa'o/ /don lnga rna bar ma thos rung / rgyus yod can ni rgyal ba dang / /— rgyus chad dag ni pham pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ blo dang / dus/ sa/ 'go dpon/khrims bcas don gnad lnga gzhi rtsar bzung thog dpung shed che chung la solas pa'i mthun rkyen rnams phan tshun bsdur te/ dmag 'khrug gi mtha' ma'i rgyal pham rtogs par bya dgos thing / dmag dpon zhig gi ngos nas bshad na/ don gnad lnga po de dag gal po cher 'dzin dgos tshul gzhan gyis bshad pa ma thos rung / rang gis nyams len dngos kyi nang cha rgyus yongs su lon na/ mtha' ma'i rgyal kha thob nges pa spyang /

cha rgyus ma lon na pham par 'gyur nges zhes bstan yod/ 'dir blo ni blo sems mthun par go dgos thing / de'ang dpon dmag gong 'og bar 'chi gson mnyam skyong gi blo sems gcig tu mthun par go dgos tshul dngos su bstan pa'i khar/ dmag dmangs bar dang /dmangs dang dmangs kyi bar la'ang blo sems mthun pa bya rgyu shin tu nas gal chen po yin pa shugs su go / dper na sbyi lo 1895lor ching rgyal rabs srid gzhung gis tha'e wan lngar pan la sprad rjes/ tha'e wan mi dmangs kyis bsam 'dun gcig tu sgril nas thang cing sung zhes bya bar dmangs gtso'i srid gzhung 'dzugs su bcugs te/ ljar pan 'gos thabs byas pa dang / thang cing sung tha'i wan nas kha bral rjes su'ang tha'e wan mi dmangs kyis bstud mar lo lnga'i ring / dpa' ngar chen ༵༵ / / /sna / /thab rtsod byas pa lta bu ni/ dmangs kyi blo sems ga 'dir bstan pa'i dus ni sprin dang sprin bral dang zhes pa'i dus ni/spyir btang gi dus tshod tsam ma zad nyin srib dang tsha grang / dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba sogs gnam gzhis la yang go dgos kyi yod/ spyi na 'jig rten gyi dngos po gang 'dra zhig yin rung / de'i skye gnas 'jig gsum ni/ yul dus gnyis dang kha bral du med na/ dmag 'dzugs dang / dmag grabs/ dpung 'jug byed pa sogs kyang yul dus dang kha bral du med/ /dper na dbyar ka lta bur cha mtshon na/ he lung cardo zhing chen dang ha'e nan zhing chen gnyis kyi gnam gshis drod grang

dang nyin mtshan ring thung ha cang mi 'dra zhing / mtsho dmag dang mkha' dmag ni gnam gar+shas kyi bab dang bstun rgyu gal shin tu che bas/ de bas kyang yul dus kyi gnam gshis khyad par rtogs pa bya dgos/dper na spyi lo 1982lo'i zla ba 4par dbyin ji dang a ken thing bar mar wu'i na si'i gling tshom gyi don du dmag 'khrug byung skabs/ dbyin ji'i mtsho dmag gi dmag gru ru khag dbyin ji nas rdog thon gyis g.yul sar dpung 'dren pa dang / lam bar du dus bzhi'i gnam gshis brgyud yo da pa red/ gal te lam thag ring ba dang nam dus mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos la snang chung byas na skabs bab kyi dgos mkho bskong mi thub/ dper na dmag gru bzo rgyur cha mtshon na/ grang ngar che sa'i rgyal khab kyis grang 'khyag 'gog chas la do snang byed dgos pa dang /tsha drod che sa'i rgyal khab kyis tsha ba 'bog chas dang / rlung 'gro sa/drod tshad snyom sgrig 'phrul chas bcas kyi thad do snang byed dgos par ma zad/ gnam gshis mi 'dra bar gzhigs te/ mtshon cha dang /ṭī kā zlo/ /dgohā/ kā/// / 'bar rdzas/ ( khusko/ )sman rdzas sogs mi 'dra don lnga'i ya rgyal sa zhes pa ris bab sna tshogs shes par bya dgos pa go sla zhing / 'go dpon ni dmag dpon la bya ba dang / de'i cha rkyen yang blo dang ldan pa/ yid rton rung ba/ byams kyis skyong ba/brtul phod che ba/ nan pa bcas lnga las/ blo dang ldan pa ni/dmag 'khrug gi gnas tshul skad cig nyid du 'gyur sla zhing / galha te

bkod 'doms pa ra skyen po'i blo dang thabs kyi nus rtsal med na/dpung gi 'gan 'khur mi thub pas/ nges par du lhan skyes kyi blo rig dang thabs shes ldan pa'i khar dmag don rig par sbyong zhib dang sama' deng gi dmag 'khrug lo rgyus la zhib 'jus byas mthar/ bsod 'doms kyi blo gros dang thabs shes gang legs ldan pa bya dkos pa de yin/ byams kyis skyong ba ni/ bong rim la brtsi 'jog dang / 'osagi dpung dmangs byams kyis skyong ba/ de'ang rgyal kha thob pa'i 'gan len zhig yin pa red/ brtul phod che ba ni/ me mdel gyi char 'bab kyang mi 'jigs par dmag 'thab byed phod pa tsam ma zad/ dmag 'khrug gi rnam pa dza thin tu drag pa dang / yo lang ji ltar che na'ang rang sems rnal du 'phabs thub pa/ rgol ba'am srung ba'i gnas skabs su blo thag chod pos bkod 'doms byed nus pa bcas so/ nan pa ni/zab cing nan la phral thag chod po dang / dpung mang la re ba nan po bcol ba/ sbyong brdar nan po byed pa/ sgrig khrims dang bstod chad nan zhing gsal ba bcas la go ba'o/ khrims zhes pa ni tshad ga'ir bya zhing / 'dir dpung sde'i sgrig gzhi dang / bka' tan 'bebs/do dam bsol spyod kyi srol lugs sogs tshud yod/ /de phyir kun nas bsdur byas te/ /g.yul gyi sbyi khog dpogs pa'ang / /gang rje blo dang ldan pa dang / / 8 gang 'argo mthu dang nus pa che/ /

gang la sanam sa bzang ba'am /gang la bka' khrims 'khyol pa legs/ /gang gi dpung mtshon stobs su rdzogs/ /gang gi dpung mang byang chod mtho/ /gang la bstod chad nan pa sogs/ /zhib tu dpyad cing brtags par bya/ /bdag kyang de ltar dpyod pa las/ /g.yul gyi rgyal pham rtogs pa yin/ /zhes rgyal khab gang rung gi dpung sde'i 'dzugs skyong ni/ gong gsal gyi don lnga dang kha 'bral thabs med cing / des na dmag 'khrug gi snga na'am yang na nam rgyun du nas gang ci'i thad phas rgol dang dpyad bsdur gyis rang gzhan gnyis kyi dpung stobs drag 'an gyi spyi khog dpogs par bya dgos pa de'ang / gcig ni/ rgyal khab gang zhig gi rgyal po'am/ deng nas bshad na tsung thung dang kru'u 'i sogs kyis rang gi rgyal khab skyong mkhas min dang srid dbang 'dzin pa'i nus pa ldan min/de yi srid jus dmangs sems la 'bab min bcas la blta dgos pa/gnyis ni/ gang gi dmag dpon chab srid kyi byang tshan dang / dmag don gyi shes tshad/ sbyong brdar chu tshad/ dmag 'thab gyi nyams myong /bkod 'doms byed nus ldan min sogs la blta dgos pa/ gsum ni/gang la gnam sa bzang ba ste/ phyogs gang zhig la gnam gshis dang /sa bab kyi mthun rkyen bzang bo yo da med la blta dgos zhes bstan/ 9

gang la sanam sa bzang ba'am /gang la bka' khrims 'khyol pa legs/ /gang gi dpung mtshon stobs su rdzogs/ /gang gi dpung mang byang chod mtho/ /gang la bstod chad nan pa sogs/ /zhib tu dpyad cing brtags par bya/ /bdag kyang de ltar dpyod pa las/ /g.yul gyi rgyal pham rtogs pa yin/ /zhes rgyal khab gang rung gi dpung sde'i 'dzugs skyong ni/ gong gsal gyi don lnga dang kha 'bral thabs med cing / des na dmag 'khrug gi snga na'am yang na nam rgyun du nas gang ci'i thad phas rgol dang dpyad bsdur gyis rang gzhan gnyis kyi dpung stobs drag 'an gyi spyi khog dpogs par bya dgos pa de'ang / gcig ni/ rgyal khab gang zhig gi rgyal po'am/ deng nas bshad na tsung thung dang kru'u 'i sogs kyis rang gi rgyal khab skyong mkhas min dang srid dbang 'dzin pa'i nus pa ldan min/de yi srid jus dmangs sems la 'bab min bcas la blta dgos pa/gnyis ni/ gang gi dmag dpon chab srid kyi byang tshan dang / dmag don gyi shes tshad/ sbyong brdar chu tshad/ dmag 'thab gyi nyams myong /bkod 'doms byed nus ldan min sogs la blta dgos pa/ gsum ni/gang la gnam sa bzang ba ste/ phyogs gang zhig la gnam gshis dang /sa bab kyi mthun rkyen bzang bo yo da med la blta dgos zhes bstan/ 9

gnam gshis bstun spyod bya rgyu gal che zhing / de'i dpe mtshon zhig zhus na/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i nang / no man ter (༷ 49/ )dpung 'jug byed skabs/ rgyal mang dpung sde'i bkod 'doms lang dang / 'jar man dpung sde'i bkod 'doms khang gnyis skru'i sanam sathis blta dpyad mkhas pas spyi zla 6tshes 4nyin gyi snga nub tu dpung 'jug bya rgyur mtshams pa'i gnam gathis yag po khyug tsam zhig bstan nges yin pa shes rtogs byung yod cing / 'jar man dmag gi bkod 'doms pas gnam gshes yag po khyug tsam zhig las bstan bzo med na/ de lta bu'i dus yun thung ngu'i nang pha rol nas dpung 'jug byed mi thub snyams te nyen zon med par bag yangs su bsdad/rgyal mang dpung sde'i bkod 'doms pa a'i sen ha'o wer gyis dus yu na thung ngu'i gnam gshis yag po'i go skabs de dam por bzung ste/legs grubs ldan pa'i ngang dpung tshogs drangs nas 'thab lag sprad pa red/ gzhan yang sa bab bzung spyod thad/ dper na krung go'i bzo zhing dmar ngamag thog mar 'dzugs skabs/ ri khul du gsar brje'i rten gzhi btsugs pa dang / bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug skabs li'u teng dpung chen gyis ta pe hran ri bor dpung 'jug byas nas go min tang dmag dpung gis bcings 'grol sa khul bskor bcom byed pa rtsa brlags btang / sa de'i thog nas ta pe hran ri bo'i 'thab jus kyi gnas bab gal chen po yin pa mtshon thub pa lta bu'o/ bzhi ni phyogs gardo ḍi dpung sdes bka' dang khrims srol sna tshogs la brtsi srung gis don

dngos su lag len bstar tshul yag po yod med la blta dgos/ gang lags she na/ dpung sde'i bya spyod la go rim dang sgrig khrims med na/dmag 'thab kyi stobs shugs med/ lnga ni/ gang gi dpung mtshon stobs su rdzogs zhes phyogs gang zhig gi dpung mang ba dang go mtshon gyi grangs tshad dang spus tshad mang zhing shugs che ba yod med la blta dgos pa bstan yod/ dper na deng skabs 'dzam gling thog rgyal khab khag cig gi dmag grabs 'gran sdur nang / gtso bo me shugs 'phur mda' dang / gnam gru/ 'thab 'khor/ chu 'og dmag gru sogs kyi grangs tshad dang spus chad thad 'gran sdur byed kyi yod/ der brten a ri'i tshan rig mkhas pas da lta sa chod mdel mgo dang chu 'og rdul nying dmag gru 'gog byed kyi chu gting 'bar mdel gsar pa zhig zhib bzo byed bzhin yod cing / a ri'i 'gran rtsod bya yul yang sngar bzhin mu ru su yin pa red/ lhag par du mtsho khug dmag 'khrug mjug 'gril rjes/ mtho gsar tshan rtsal gyi glog rdul lag rtsal gong mthor gtong rgyu de dmag shugs che ru gtong rgyu'i gtso gnad zhig tu gyur yod/ drug ni/phyogs gang gi bkod 'thab pa'i byang tshad mtho ba yod med la blta dgos thing / deng nas bshad na de'i nang chab srid kyi go rtogs dang /spyod tshul/ dmag don bsam blo/ 'thab jus dang 'thab rtsal/dmag don lag rtsal sogs tshud yod/ bdun ni/ dpung sde ni dras chas kyi sgrig gzhi zhig yin gshis/ bsam blo gcig 'gyur dang bya spyod gcig 'gyur yong ched nges par du byas rjes can la bsngags brjod 1sdong /

dngos su lag len bstar tshul yag po yod med la blta dgos/ gang lags she na/ dpung sde'i bya spyod la go rim dang sgrig khrims med na/dmag 'thab kyi stobs shugs med/ lnga ni/ gang gi dpung mtshon stobs su rdzogs zhes phyogs gang zhig gi dpung mang ba dang go mtshon gyi grangs tshad dang spus tshad mang zhing shugs che ba yod med la blta dgos pa bstan yod/ dper na deng skabs 'dzam gling thog rgyal khab khag cig gi dmag grabs 'gran sdur nang / gtso bo me shugs 'phur mda' dang / gnam gru/ 'thab 'khor/ chu 'og dmag gru sogs kyi grangs tshad dang spus chad thad 'gran sdur byed kyi yod/ der brten a ri'i tshan rig mkhas pas da lta sa chod mdel mgo dang chu 'og rdul nying dmag gru 'gog byed kyi chu gting 'bar mdel gsar pa zhig zhib bzo byed bzhin yod cing / a ri'i 'gran rtsod bya yul yang sngar bzhin mu ru su yin pa red/ lhag par du mtsho khug dmag 'khrug mjug 'gril rjes/ mtho gsar tshan rtsal gyi glog rdul lag rtsal gong mthor gtong rgyu de dmag shugs che ru gtong rgyu'i gtso gnad zhig tu gyur yod/ drug ni/phyogs gang gi bkod 'thab pa'i byang tshad mtho ba yod med la blta dgos thing / deng nas bshad na de'i nang chab srid kyi go rtogs dang /spyod tshul/ dmag don bsam blo/ 'thab jus dang 'thab rtsal/dmag don lag rtsal sogs tshud yod/ bdun ni/ dpung sde ni dras chas kyi sgrig gzhi zhig yin gshis/ bsam blo gcig 'gyur dang bya spyod gcig 'gyur yong ched nges par du byas rjes can la bsngags brjod 1sdong /

byas nyes can la chad pa gcod dgos tshul bstan yod/ der brten sun tsis ngas kyang song gsal gyi phyogs du ma'i thad nas dbye zhib dang spyirno ༵ kā/ trī paX //na/ dmag 'khrug gi mtha' ma'i rgyal pham rtogs pa phran gros gsan zhing dbang bkur na/ /rgyal bar nges pas gnas zhing bca'/ /༵༵ /pa sdi pa~X tādītā bkur yang / /zhes 'dir bstan don gtso bo ni/ dpon dmag gong 'og bar phan tshun yid ches dang blo dkar bya dgos pa 'di yin gshis/ de'ang rgyal rje mchog nas nga yi lhag bsam dag pa'i jus gros 'dir yid ches kyis yongs su gsan pa tsam ma zad/ phran dpung gi sne mor mngags pa na da thengs kyi g.yul 'di rgyal bar nges shing / phran khyed kyi sku 'khor du mu mthun dmag zhabs zhus nas sdod rgyu dang / gal te khyed nas phran gyi 'thab jus la gsan 'jog ma gnang bar phran dpung gi sne mor bkod kyang rgyal kha mi thob pas phran khyed kyi sku 'khor du dmag 'bas zhus nas mi sdod do chesgos bstan/ /tā dī ṭ+wāṃ lda /shā /shā ṭā ༵༵ / ṭā /nga/ // /khyed la phyi stobs skyong rogs zhus/ /12 dpung gi stobs zhes bya ba'ang / /

skabs bstun rgol ba nyid du nges/ /zhes pa'ang rgyal rje mchog nas phran gyi 'thab jus 'dis thugs phan bzod do snyam ste gsan zhing dang du blangs na/ phran gyis rang dpung stobs su rdzogs par byas thog nang gros byas pa'i 'thab jus rnams/ phyi nas mngon du 'gyur ba byed pa'i dpung gnyen zhig byed chos dpung gi stobs zhes pa'ang skabs dang bstun pa'i /phar shol bya rgyur thug pa'o zhes bstan/ skabs bstun rgol ba zhes pa'i don ni/dper na spyi lo 1944lor a ri'i dmag dngo na e sen ha'o wer gyis rgyal mang dpung sde drangs te no mān tir dpung 'jug byed skabs/rang gzhan phyogs gnyis kyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul la dpyad sdur byas pa'i khar/ da dung 'thab sar slebs rjes rgyal mang dpung sde'i dpung snon gtong ba'i myur tshad de/ lngar man gyi dpung snon myur tshad gyi sngon du 'byor thub min mi shes pas/ thog mar lngar man gyi dpung snon 'gro lam gtor rgyu sogagakyi 'thab jus bzung ba lta bu'o/ /g.yul gyi thabs 'phrul sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can/ /nus la mi nus bkol la mi bkol dang / /nye la ring dang ring la nye ba'am/ /brngan pas bslu zhing za zi'i 'phrod du brtul/ /'thab ya'i stobs la gdod ma'i zon gra sgrigs/ /mi bzod rgol ba'i shugs la g.yol bar bya/ /khro ba'i la na rkyen gyis mnar bar bya/ / 1 3

bskyungs ba'i tshe na thabs kyis rloms par bya/ /bde bar 'dug pa ngal ba'i gnas su 'jog /'cham zhing sgril ba dgyen dang phra mas phyes/ /pha rol dogs zon bral tshe rgol ba dang / /snang med nyid du brtul zhing brlags par bya/ /'di rnams thabs mkhas can gyi thabs dam pa/ /gsang ba yin pas sgrog bar mi bya'o/ /zhes gang bstan par bya ba'i tshig gi sbyi sgros tsam ni rtogs par sla yang / dpe don dang bcas te mdo tsam zhus na/ dang po/ g.yul gyi thabs 'phrul sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can/ zhes pa ni/ dpung tshogs g.yul du 'dren pa'i thabs 'phrul gyi chos nyid ni/ pha rol mgo bo 'khor ba dang 'phrul bar byed pa'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa zhig yin zhes te/ dper na spyi lo 1942lo'o zla ba 12par/ lngar pan mtsho dmag dmag gru ru khag gis a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho chen po'i dmag spu ru khag gi rten gzhi mu tig spu kha zhes par 'jab rgol byed skabs/ mgo skor gtong ba'i bya spyod rdzun ma mang po bzung ba de'ang skud med tar 'phrin rdzun ma bsgrigs pa dang / pho nya shi tshun a rir dbye 'byed gros mol byed par mngags pa/ 'grul bzhud gru gzings chen mo lung than wan zer ba sngar rgyun bzhin mtsho thog tu bton nas a rir skyod de rang mi'i spun zla phyir len khul byed pa/ mtsho dmag slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma 30/0lhag gis dmag gru'i dpung mang gi gyon chas spras te spyi zla 12tshes

5 —— 6nyin bar tho khe'u grong khul la lta skor du phyin nas ljar pan gyi dmag gru sngar bzhin spu kha de rang la bsdad yod khul byed pa bcas kyi thog nas a ri'i gsang myul la mgo bskor btang ba lta bu dang /gnyis pa/ nus la mi nus bkol la mi bkol dang / zhes pa ni dper na spyi lo'i sngon gyi 270lor chin rgyal khab (rngo rji)kyi dpung dmag bis kra'o rgyal khab (sa/za)kyi yan ( 〉 deng gi hran shi'i yi he hrun rdzong )zhes pa'i yul spu'i mtha' bskor cing / kra'o rgyal khab nas dmag dpon kra'o hre dpung dang bcas pa phar rgol byed par btang / kra'o hres dpung tshogs drangs te rgyal sa han tan (go stso)nas rdog thon byas rjes spyi le bco lnga'i sar slebs skabs/ dpung 'jug byed mtshams bzhags te/ nyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad ring sa cha de rang la bca' srung byas nas bsdad/ chin rgyal khab nas kra'o rgyal khab kyi dmag dpung gi gnas tshul rtog zhib byed mkhan pho nya gcig btang ba der/ dmag dpon kra'o hres nas sne len gang legs zhus rjes phyir log btang ba red/chin gyi pho nyas phyir log rjes/ kra'o yi dmag dpung ni rang dmag la 'jigs nas bsdad yod pa dang / dmag rgyab 'dod med pa'i skor snyan gseng zhus pas/ chin dmag grabs thon med par bag yangs su bsdad/ don dam du dmag dpon kra'o hres chin gyi pho nya phyir slog ma thag gsang ba zab mos chin gyi pho nya'i rjes ded dpung tshogs drangs /shā/ rdong ba dang / mthar chin dmag snang med nyid du cham la /༷sa

'gog srung byed par phyin/ skabs der then khran gyis phas rgol bsru ba'i bya thabs mang po spel yod pa dper na/ gang sar 'bru gtor te bya tshogs 'du ba dang / des rgyag bye 'dang nges shig yod khul byas pa dang / bslu thabs la brten nas rgan gon dang bud med bcas la grong khyer srung bar btang ste/ rang dpung gi stobs shugs phas rgol las zhan pa'i tshul bstan pa/ gzhan yang yan dmag gi sgar gnas su 'thus tshab btang nas mgo btags pa dang / mi ser gyi lag nas dngul 'bor chen bsdus thog / de rnams khyim tshang phyug gras brgyud yan dmag gi dpon rigs la 'bul du bcugs pa dang sbrags chi'i dmag grong khyer nang dpung 'jug byed skabs/ khong tsho'i khyim mi la sogs pa bde srung chag yang ba'i re zhu byed du bcugs pa sogs kyi bslu thabs spel bar/ yan gyi dmagadapon rnams shin tu dga' nas zon grabs byed rgyu lhod g.yengs su btang / then khran gyis skabs de dang bstun te phar rgol byas pas/ yan dmag pham nyes chen po bzos pa dang / grong khyer bdun cu don gnyis phyir blangs te chi'i rgyal lab kyi dbang sgyur slar gso byas pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa/ 'thab ya'i stobs la gdod ma'i zon gra bsgrigs zhes pa ni/ pha rol dpung shugs che bas/ rang phyogs la tshur rgol byed srid cing / nges par du thog ma nas rang gi dpung stobs je cher btang ste/'gog rgol gyi gra sgrig tshags su tshud pa bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ sun tsi'i lta tshul 'di bzhin yang dag pa 'ig yin pa'i dngos ra 'phrod1 byed/

ldog phyogs kyi dpe mtshon zhig gzhag chog pa de'ang / spyi lo 1939lo zla ba 9par 'jar man h+pha shi si'i dmag dpung gis zla ba gcig gi nang pho lan gyi mnga' khongs yongs rdzogs btsan 'dzin byas/ dmag 'khrug 'go ma 'tshugs gong / pho lan srid gzhung gis 'jar dmas rang gi sa mtshams su bkrams zin pa dang / rkyen zhig 'phud ma thag dmag 'khrug langs nges yin pa shes na'ang / khong tshos dmag 'thab kyi gra sgrig ma byas pa ma zad/ da dung rta dmag btang ste 'jar man gyi rgyal sa per lin (lkolko)gang ltar len rgyu'i skor la gros sdur byas nas bsdad mthar/ 'gog rgol byed ma thub pa red/ der brten pha rol gyi stobs shugs 'gog pa'i sngon grabs ma byas pa de ni/ pho lan pham nyes su phyin pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig yin pa red/ 'jar man gyi ngos nas bshad na/ tshigabs kyis grabs med brtul ba dang / dziskabs su rgol ba'i mi 'thab jus kyi nus 'bras shig yin pa smos ci dgos/lhag par du rdul nying me shugs 'phur mdel gyi dus rabs 'dir/dmag 'khrug gi stes dbang rang bzhin dang / myur ba'i rang bzhin gtor skyon gtong ba'i rang bzhin bcas ni/ rgyun srol mtshon cha'i dus rabs kyi dmag 'khrug las ches cher brgal bas/ rang gi rgyal khab la don dngos su 'jigs skul bzo ba'i stobs ldan gyi dgra bo dag la dogs zon lhod g.yeng gtan nas mi byed par rang shugs je cher btang ste/rang stobs pha rol las che ba'i thog nas ya lan sprod rtsis byed dgos so/18/

drug pa/ mi bzod rgol ba'i shugs la g.yol bar bya/ zhes pa ni 'thab lag dngos su sbyor skabs pha rol gyi stobs shugs rang sde las che zhing / phas kyis rgol ba la mi do tshe/ mtha' thag gcod pa'i dmas 'thab mi byed par/ cis kyang re zhig g.yol thabs bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ de ni dmag 'thab dngos su byed pa'i gnas skabs la bshad pa yin gyi/ dmag 'thab ma byas gong gi 'thab jus thog nas bshad pa ma yin no/ spyir btang gi 'thab jus thog nas bshad na/dgra stobs chen pos rang la tshur rgol byas na de las g.yol thabs mi bya bar stobs chung gis stobs chen rgol ba'i 'thab jus la brten nas 'thab ra sprod dgos/ dmag 'khrug nang stobs shugs drag 'an ni ltos bcas su gnas pa yin gshis/ drag zhan gnyis bar phan tshun 'pho 'gyur 'byung nges dang 'pho 'gyur gtong thub nges yin pa'i chos nyid de gsal por shes rgyu gal che/ ma'o tse tung gis lngar 'gog dmag 'khrug skabs rgyun bsrings dmag 'khrug gi rnam bshad ces pa'i nang /stobs chung stobs chen las ji ltar rgyal bar bya rgyu'i thad rgyas bshad gnad la 'thags pa byas yod/ gzhan yang dper na gang zhig rgol bar mi bde na/ rgol bar bde ba'i dgra 'ig 'tshol/ dus 'dir rgol bar mi bde na/ rgol bar bde ba'i dus shig 'tshol/ zhes pa //sdu /dī trī / bzod rgol ba'i shugs la g.yo la bar bya zhes pa'i thabs bdun pa/ khro ba'i kha na rkyen gyis mnar bar byed/ ces ༵ ni

dgra sde'i dmag dpon ngang rgyud mi ring na khro ba langs sla bas/ khong khro bslang na bzod dka' ba'i 'khrug rkyen 'byin/ de ltar byas na khong khro dang bcas te rang dgar dmag bshams pa dang / dmag bshams na 'thab jus thad nor 'dzol 'byung ba de'i tshe na pha rol gyi skyon dang bstun nas rgyal kha len thub pa'o zhes bstan/ /brgyad pa/ bskyungs pa'i tshe na thabs kyis rloms par bya/zhes pa ni dper na/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi 206lor li'u pang gis shang yus kyi sngon la chin yul (lko )du dpung drangs te rang nyid chin yul gyi rgyal po bya dgos snyam/ h+phan tseng zhes bya bas shang yu sa la li'u pang gi dpung 'jug la nges par du phar rgol bya dgos tshul gyi bslab bya byas kyang / shang yus kyi khengs skyungs do nan gyi ngang tshul bzung nas phar rgol ma byas/ skabs der shang yus la dpung mi khri tsho bzhi bcu yod pa dang / li'u pang la dpung mi khri tsho bcu las med/ li'u pang gis 'ang yus kyi do zla mi chod pa shes rjes/ shang po (shang yus yi spun zhig )zhes pa ra dngus 'bul gya nom pa skyon te 'brel ba btsugs mthar/shang yus la han krung (/kro lo)yul gru rang gis bzung chog pa'i skyabs 'jug zhus/ shang yus kyis de ltar khas blangs par ma zad/ li'u pang la han krung rgyal po zhes gsol/ tan krung rgyal pos (li'u pang )dpung tshogs 'khrid de han krung du go dbang 'dzin par phyin/ lam bar du li'u pang gis 'brel gzam bshigs te/ shang yus la hān krung rgya~X 0po'i go dbang phyir sprod mi bya ba dang / khrims sgo rang btsan yin

pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas phyin/ 'di ni li'u pang gis shang yus pa/dri kā pa/ /sdo ༵ trī /mas par byed du bcug ste mthar han krung dgu pa/ bde bar 'dug pa ngal ba'i gnas su 'jog / ces pa'i don ni skabs babs kyi bya thabs gang rung la brten nas pha rol la snon shugs sprad de pha rol bas phebs su 'dug pa'i tshul de gnas bzod mi bde ba'am dka' ngal gyi rkyen dang ldan pa bzo dgos zhes bya ba'i don te/ dper na ma'o tse tung gi 〈yig 'bru bcu drug gi gdams ngag 〉ces pa'i nang / pha rol bde bar 'dug pa dag rang sdes zing zhing 'khrugs par byed/ /phas rgol 'jug cing 'ongs ba na/ /rang tram̐ /ba gyu dī /kā lhar byed/ /ces pa lta bu ni pha rol ngal bar byed pa'i bcu pa/ 'cham zhing sgril ba dbyen dang phra mas phyes/ /zhes pa ni/ pha rol gyi dpung sde'i dpon dmag gong 'og shin tu mthun zhing /gong bu sgril shugs chen po ldan pa na/ rang sdes dbyen sbyor dang phra mas dkrigs zhing byed pa sogs pa'i thabs gang rung la brten nas/pha rol dmag sde'i nang khungs phan tshun mi 'cham par kha 'bral bar bya dgos tshul bstan pa/ de'ang dper na spyi lo'i sngon gyi 204lor li'u pang gis khre phing gi thabs jus ltar/ myul ma ldog thabs (2/ga)bkol spyod kyis shang lus dang de'i byas rjes che ba'i dmag dpon krung li'i me/ lhag bsam che ba'i gzu blon h+phan tseng bcas kyi bar /spyan

sbyor phra ma bcugs te phan tshun nang 'gal bzos te/ mthar pham nyes su btang ba lta bu dang / gzhan yang dper na/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs/ lngar man h+pha shi si'i spyi khyab bkod 'doms pus myul ma ldog thabs bkol spyod bya thabs la brten nas/ su'u len gyi k+to khyab bkod 'doms pu'u dī rgyal srung pu'u krang thu ha che spru si ci nor bsangapa ṭ+wāṃ shā // /ta/nga dī sdi ṭī bye/na/ gra bral tshe rgol ba dang / /snang med nyid du brtul zhing 'thul bar byed/ /ces pa'ang dper na spyi lo'i sngon gyi 204lor/ tan rgyal khab kyi dmag dpon hān shin gyis kra'o rgyal khab (7༅)la dpung 'jug byas te rgya rnyir 'dren pa'i dmag 'thab byed skabs/ mtshan mo rta dmag nyis stong gsang stabs kyis kra'o rgyal khab kyi sgar gnas nye 'khor du bcar ba dang dpung mi khag cig ri steng du yib nas bsdad/ han shin rang nyid kyis dmag shugs che ba de 'khrid nas kra'o rgyal khab kyi dpung dmag dang 'thab lag gang tsam sprad rjes/ 'jigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi bshol byas/ kra'o dmag (7 lha)gis sgar gnas stongs par bzhags te rjes 'ded gtong skabs/ ri steng la yib nas bsdad pa'i han dmag ( /ṭ+wā stso )gis skabs de dang bstun nas kra'o dmag gi sgar sa bzung ba ma zad/ kra'o dmag gi dmag dar phabs te/ han dmag gi dmag dar dmar po yar bsgrengs/ kra'o dmag rjes 'ded btang ma thub par phyir log yong ma~X/ sgar gnas kyi gang sar tan dmag gi dmag dar lhab lhub tu

g.yo ba rgyang nas mthong rjes/ kra'o yi rgyal po dang dmag dpon rnams 'jigs shing skrags pa dang dpung mang zang zing du gyur mthar/ kra'o rgyal khab rtsa brlags su phyin pa lta bu'o/ /bcu gnyis pa/ 'di yang 'thab mkhas can gyi thabs dam pa/ /snga nas gsang zhing sgrog pa mi rigs so/ /zhes pa ni g.yu la gyi thabs 'phrul ni sgyu ma'i rang bzhin zhig yin pa dang / sgyu ma'i rang bzhin ni yang gsang rgya bsdams dgos pa zhig yin pas phyi nang gang rung la gtan nas thod mi rung ba'i don yin pa'o/ /mchod khang du ni ma 'thab gong / /brtsis thing brtags te rgyal snyam pa/ /de yi dge rkyen mang ba'i phyir/ /ma 'thab snga na mchod khang du/ /brtsis shing brtags te pham dogs pa/ /de yi dge rkyen nyung ba'i phyir/ /de phyir gang la dge ba'i rkyen/ /༵༵ s+t+ri shā/ /hā shātā snyi sdum/ /phran ni de ltar zhib dpyad de/ /g.yul gyi rgyal pham dpogs par byed/ /zhes 'dir bstan pa'i mes mchod khang zhes pa ni gong ma'i mes po'i mchod khang la go dgos shing / rgya'i gna' rabs gong ma'i 2ltad

gzhung gis rgyal khab kyi don gnad che rigs gros thag gcod skabs/zhi drag dpon rigs rnams mchod khang du 'dus nas mol gros dang gros mtha' thag gcod kyi yod/ dmag don ni de bas kyang don gnad gal chen zhig yin gathis/ g.yul ma bshams gong rje blon rnams 'dir 'dzoms nas dpyad sdur dang gros gling byed kyi yod/ /gros sdur byas rjes tshang mas da thengs kyi dmag 'di rgyal bar nges so snyams pa ni rang sde'i rgo mtshon dang dpung stobs/ sa bab sogs phyogs ci thad kyi mthun rkyen pha rol las lhag pa yod pa bcas la brten pa yin/ dpyad gros byas rjes da thengs kyi dmag 'di pham bzo che'o snyams pa'i dosas gzhi byung ba ni rang sde'i mthun rkyen pha rol las zhan pa yod pa des yin/des na mthun rkyen mang na rgyal ba dang / mthun rkyen nyung na pham par nges shing / mthun rkyen gtan nas med na ji ltar rgyal te rgyal mi srid/phran gyis kyang mthun rkyen la dpyad zhib gang zab kyis mtha' ma'i rgyal pham dpogs pa ra byed pa yin zhes bstan/ /24

g.yul la 'jug chul rnam par bshadapa/spyi na dpung tshogs 'dren pa'i srol/ /shing 'khor lci yang stong phrag dang / /dpung mang 'bum tsho gcig drangs shing / /le dbar stong du 'bru gzan 'dren/ /phyi nang gron dang mgron gyi gron/ /go mtshon tshon rtsi lhu lag dang / /shing rta 'khor lo'i byugs snum sogs/ /nyin re'i zad gron shin tu che/ /sta gon khrigs se grubs pa na/ /'bum sde'i dpung tshogs 'dren par bya/ /zhes dpung tshogs 'dren skabs/ shing rta 'khor lo dang dpung dmag gi zad gron sogs gtong sgo'i 'bor tshad gsal por bstan pa dang sgrags/ dgos nges kyi gra sgrigs de dag yongs su grub rjes/gzhi nas 'bum sde'i dpung chen 'dren dgos zhes bstan/ / 25

'dir tshig don mdor stabs su 'grel na/ dang po shing 'khor lci yang gnyis nas shing 'khor yang ba ni rta bzhis 'dren pa'i dmag mi 'dren pa'i shing rta 'khor lo zhig yin pa dang / der shing 'khor chung ba yang zer/ thing 'khor lci ba ni glang gis 'dren pa'i shing 'khor zhig yin zhing / de'i nang dmag spyod dngos rdzas blugs thog der ba /sdo gi lpags pas sgrib g.yog btums te ru dpung gi rjes su 'bring bar gnyis pa/ phyi nang gron dang mgron gyi gron zhes pa ni/ dpung sde'i phyi nang gi nyin re'i 'gro gron dang / pho nya 'gro 'ong byed pa'i 'gro gron/ myul zhib byed mkhan gyi 'gro gron sogs dmag mi dngos min mi snar gtong dgos pa'i 'gro gron la go dgos pa'o/ /gsum pa/ go mtshon tshon rtsi lhu lag dang / /shing rta 'khor lo'i byugs snam sogs/ /zhes pa ni/ go khrab/ rmog zhwa/ mda' gzhu/mdung / phub sogs bdag gces dang nyams bzo bya rgyur mkho ba'i sgru cha dang / lhu las byug tshon sogs sngon grabs yag po bya dgos kyi yod pa der go ba'o/ deng skabs dmag 'khrug gi dngos rdzas gra sgrig bya rgyu nas bshad na/ de bas kyang nam rgyun nas zhib bzo dang gra sgrig gang legs ma byas na gyong gun chen po 'phog srid pa smod mi dgos/a ri'i 'thab jus 'gog srung gros gzhi (nub phyogs kyis skar ma'i go la'i dmag chen 'char gzhi zer )zhes pa dang / h+pha ran si'i ya'u li kha~X /char gzhi zhes pa/ de snga'i su'u len gyi skar ma'i go la'i dmag

// bye rdzu ༵ //sdu /dro ṭ+wāṃ /byung 'gyur dmag 'khrug la gra sgrigabyed pa'i bzhi pa/ nyin re'i 'gro gron shin tu che zhes pas gna' rabs dpung tshogs 'dren skabs/ nyin re'i zad gron shin tuche ba gsal por bstan zhing / deng rabs dmag 'khrug gi ngos nas bshad na/'gro gron de bas che ba yo da pa dper na/ spyi lo 1982lor dbyin ji dang a ken thing bar dmag 'khrug nyin 75thug ring / rgyal khab phan tshun gnyis kur gyong gun a sgor dung phyur brgya bcu re 'phogs pa phud/dbyin jis dmag gron a sgor dung phyur 27btang bas/ nyin rer a sgor bye ba gsum dang sa ya drug phyin yod pa dang / a ken thing gi nyin de'i 'gro gron a sgor bye ba gcig dang sa ya bzhi phyin yo da pa red/ lo de rang la dbyi si ral gyis li pa non la btsan 'dzul byas te/ dmag 'khrug nyin bcur thug cing cha snyoms nyin rer dmag gron a sgor dung phyur gcig phyin yod pa red/ a ri'i dpal 'byor rig pa mkhas can la'i ce zhi wa tes brtsams pa 'i deb chung zhig gi nang tshod dpags byas par gzhigs na/ da cha 'dzam gling yongs kyi dus yu na skar cha re'i nang gtong ba'i dmag gron a sgor sa ya gcig yan zin gyi yod pa red ces bkod yod/ spyi lo 1985lo zla ba 6 tshes 20nyin a ri'i rgyal tshogs smad pas ('tshi cho)gros 'chams byas pa'i dmag jus 'gog srung gros gzhi zhes pa'i nang lo gcig gi dmag gron a sgor dung phyur nyi shu rtsa lnga zin yod/ gong gsal gyi grangs tshad de kho na'i thog nas/ kā/ga

grabs dang dmag 'thab dngos su byed skabs/ 'gro gron ha cang mang po gtong dgos par ma zad/ dngos rdzas dang rgyu cha sna tshogs 'bor chen zhig kyang gtong dgos pa gsal por mngon yod/ spyi lo 1990lo'i zla ba 8tshes 2nyin dbyi rag gis kho we the btsan bzung byas pa'i lo de'i spyi zla 10par/ a ri'i dpung tshogs so te a rab la phra ma btabs te/ dbyi rag la phar rgol byas pa'i dmag spyod de la/ bye thang gi phub ces gsol ba dang / a ri'i 'brel yod sde khag nas sngon dpags byas par gzhigs na/ skabs der nyin re'i dmag gron a sgor bye ba gcig nas bye ba gcig dang sa ya lnga gtong dgos kyi yod pa ma zad/ gal te dmag 'khrug 'go tshugs na/ nyin re'i 'gro gron a sgor dung phyur bcu gtong dgos kyi yod pa red/ a ri'i dpung tshogs so te a rab la bca' sdod byed skabs/ rgyal khab khag cig gis 'gro gron thad rogs skyor byas pa de'ang so ti a rab dang a lan chi'u tsho dpon rgyal khab nas a sgor dung phyur 70 dang / kho we the'i yul rgyar srid gzhung nas a sgor dung phyur 50 lngar pan gyis a sgor dung phyur 40 'jar man gyis a sgor dung phyur 20 yo rob dpal 'byor thun mong ma lag gis a sgor dung phyur 20 kho ri ya lho mas a sgor dung phyur 2dang bye ba 2 dbyi ṭa lis a sgor dung phyur 1 dang bye ba byas ya 7 bcas btang ba'i thog nas bltas na/ a ri rgyu stobs chen po de lta bus kyang /'bor shin tu che ba'i dmag gron rnams rang gcig pus 'don mi thub pa mardo/ pa dang phyogs mtshungs /rgyal khab stobs dang ldan na yang / /

dmag yun ring na rgyad par 'gyur/ /’ zhes pa 'dir/ rgyal khab sang 'dra zhigaci yin rung tshang mas do snang gang legs dang / don gnad de thag gcod yang dag pa bya dgos pasatshon yod/ /de 'dra'i g.yul ni myur ba mchog /yun du bsrings pa sa dpung mtshon rgud/ /mkhar rdzong rgol bas dpung shed nyams/ /dpung tshogs 'dren yun ring gyur na/ /khab kyi spyod bya mi 'dang zhing / /go mtshon dpung bi rno shed nyams/ /dpung dang nor gyi zungs zad na/ /rgyal phran gzhan gyis skabs su rgol/ /de'i tshe blo dang ldan pas kyang / /pham pa dge bar gso mi nus/ /'jug thabs gzhan ci ma mchis par /myur gyis rgyal ba thos gyur yang / /'jug thabs ci rigs mchis na yang / /bsnur cing bsrings pa mthong ma gyur/ /'thab yun ring du bsrings pa yis/ /khab la phan pa'i dpe ma mchis/ /zhes dpung tshogs 'dren skabs dpung mi dang rgyu nor gyi gtong sgo shin tu che ba gong du zhus pa de rang yin gathis/ de lta bu'i /sdug

'khrug la gal te myur du rgyal ba'i mthun rkyen ldan tshe cis nas kyang myur du rgyal bar byed pa mchog yin te/ dpung stobs nyams pa dang / go mtshon rnams btsa' ba la sogs pas rno mnyen rgud pa/ gzhan yang pha rol gyi grong khyer la dpung 'jug byas na/ rang dmag la yang gyong gun 'byung nas dpung stobs nyams pa/ de bzhin rgyal khab gzhanadu rang gi dmag dpung bca' sdod byed yun ring drag na/ rgyal nang gi rgyu dngos mi 'dang ba dang / go mtshon dang dpung stobs nyams pas mi tshad/ dpung gi spyod rdzas kyang yongs su zad cing / pha rol gyis dka' rkyen che ba'i skabs de dang bstun nas tshur rgol byed/ de'i tshe na rang dmag la pham nyes chen po 'byung nges zhing / pham pa'i tshul de blo gros dang rnam dpyod khyad par du ldan pa'i dmag dpon gang 'dra zhig gis kyang / sngon ma ltar du slar gso byed thub thabs bral/ gzhan du na dpung 'jug bya ba'i thabs gzhan dag gang yang med par/ glun rtags dang bcas te myur du rgyal bar byed mkhan 'ga' yod kyang /dpung 'jug bya thabs gzhan mang po yod na yang dpung 'jug ma byas par dmag yunaring dugatong mkhan skani med do/ gang lags she na/bye/kā sdokā ༵༵ t+na sdu/kā / rgyal khab 4 khe phan la gnod pa las phan pa 'dir bstan pa'i tshig 'ga' zhig dpe don zung du 'brel nas mdo tsam zhus na/ dang po/ yun du bsrings pas dpung mtshon rgya 0/ /ces pa ni dper na a ris we the nam la dpung 'jug byed skabs/

drang bden med pa'i dmag yun ring drag nas/ mthar rang gi go mtshon mi 'dang ba dang dpung stobs nyams te we the nam gyi dmag sa nas phyir 'then ma byed thabs med byung ba lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa/ grong du rgol bas dpung shed nyams/ /zhes pa'ang dper na spyi lo 1626lor nor ha khris (zalo lko)dmag mi chig 'bum gsum khri khrid nas/ ming rgyal rabs kyi yon tsung hwan ( lko )gyis dmag mi chig khris bca' srung byas pa'i nying yon grong khyer (deng le'o nying gi zhin khren rdzong )la dpung 'jug byasashing / dpung stobs che chung gi he bag shin tu che yang / drag rgol thengs gsum byas pas pham kha nyos pa ma zad/ shi rmas kyang tshabs chen byung mthar phyir bshol ma byed thabs med byung ba dang / nor ha khri rang nyid kyang dmag 'khrug /sdo nang rmas skyon phogs te zla shas song rjes lnga ba'i lam tu byin pa lta ri gsum pa/ dpung tshogs sdod yun ring ba na/ /khab kyi spyod bya 'dang mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni dper na/ chin hri hong (spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 259—— 210)gi dmag dpon chen po mong than gyis dpung sne drangs te byang rgyud rgyal phran hor (mi rigs gzhan )brtul bar phyin pa dang /thu'u su'e (ṭha )zhes pas chu dmag 'khrid de lho rgyud kyi h+phu cwan dang kre cang khul gyi rgyal phran brtul bar phyin zhing / de ltar lo bcu grangs ring dpung 'jug byed skabs/ pho rgod po rnams dmag la song ba dang /mo rgod mo rnams dmag zog 'dren par 'gro dgos byung stabs/ 3snying

las dang 'thag las byed mkhan dbon zhing / mnga' 'bangs rnams 'cho ba'i rten gzhi med par gyur ba dang mthar/ chin hri hong shi nas lo bzhi las ma song bar rgyal khab stongs pa red/ lo rgyus rig pa mkhas can gyis de ni dmag gis bzos pa'i lan chag zhig yin par ngos 'dzin gyi yo da/ dus rabs 'di'i nang a ris kho re ya byang mar btsan 'dzul byas rjes/ slar yang wa the nam la dmag mi lnga 'bum gyi dpung chen 'dren skabs/ lo re'i 'gro gron a sgor dung phyur 300zin te/pa/ bye tram̐ bye ṭ+wāṃ /zlo chags nas dmag dpung phyir 'then mi byed thabs bzhi pa/cu dpung dang rgyu yi stobs 'dzad de/ /zhes pa'ang dmag 'dren yun ring thal na dpung stobs dang rgyal khab kyi rgyu stobs gnyis ka pos su zad pa'o zhes bstan 'ing / dper na dbyi rang dang dbyi rag bar sbyi lo 1980lo nas spyi lo 1987lo'i bar dmag 'khrug lo bdun thug pa'i nang / mi chig 'bum lhag tsam gyi srog thor ba'i khar/ rgyal khab gnyis po'i lo re'i dmag gron a sgor dung phyur bcu phyin yod pas rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhir shugs rkyen thebs pa dang tshong las thad cha 'jog dang yid ches med par gyur ba lta bu'o/ 'dir dmag 'khrug nang rgyal shugs dang mi shugs dngos shugs bcas zad gron che zhing /dmag 'khrug gi dmigs yul gtso bo ni pha rol las rgyal bar bya rgyu de yin pa las/ phan tshun rengs por gnas te yun ring gi bsdur ba byed rgyu ༵ ma yin pa bstan yod/ spyir sun tsis dmag ni myur du 'thab te

myur du rgyal ba bya rgyu de mchog tu 'dzin pa las/ dmag yun ring du bsrings mi rung ba gsal por gsungs mod/ 'on kyang dmag thams cad myur du rgyal ba dgos zhes smra ba ma yin/ gang lags she na bltos sducas kyi sdi rkyenā sna tshogs la blta dgos pas 'dir yig tshogs mang rkyen yab tu ma sa/ /la/ gyi/ nyes pa ma shes par/ /g.yul gyi phan pa rtogs mi gyur/ /dpung chen 'dren par mkhas dag gis/ /dpung mi skyar ma mi bsdu zhing / /'bru gzan lan gsum 'dren mi srid/ /go mtshon rang gi khab nas 'don/ /rgyag bye dgra yi lag nas len/ /dpung gi bza' bya de yis 'thus/ /khab gang dpung gi bya ba'i phyir/ /phongs pa'i rkyen ni ring 'dren nyid/ /'dren thag ring pas 'bangs rnams dbul/ /dpung dang nye sar zog gong che/ /zog rin che bas dmangs rgyu nyams/ /rgyu dngos dkon pas dmag khral lci/ /'bangs kyi stobs dang rgyu nor 'dzad/ /'bangs kyi khyim dud thams cad stongs/ / 33

'bangs kyi zad song bcu cha bdun/ /de'i khar gzhung gi zad gron te/ /thing 'khor grum zhing dmag rta dub/ /mda' gzhu mdung phub khal glang dang / /dod 'dren shing 'khor bcas pa yi/ /zad song sgril na bcu cha drug /dpung 'go blo dang ldan pa yis/ /'bru gzan dgra yi phyogs nas len/ /dgra yi 'bru krung gcig re la/ /rang gi 'bru krung nyi shur mtshungs/ /dgra yi gzan ta'an gcig re la/ /rang gi gzan ta'an nyi shur mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ phyogs kun nas dmag 'khrug bi nyes dmigs ma shes na/ de bzhin du dmag 'khrug gi phan yon kyang rtogs mi thub ces gong gi tshig 'phros drangs zhing / gzhan yang dpung sne 'dren par mkhas pa'i dmag dpon dag gis dmag mi skyar ma mi bsdu ba ma zad/ 'bru gzan yang thengs gsum tsam g.yul sar 'dren par mi byed/ rgyu mtshan ni mtshon cha rang gi rgyal khab nas 'don dgos pa ma gtogs 'bru rigs ni mi'i rigs kyi sbyi spyod du gyur ba yin thing / mi yod sar 'bru rigs kyang yod nges yin na/ 'bru rigs dgra yi yul na~X 4bsdu chog pa dang / des dpung mi za 'bru 'dang ba dang / rgyal

khab gang zhig dpung dmag cu don du mi ser rnams dbul phongs la gyur rdzu / lha ñcha shā /rdo ༵ // thag ring gi g.yul sar dmag zog 'dren skyel dpung btegs pa'i lam bar du 'khel ba'i sa cha ru zog gong 'phar ba dang / zog gong 'phar bas dmangs kyi rgyu stobs nyams pa/rgyu stobs nyams pa'i rkyen gyis dmag khral lci ba sogs rten cing 'brel bar byung zhing / lhag par du dmangs stobs dang dmangs kyi rgyu nor yongs su zad pa'i skabs su/ dbus rgyud ( ṭha)sa khul gyi khyim tshang thams cad stongs par 'gyur bzhin pa dang / de'i skabs su mi ser gyi 'gro gron bcu cha bdun zin pa dang / rgyal khab kyi 'gro gron bcu cha drug zin gyi yod/ dmag dpon mkhas pa dag gis 'bru gzan dgra yi phyogs nas len skabs/ dgra yi 'bru rigs krung re re la rang rgyal khab nas dbor ba'i 'bru rigs krung (5)nyi shu dang mtshungs pa dang /dgra yi gzan rtswa ta'an (7)re re la rang gi rgyal khab nas 'dren pa'i gzan rtsa ta'an nyi shu dang mtshungs so zhes bstan/ 'dir bstan pa'i dpung mi skyar ma mi bsdu zhing 'bru gzan lan gsum 'dren mi srid ces pa dang / go mtshon rang gi khab nas 'don/ rgyag bye dgra yi lag nas len zhes pa'i don ni/ rang rgyal khab kyi mi shugs dang dngos shugs sogs gron chung bya rgyu dang / dmag 'khrug gis rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor thad gyong gun 'phog tshad je nyung du gtong rgyu de yin mod/'on kyang spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel phyin pa dung /

krung rgo'i gsar brje'i dmag 'khrus gi yun ring rang bzhin la gzhigs /to/ na /sdo ḍi zlo/ par brten nas zas gos 'dzoms pa byadagos zhes 'bru gzan dgra yi lag nas len/ /zhes pa ni dmag don gyi rtsa don gal chen zhig yin zhing / lngar 'argog dmag 'khrug skabs/dmag sde brgyad pa dang dmag sde zhin si cun gyis lo ltar ston bsdu'i skabs su/ ston bsdur srung skyob byed pa dang / mgyogs brnga dang /mgyogs bsdu/ mgyogs sbas bcas kyi byed thabs spel nas/ dgra dmag gis 'bru rigs 'phrog mi thub pa byas pa lta bu dang / gzhan yang a ris we the nam la btsan 'dzul byed skabs/ 'thung chu shin tu dkon zhing / spre ru pin nas we de nam bar gnam grus dbor dgos pas mthar dam ga 'thab kyi rgyun ma 'khyongs pa de ni we the nam mi dmangs kyis 'gog gol mtha' gcig tu byas pa des yin pa'o/ /rgyab phyogs kyi skyel 'dren ci tsam ring ba de tsam gyis dgra bo'i 'jab rgol phog sla ba yod pa dper na/ spyi lo 1942lor/ rgyal mang dpung sde'i ( ༅ ho )9417rtags can gyi gru srung ru khag la khyon bsdoms skyel 'dren gru gzings 36yod pa de dag nub kyi rgya mtsho chen po byang ma nas shar phyogs su skyod skabs/ sbyi zla 4tshes 7nyin gyi phyi dro pa pi lun mtsho lag nas 'jar man dmag gi 'jab rgol 'phogs te su'u len gyi gru khar slebs dus gru gzings 13las lhag med pa dang / de dag nang blugs pa'i gnam gru 210gtor brlags phyin pas/ gnam spu 8rdodhis

'dren ma thub pa dang / gzhan yang 'thab 'khor 43)blugs yod pa nas 146ma gtogs dbor ma thub/ dmag 'thab rlangs 'khor — 3350gtor brlags phyin nas rlangs 'khor 890las dbor ma thub pa red/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs/ ljar pan gyi rdo snum dang khro lcags sogs dmag spyod dngos jas sne rigs bcu drug dang /de bzhin mngar cha dang gro 'bras bcas tshang ma nang 'dren bya rgyur brten dgos shing skabs der ljar pan la tun (7)sa ya bzhi 'dren thub pa'i gru gzings las med pa'i khar/ spu srung gi gra sgrig kyang med pa dang/ a ri'i chu 'dzul dmag gru'i dmigs sa gtso bo lngar pan gyi snum 'dron spu gzings yin pas/ lngar pan gyi 'bar rdzas (77)mi 'dang ba bzos pa red/ dmag 'khrug hril po'i nang ljar pan gyi tshong gru tun sa ya 8 la gyong gun 'phogs yod cing / de ni ljar pan pham kha shor ba'i rgyu rkyen gyi gras shig tu gyur pa red/'thab ya brtul bar 'dod pa na/ /dpung mang ngar cing khro bar byed/ /dgra las byung ba'i bdog pa dag /byas pa can la bya dgar 'byin/ /'khor lo'i g.yul gyi do ra ru/ /shing 'khor bcu phrag blangs pa na/ /sngon la len po bya dga' byin/ /38 dgra yi dmag dang 'phabs byas te/ /

'dren ma thub pa dang / gzhan yang 'thab 'khor 43)blugs yod pa nas 146ma gtogs dbor ma thub/ dmag 'thab rlangs 'khor — 3350gtor brlags phyin nas rlangs 'khor 890las dbor ma thub pa red/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs/ ljar pan gyi rdo snum dang khro lcags sogs dmag spyod dngos jas sne rigs bcu drug dang /de bzhin mngar cha dang gro 'bras bcas tshang ma nang 'dren bya rgyur brten dgos shing skabs der ljar pan la tun (7)sa ya bzhi 'dren thub pa'i gru gzings las med pa'i khar/ spu srung gi gra sgrig kyang med pa dang/ a ri'i chu 'dzul dmag gru'i dmigs sa gtso bo lngar pan gyi snum 'dron spu gzings yin pas/ lngar pan gyi 'bar rdzas (77)mi 'dang ba bzos pa red/ dmag 'khrug hril po'i nang ljar pan gyi tshong gru tun sa ya 8 la gyong gun 'phogs yod cing / de ni ljar pan pham kha shor ba'i rgyu rkyen gyi gras shig tu gyur pa red/'thab ya brtul bar 'dod pa na/ /dpung mang ngar cing khro bar byed/ /dgra las byung ba'i bdog pa dag /byas pa can la bya dgar 'byin/ /'khor lo'i g.yul gyi do ra ru/ /shing 'khor bcu phrag blangs pa na/ /sngon la len po bya dga' byin/ /38 dgra yi dmag dang 'phabs byas te/ /

shing 'khor rang gi dpung du sprengs/ /bzung dmag dge bas 'khor du skyong / /thob pa'ikha na 'phel ba'o/ /zhes bstan pa'i don phal mo che ni go sla zhing / 'thab ya brtul bar 'dod pa na/ dpung mang ngar cing khro bar byed ces pa'i tshig rkang dang po dang gnyis pa'i don ni/ dpung mang la bsam blo'i thad skul slong gis/ dgra bo'i nyes spyod 'ther don byed pa dang / dpung mang rnams dgra bor khongs nas khro ba'i 'khon sems skyed thog zhum pa med par dgra dang 'thab lag spyod rgyu'i dpa' sems 'phel ba bya dgos zhes pa'i don yin pa dper na/ krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis bzo zhing dmar dmag btsugs pa nas bzung chab srid las don lam lugs btsugs thog chab srid bsam blo'i slob gso btang nas/ dmag 'thab ma byas gong skul slong las ka nan tan byed kyi yod/bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug skabs/ sdug bsngal bgrang ba'i las 'gul zhes pa spel don yang / dpung mang rnams sa bdag dang bshu gzhig gral rim la 'khon sems 'phel ba bya rgyu de yin gshis/ dpung mang gis kyang de ltar 'khon sems rab tu bcangs nas dpa' ngar chen pos dmag 'thab byas pa lta bu dang / bzung dmag dge bas 'khor du skyong / thob pa'i kha na 'phel ba'o/ zhes pa ni bzung dmag la brnyas bcos dang mnar gcod sogs mi byed par/ rang gi mnga' 'og tu blta rtogs gang legs kyis skyong dgos de ltar byas tshe 3/nga

dmag dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i khar da dung rang dmag gi dpung stobs kyang sngar las je cher 'gro rgyur phan pa yod cing / de la rgya'/ khar 'phel zhes grags pa yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /g.yul ni rgyal ba mchog yin te/ /yun du sring ba mchog ma yin/ /g.yul la byang ba'i da// dpo/ gang / //tā ṭ+wāṃ kār+sha kār+sha ༷ / wa /kā da na dang / /zhes pa'ang semag 'thab kyi dmigs yul ni —dgra las rnam par rgyal ba bya rgyu de yin na/ myur du 'thab ste myur du rgyal bar byed pa legs shos yin pa las/ 'thab yun ring ba ni mi legs so/ der brten dmag 'khrug gi ngo bo dang dmisas yul/ khyad chos bcas shes pa dang / dmag 'khrug gi 'phel tshul la kha lo bsgyur thub pa'i dmag dpon 'di 'dra ba ni mnga' 'bangs kyi las dbang dang / rgyal khab kyi bde sdug dar rgud rang gis bzung ba'i ded dpon lta bu dang sbyin bdag lta bu yin zhes bstan/ /40

dmag dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i khar da dung rang dmag gi dpung stobs kyang sngar las je cher 'gro rgyur phan pa yod cing / de la rgya'/ khar 'phel zhes grags pa yin zhes bstan pa'o/ /g.yul ni rgyal ba mchog yin te/ /yun du sring ba mchog ma yin/ /g.yul la byang ba'i da// dpo/ gang / //tā ṭ+wāṃ kār+sha kār+sha ༷ / wa /kā da na dang / /zhes pa'ang semag 'thab kyi dmigs yul ni —dgra las rnam par rgyal ba bya rgyu de yin na/ myur du 'thab ste myur du rgyal bar byed pa legs shos yin pa las/ 'thab yun ring ba ni mi legs so/ der brten dmag 'khrug gi ngo bo dang dmisas yul/ khyad chos bcas shes pa dang / dmag 'khrug gi 'phel tshul la kha lo bsgyur thub pa'i dmag dpon 'di 'dra ba ni mnga' 'bangs kyi las dbang dang / rgyal khab kyi bde sdug dar rgud rang gis bzung ba'i ded dpon lta bu dang sbyin bdag lta bu yin zhes bstan/ /40

thabasakyis 'a ba rnam par bshadapa/spyir na g.yul gyi 'dren thabs ni/ /rgyal phran rang mgo btud pa mchog yin la/ /drag po'i shugs kyis sdud pa phal ba'o/ /cun shog rang mgo btud pa mchog yin la/ /drag po'i shugs kyis sdud pa phal ba'o/ /lu'u shog rang mgo btud pa mchog yin la/ /drag po'i shugs kyis sdus pa phal ba'o/ /brgya shog rang mgo btud pa mchog yin la/ /drag po'i shugs kyis 'dus pa phal ba'o/ /lnga shog rang mgo btud pa mchog yin la/ /drag po'i shugs kyis 'dus pa phal ba'o/ /lan brgya 'thab pa lan brgyar rgyal na'ang / /mchog pa'i mchom tu dge ba ma yin te/ /ma 'thab thabs kyis rgyal ba kun tu dge / 41

zhes pa'i bstan don ni/ drag shugs la ma brten par pha rol gyi dpung rang sde'i mnga' 'og tu ngang shugs kyis mgo bo btags te bsdur par byed pa ni g.yul gyi thabs yag shos yin pa dang / drag shugs la brten nas rang 'og tu sdud par byed pa'i g.yul thabs ni cung zhan pa'o/der brten lan brgya 'thab pa'i rgyal kha tshang ma rang la thob pa yin tshe/de ni bya ba yag po zhig yin pa smod mi dbos kyang yag shos nang gi yag rang ma yin te/ phan tshun 'thab 'khrug byed mi dgos par 'jam po'i thabs kyis pha rol las rgyal bar byed pa de yag shos nang gi yag shos yin zhes bstan/ dper na 'jar man shar nub gnyis rgyal khab gcig tu bsgril ba der phyi rgyal gyi dpyad gleng mkhas pas 'jar man nub mas 'jar man shar ma rang gi mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa dang / de ni ma 'thab thabs kyis rgyal ba'i dpe mtshon 'khrul med du brtsi ba lta bu'o/ /'dir bstan pa'i cun shog dang / hri thog lu'e thog brgya shog lnga thog bcas ni rgya'i gna' rabs kyi dpung sde'i sgrig khungs yin zhing / skabs der cun shog la dmag mi 12500 dang / hri thos la dmag mi 2500 dang / lu'e shog la dmag mi 500 dang / brgya ༷/ khrishā)rdzu ngadapaki dī 100 lan shog (7)la dmag mi 25 lnga shog (/7 ) su — shāshā bye dī /bas kyis brtul ba dang po ste/ /'bre la bas bkugs te brtul ba gnyis pa'o/ /42 drag po'i dpung gis brtul ba gsum pa ste/ /

dpung tshogs grong du rgol ba bzhi pa'am/ /'di ni thabs su zad pas mtha' ma'o/ /zhes bstan pa'i dang po/ 'thab ya thabs kyis brtul ba dang po ste/ /zhes pa ni 'thab lag ma sbyor bar thabs jus kho nar brten nas 'thab ya thul bar byed pa 'di ni thabs jus kyi ang dang po zhig yin zhes bstan pa de'ang dper na/ spyi lo 1936lo'i 'i yan dus 'gyur skabs/ kung zhu'i ling dang dbyang hu'u khyen rnam gnyis kyis cang ce hrir lngar 'gog dmag 'thab bya dgos zhes btsan skul byas te/ cang ce hri lin thung (mi )du bkag nyar byed skabs/ lngar pan dang nye ba'i thog khag gis nang 'khrug slong ba'i lkog g.yo bshams thog lngar pan dmag dang zung 'brel gyis gung khran tang la ngo rgol byas/ kro'u en la'i yis krung gung gi tshab byas te krang dbyang dmag dpon rnam gnyis la zhi bas thag gcod byed dgos tshul gyi skul ma btang rjes/ cang ce hri nan cing la phyir log nas lngar pan dmag dang nye ba'i shog khag gi lkog g.yo tshar bcad/ des lngar 'gog 'thab phyogs gcig 'gyur 'dzugs rgyur phan thog byung ba ma zad/ de nas bzung rim bzhin lngar 'gog dmag 'thab byed thub pa byung zhing / ljar pan dmag dang nye ba'i shog // / me/gci sna sdi /ra bcad pa ni thabs kyis brtul ba'i dpe mtshon gnyis pa/ 'brel bas bkugs te brtul ba gnyis pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang pha rol gyi dpung tshogs stobs che chung la gzhigs te/ phyi disal

gyi 'bres ba btsugs thog pha rol gyi stobs shugs kha phral dang thor 'is tu gtong ba dang / pha rol gyi mna' 'brel rgyal khab rang phyogs su 'gugs pa'am yang na bar gnas su 'jog thabs byas nas/ rang gi 'thab ya grogs med kher rkyang du lus par byed pa zhig yin pa de ni 'thab jus kyi ang gnyis pa yin zhes bstan yod pa de'ang dper na spyi lo 1939lor 'jar man gyi she the les yo rob nub ma'i dbyin h+pha gnyis la dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i dmigs yul gtso bo sgrub ched/ thog mar 'phral rgol 'thab jus la brten nas pho lan gyi mnga' khongs yongs rdzogs btsan bzung byas te/ h+pha ran si dang pho lan bar gyi mna' 'brel 'brel ba med pa bzos pa dang / de rjes gzhi nas h+pha ran si dang / ho lan/ per kram sogs la dpung 'jug byas pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa drag po'i shugs kyis brtul ba gsum pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang / dpung tshogs bshams nas pha rol brtul ba 'di ni 'thab jus kyi ang gsum pa yin zhes bstan/bzhi pa/ dpung tshogs grong du rgol ba ni 'thab jus kyi yang bzhi pa'am thabs gzhan gang yang med pa'i thabs mtha' ma de yin zhes bstan/ dper na 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs/ spyi lo 1942lo'i zla ba 7par su'u len dmar dmag gis si tā lin ke le'i srung skyob dmag 'thab byas pa dang / dmag mi chig 'bum drug khri'i dpung stobs kyis 'jar man gyi dmag mi hri shog 22grong khyer du phar rgol byed ma sab par 'thab yun ring po'i dmag 'thab byed du bcugs pa dang /

gzhan yang 'jar man gyi hri shog 32 dang lu'i shog 3 2dpung tshogs kyi gzhogs gnyis su bsdad nas srung skyob ma byed ka med bzos pas 2dpung tshogs kyi rjes grabs dpung sder hri shog 2 dang lu'i shog 1 las lhag med pa red/ ma sazhi ljar dmag la skabs bstun rgol shugs ha cang chen po yod na'ang / grong khyer la rgol ba'i 'thab yun ring drags pa des/ skabs bstun rgol shugs kyi legs cha yang med par gyur ba dang / lhag par du gru kha'i dmag 'thab 'go tshugs rjes/ 'thab 'khor khrom lam brgyud nas ma gtogs mdun phyogs su dpung 'jug byed mi thub pa dang / rlangs 'khor kyang lag cig las tshang ma gtong mi thub pas/ rgol shugs ha cang nyams zhan du phyin pa de'i tshe na/su'u dmag gi 'thab 'khor 'gog byed mtshon chas zil shugs sngar las che ba 'don thub pa byung bas/ 'jar dmag shi rmas zam mi chad par tshabs cher phyin nas/ dpung mi'i dpa' stobs rim gyis nyams/dgun kha shar skabs/ dpung sde'i skabs bstun rgol shugs med par gyur zin pas/ su'u dmag gis 'jar dmag gi zhan cha de dam bzung byas thog spyi zla 11tshes 19nyin nas 20nyin bar 'gog rgol drag po byas mthar/ 'jar dmag gi dmag dpon pa'o li si'i (mas lo)mnga' 'og gi dmag mi drug 'bum lhag tsam 'dzin bzung byas pa dang /de nas bzung 'jar dmag pham nyes su 'gro 'go tshugs/ de ltar grong khyer du phar rgol byas pa des 'jar man pham kha shor ba dang / su'u dmag la khe bzang rag pa lta bu'o/ / 45

so lta'i 'khor khang sprun wun 'khor lo dag /drul ba bcos dang mkho chas sta gon la/ /grubs pa'i dus kyi yun tshad zla gsum khar/ /grong rgol sa de'u spungs la zla ba gsum/ /dmag dpon pham dogs 'tshab cing khro ba na/ /dpung mang grog ma bzhin du gyang la 'ded/ /dpung mi gsum cha gcig ni 'chi rmas kyang / /grong gi mkhar rdzong da dung gtor mi bya/ /de ni mkhar grong rgol ba'i nyes dmigs yin/ /de phyir gang zhig g.yul la mkhas pa yis/ /dgra sde brtul yang g.yul 'thab mi sbyor la/ /grong mkhar bzung rung grong la rgol min zhing / /pha rol rdul bzhin brlags kyang yu na mi bsrings/ /yongs su rgyal ba'i thabs kyis gnam 'og bzung / /rang shed mi rgud rnam par rgyal bar byed/ /'di dag thabs kyis rgol ba'i gzhi ma'o/ /zhes 'dir grong du dpung 'jug byed skabs gra sgrig yu na ring byed dgos pa'i khar/ dmag yun ring ba dang shi rmas mang ba sogs kyi nyes skyon che bas 'i thabs la brten nas grong khyer 'dzin dgos tshul gyi bstan don go sla zhing / tshig kha shas kyi don mdo tsam zhus na/ so lta'i 'a/ḍi khang ( )zhes pa ni pha rol gyi grong khyer la so lta byed skabs bed

so lta'i 'khor khang sprun wun 'khor lo dag /drul ba bcos dang mkho chas sta gon la/ /grubs pa'i dus kyi yun tshad zla gsum khar/ /grong rgol sa de'u spungs la zla ba gsum/ /dmag dpon pham dogs 'tshab cing khro ba na/ /dpung mang grog ma bzhin du gyang la 'ded/ /dpung mi gsum cha gcig ni 'chi rmas kyang / /grong gi mkhar rdzong da dung gtor mi bya/ /de ni mkhar grong rgol ba'i nyes dmigs yin/ /de phyir gang zhig g.yul la mkhas pa yis/ /dgra sde brtul yang g.yul 'thab mi sbyor la/ /grong mkhar bzung rung grong la rgol min zhing / /pha rol rdul bzhin brlags kyang yu na mi bsrings/ /yongs su rgyal ba'i thabs kyis gnam 'og bzung / /rang shed mi rgud rnam par rgyal bar byed/ /'di dag thabs kyis rgol ba'i gzhi ma'o/ /zhes 'dir grong du dpung 'jug byed skabs gra sgrig yu na ring byed dgos pa'i khar/ dmag yun ring ba dang shi rmas mang ba sogs kyi nyes skyon che bas 'i thabs la brten nas grong khyer 'dzin dgos tshul gyi bstan don go sla zhing / tshig kha shas kyi don mdo tsam zhus na/ so lta'i 'a/ḍi khang ( )zhes pa ni pha rol gyi grong khyer la so lta byed skabs bed

spyo da pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo yod pa dang / phyogs bzhir sge'u khung yod pa 'i shing khang zhig yin pa dang / ming gzhan rgyang mthong 'khor khang // ba dang / der bya tshang gsog pas tshang 'khor (4)yang zer sprun lun 'khor lo (ma ma)zhes pa ni/ 'khor lo bzhi yod pa'i shing 'khor zhig yin te/ de'i stong la glang ko yis g.yogs yod pa de'i nang dmag mi 10tsam 'dzul chog /shing 'khor de mi yis 'bud 'ded btang te phas rgol gyi mkhar dang grong gi byang ngos la sbyar skabs/ pha rol nas 'phangs pa'i mtshon cha 'gog thub pa'o/ /mkho chas zhes pa ni/ pha rol gyi grong la dpung 'jug byed skabs byin /shā sbyatā zlo'i skas ring (za )dang lcags kyu sogs mkho chas sna sa de'u ( lo)pha rol gyi grong la dpung 'jug byed skabs bca' srung byed bde ba'i sa sbog gi 'dzing rags lta bu zhig yin pa'o/ /yongs su rgyal ba'i thabs kyis gnam 'og bzung zhes pa ni/'thab lag mi sbyor ba dang / grong du mi rgol ba/ dmag yun ring du mi bsrings ba bcas mdor na zhi thabs kyi thog nas thams cad rang gi dbang 'og tu bsdu ba'i don la go dgos pa ni mkhas pa spyi'i lta tshul yin mod/ 'on kyang kru'u cun gyis de ni zhi drag gnyis kyi thabs zung du 'brel nas kun las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa'i don la ngos 'dzin byas na/ gna' deng gnyis ku'i dmag 'thab kyi don dngos dang /snyin

par snang zhes gsungs yod pa'o/ /dpung tshogs g.yul du bkol ba'i srol/ /ldab bcus mtha' nas bskor ba dang / /ldab lngas gdong nas thad du rgol/ /ldab 'gyur gcig gis gyes shing rgol/ /dgra dang mnyam na 'gran zhing 'thab/ /dgra las nyung na zung ba dang / /mi do ba la g.yol bar bya/ /chung du dpa' yis 'dzing 'gyur na/ /chen po'i dbang du tshud par 'gyur/ /zhes bstan pa'i dang po ldab bcus mtha' nas bskor zhes pa ni rang dmag gi grangs 'bor de dgra dmag gi grangs las ldab bcu yis mang na/ phas rgol gyi mtha' nas bskor te bcom zhes bya ba'i don dang / dgra bo bskor rdung gtong bar rang dmag ldab bcus mang ba yod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam zhe na/ gsham gsal gyi sgor thigs thog nas gsal bshad thub/ dper na ka pa phar rgol byed mkhan dang kha pa 'gog srung byed mkhan yin pa/ phyogs gnyis po'i dmag mi'i bar thag tshang ma 0 002 yin pa/ka pa'i g.yul sa mdun mar dmag mi 15708 yod pa/kha pa'i g.yul sa mdun mar dmag mi 9425 yod pa/48phyogs so so'i g.yul sa gtso bo khag bzhir dbye ba/
