par snang zhes gsungs yod pa'o/ /dpung tshogs g.yul du bkol ba'i srol/ /ldab bcus mtha' nas bskor ba dang / /ldab lngas gdong nas thad du rgol/ /ldab 'gyur gcig gis gyes shing rgol/ /dgra dang mnyam na 'gran zhing 'thab/ /dgra las nyung na zung ba dang / /mi do ba la g.yol bar bya/ /chung du dpa' yis 'dzing 'gyur na/ /chen po'i dbang du tshud par 'gyur/ /zhes bstan pa'i dang po ldab bcus mtha' nas bskor zhes pa ni rang dmag gi grangs 'bor de dgra dmag gi grangs las ldab bcu yis mang na/ phas rgol gyi mtha' nas bskor te bcom zhes bya ba'i don dang / dgra bo bskor rdung gtong bar rang dmag ldab bcus mang ba yod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam zhe na/ gsham gsal gyi sgor thigs thog nas gsal bshad thub/ dper na ka pa phar rgol byed mkhan dang kha pa 'gog srung byed mkhan yin pa/ phyogs gnyis po'i dmag mi'i bar thag tshang ma 0 002 yin pa/ka pa'i g.yul sa mdun mar dmag mi 15708 yod pa/kha pa'i g.yul sa mdun mar dmag mi 9425 yod pa/48phyogs so so'i g.yul sa gtso bo khag bzhir dbye ba/

ka par khul re rer dmag mi 3927 yod pa/kha par khul re rer dmag mi 2356 yod pa/phyogs gnyis kyi dmag mi mang nyung gi sdur tshad ni ka par 10 dang kha par 6 yod pa dang gcig mtshungs yin la kha gtad so so'i bar thag kyang tshang ma gcig mtshungs yin/ ka pas bskor bcom byed skabs/kha pas phyogs bzhir dmag mi drug re 486 yod pa de dag phyogs gcig tu bsgril te mi 4mo6—24 yis ka pa'i bskor bcom las thar thabs byed srid pa de ka pas bkags thub pa byed dgos shing / de ltar byed par ka pas kha pa'i dmag mi 24 las mang ba'i thog nas 'gog thabs byed dgos/ gal te ka pas phyogs gcig nas dpung dīstag

ka par khul re rer dmag mi 3927 yod pa/kha par khul re rer dmag mi 2356 yod pa/phyogs gnyis kyi dmag mi mang nyung gi sdur tshad ni ka par 10 dang kha par 6 yod pa dang gcig mtshungs yin la kha gtad so so'i bar thag kyang tshang ma gcig mtshungs yin/ ka pas bskor bcom byed skabs/kha pas phyogs bzhir dmag mi drug re 486 yod pa de dag phyogs gcig tu bsgril te mi 4mo6—24 yis ka pa'i bskor bcom las thar thabs byed srid pa de ka pas bkags thub pa byed dgos shing / de ltar byed par ka pas kha pa'i dmag mi 24 las mang ba'i thog nas 'gog thabs byed dgos/ gal te ka pas phyogs gcig nas dpung dīstag

byed na yang la pa'i phyogs gcis gi dmag mi 6 las mang ba'i thog nas dpung 'jug byed dgos/ gal te kha pas dmag mi 24 phyogs gcig tu bsgril nas ka pa'i bskor bcom las thar thabs byed tshe/ kha pa'i dmag shugs 486524 yis ka pa'i dmag mi 10 dang 'thab na kha pa bskor bcom las thar thub bzo yod/ ka pas de ltar thar mi thub pa byed chen/ nges par du kha pa'i dmag shusas 476—24 las ldab 1 3 dang ldab 2 0 ldab 2 5 yis mang ba yod dgos shing / 476 gi ldab 1 5 dbang du byas na dmag mi 36 dang / 486 gi ldab 2 0 byas na dmag mi 48 486 gi ldab 2 5 byas na dmag mi 60 dgos pa yin/ yang gal te ka pas phyogs gang sar dmag shugs 'dang nges btang ba de'i grangs 'bor dper na 144 dang 192 yang na 244 yin tshe/kha pa'i dmas mi 24 dang bsdur na 6 1 dang 8 1 yang na 10 1 yin pas sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos nang ldab bcus mtha' nas bskor ba dang zhes pa'i don ni de rang yin pa red/ /ldab lngas gdong nas thad du rgol/ /zhes pa'ang / thang 'thab nang rang gi dpung stobs dgra las ldab lngas che ba yod tshe/ thad kur du phar rgol byed chog ces bstan zhing / thad rgol dang bskor bcom gyi khyad par ni/ bskor bcom rdi/ skangs dgra bos 'gag sa bzung dris /sdo zlo pye /sda/da yo ṭ+wāṃ kā rdo sdu/ /la dzod skabs dgra bo thang 'thab d+ngha 50ldab 'gyur gcig gis gyes shing rgol/ /zhes pa ni rang gi dpung

stobs dgra las ldab gcig gis mang ba yod tshe/ bslu thabs sna tshogs la brten nas pha rol gyi dpung stobs phral thog rang gi dpung stobs cung /lha sna'i thog nas pha rol cha shas su dbye nas tshar gcod dgos zhes dgra dang mnyam na 'gran zhing 'thab/ /ces pa'ang / rang gzhan gnyis ku'i dpung gi stobs gcig mtshungs yin na/ blo gros dang thabs la brten nas pha rol gyi dpung kha 'thor ba byas thog phan yod kyi go skabs dang bstun nas/ rang stobs gcig sdud kyis pha rol gyi rgol thub pa'i gnas la phar rgol byed dgos zhes bstan/ dper na dus rabs bco brgyad par/ dbyin ji'i mtsho dmag gi dmag dpon grags can snar shun ( lo7)gyis h+pha ran si'i dmas gru rjes 'ded gtong skabs/ h+pha ran si'i dmag gru ru khag dang phan tshun re re byas te 'dzing dgos kyang 'dzing chog pa zhig yin/ gang lags she na/ de ltar 'dzing rjes h+pha ran si'i dmag dpung la dbyin ji'i sa char btsan 'dzulakhyed pa'i stobs shugs med pa bzo thub pa'i ngos 'dzin byas yod/snar shun gyi de lta bu'i 'thab jus kyi ngan shugs ni dmag gru rang gi stobs shugs las lhag pa yod pas/ bkod 'doms pa mtho 'bring tshang mar khong lta bu'i 'thab jus kyi chu tshad ldan dgos pa yin/ /dgra las nyung na srung ba dang / /zhes pa ni/ dpung shugs chung ba'i skabs su 'gag sa brtan por bzung nas sa bab la brten te 'gog srung mtha' gcig tu byas thog dmag yun bsrings pa dang dgra bo pa/ga

skyil byed pa/ dgra stobs nyams zhan du gtong ba/ skabs dang bstun nas rgol lan sprod dgos pa sogs bstan zhing rgya'i lo rgyus thog gi kon to'u g.yul 'gyed ces pa dang / spre cu'i g.yul 'gyed ces pa/khri pi g.yul 'gyed ces pa sogs grags che ba'i dmag 'khrug tshang ma nyung bas mang ba las rgyal ba'i dpe mtshon sha stag yin pa'o/ /mi do zla ba la g.yol bar bya/ /zhes pa'ang / dgra'i stobs la 'gran zla ma do tshe re zhig drag las g.yol bar byed pa las 'thab lag spros mi rung zhes bstan pa dang / g.yol bar bya zhes pa ni/ rang nyid rgyal thub bzo yod pa'i go skabs gzhan zhig btsal te/ dgra dang 'thab dgos pa gsungs pa las yongs su phyir bshol dang / gtan du de las g.yol dgos pa'i don ma yin no/ dper na/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs/ 'jar man gyi mtsho dmag khyi 'doms pa teng nyi tses spyi lo 1943 lo'i zla ba 5 par phral thag chod po'i ngang mtsho thog nas chu 'dzul dmag gru'i dpung sde phyir 'then byas pa dang / sbyi lo 1944 lo'i zla ba 3 par slar yang rgyal mang dpung sde'i gru srung ru dpung la 'jab rgol gyi dmag 'thab bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi dor ba sogs rdotā ma mi do ba la g.yol bar byed pa'i mtsho 'thab kyi dpe mtshon yin sbyisdo tā /sdokā tram̐ ṭ+wāṃ lha/ dī gyur na/ /52 zhes pa ni pha rol gyi stobs la zhib tu ma dpyad pas gdengs tshod

med par/ dpa' dang blo khog kho nar brten nas stobs che ba'i dgra dang mtshon kha sbyar na/ rang nyid pham zhing dgra yi bzung dmag tu 'gyur bar nges so zhes bstan yod pa dper na spyi lo'i sngon gyi 99 lor han rgyal rabs kyi dmag dpon li ling gis rkang dmag 5000 khrid de zung nu'i sa khongs su kher 'thab byas shing / ling ci'i ri bor slobs skabs/ sngon la dgra'i rta dmag lnga khri'i bskor bcom phog pa dang /de rjes rta dmag brgyad khri'i bskor bcom phog cing / dmag 'thab nang pha rol la yang bsad rmas gang tsam bzos yod na'ang / dmag mi mang nyung shor ba dang / rkang dmag dang rta dmag gi he bag che ba'i khar rgyag bye yang rdzogs te mthar li ling dgra yis bzung ba lta bu'o/ /dmagadapon rgyal rje'i sdongs grogs yin/ /sdongs grogs 'jug pa zab pa na/ /shāl poshā khab ni dar ba /nga / /༵༵༵ bye/pa ṅgi sbyi dī byed pa na/ /zhes dmag dpon ni rgyal po'i dpung gnyen 'khor lo'i tsub ma lta bu yin gshis/ de lta bu'i dpung gnyen gyi blo gros kyi 'jug pa zab pa dang rgyal khab kyi don du bsam blo zhib mo gtong thub mkhan zhig yin na/des rgyal khab stobs dang ldan pa zhig bzo thub pa dang / dpung gnyen gyi blo thabs dman zhing rgyal don la bsam blo mi gtong ba yin na/des rgyal khab nyams nyes su lhung bar byed do zhes bstan/ dper ༵ spyi

lo 1894lo'i krung ljar gyi shing pho rta lo'i dmag 'khrug ste/ lu'u hrun kho'u dang dbu'i ha'e we'i mtsho dmag rten gzhi gnyis srung skyob byed pa'i dmag 'khrug skabs/ skam dmag gi bkod 'doms pas mtsho dmag la dmag 'thab byed rog ma byas pa des rten gzhi srung skyob kyi dmag 'thab pham kha shor ba lta bu red/ /rje bos dpung la 'tshe ba gsum/ /'jug pa'i gnad min ma rtogs par/ /gasding na zlojugatusdul ba /nga / /trī /kā r+shaX/ kāshā rten ༵ tshogs par/ /dpung tshogs sgrog gis bcings dang gcig /dpung gi tshul don ma rtogs par/ /dmag don the gnyer byed pa yis/ /dpung 'go som nyir tshud dang gnyis/ /dpung gi skabs 'gyur ma rtogs par/ /rbakod cing 'doms par byed pa yos/ /dpon dmag the tshomakhyed dang gsum/ /dpung 'go rmongs shing the tshom pas/ /pha rol dpung gis skabs su rgol/ /de la rang dpung rang 'khrug gis/ /54 rgyal khagazhan la 'byin zhes grags/ /

zhes rgyal po'am khab kyi 'go gtsos dmag don gyi tshul ji ba'in ma rtogs pas phyogs gsum gyi thad nas dpung sder gnod skyon dang pham rkyen bzos mthar rang dmag zang zing du 'gyur ba dang pham kha thor ba'i tshul bstan yong / deng nas cha mtshon na dmag dpung gi 'phrin skyel dang lta zhib yo byad ha cang sngon thon yin zhing / spyir na gcig sdud thog 'thab jus dang gal 'gangs che ba'i dmag 'thab kyi sgrig 'dzugs dang bkod 'doms bya rgyu ni ches mtho'i spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa nas 'gan 'khur gyi yod rung / g.yul sa dngos la slobs skabs/'thab sa'i bkod 'doms pas/ sngar bzhin gong rim gyi 'thab jus la gzhigs te/ skabs bstun gyi bkod sgrig dang bkod 'doms byed kyi yod/ dper na dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs su/ no man tir gzhi khyon chen pos nasang 'jug byed skabs/ a'e san ha'othar gyis(4r+sā lo)de ga 'thab dngos su byed 'go 'dzugs rgyu'i bka' rgya btang rjes la'o si spru (7lo )dang / chi'u ci 'ar (167)gyis der bkag 'gog ma byas pa lta bu red/ der brten gong rim gyis 'og rim gyi skabs bstun dbang char tshod 'dzin byed mi rung ba'o/ /rgyal ba'i don rtsa dpogs pa rnam pa lnga/ /—'thab dang 'thab min rtogs pa rgyal ba dang / /mang dang nyung ba'i khyad par dpogs pa rgyal/ /gong dang 'og ma gong bur 'gril ba rgyal/ /grabs dang ldan pas grabs med rgol ba rgyal/ / 55

dmag dpon 'jon zhing rgyal rjes mi 'the rgyal/ /de lnga rgyal bar dpogs pa'i thabs su nges/ /zhes g.yul las rgyal nges yin par sngon dpags byed thub pa'i rgyu rkyen la rnam pa lnga yod pa de'ang / rang gzhan gyi dpung stobs che chung dang sa bab bzang ngan sogs kyi mthun rkyen la bsdur te dmag 'thab byed 'os min rtogs pa dang / dpung tshogs dang go mtshon gyi 'bor grangs dang / sa bab dang gnam gshis kyi mthun rkyen bzang ngan bcas kyi khyad par rtogs pa/ dmag dmangs bar 'cham zhing mthun pa'i khar/ dpon dmag gong 'og bar bsam sems gcig tu sgril bar byed pa/ rang nyid gra sgrig gang legs byas zin rjes/ pha rol grabs zon med pa'i skabs dang bstun te dpung 'jug byed pa/dmag dpon 'jon thang che zhing / dmag dpon gyi bkod jus la rgyal pos gang byung rung the jus mi byed pa bcas yin zhes bstan/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka rtogs pa na/ /lan brgya 'thab kyang pham mi 'gyur/ /rang las gzhan ni mi rtogs pa/ /rgyal gcig pham gcig rgyal pham phyed/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka mi rtogs pa/ /lan brgya 'thab kyang pham par nges/ /zhes rang gzhan gyi stobs shugs ji bzhin dpogs thub min de rgya~X 6pham la rag las pa'i don gnad gal chen zhig yin pa gsal por

bcas shes rtogs byung ba red/ nur ha khres gnas tshul de dag la dbye zhib zab mo byas rjes/ pha rol phyogs ba'i nas yong na/ rang dmag phyogs gcig nas 'gog rgol bya rgyu'i blo thag bcad thog dpung mi khri drug 'dus te thog mar nub lam gyi ming dmag dang 'thab lag sprad/de ltar zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig nyin nub lam gyi ming dmag pham par byas/ tshes gnyis nyin byang lam gyi ming dmag tshar bcad/tshes gsum nyin nur ha khres rta dmag bzhi stong khrid de rgyal sa srung ba dang / tshes bzhi nyin/ shar lam gyi ming dmag tshar bcad/ ming dmag gi dpung 'go yang ku'o yis rang dmag pham kha shor ba'i gnas tshul de dag shes rjes/ lho lam gyi ming dmag 'phral du phyir 'then bya rgyu'i bka' phabs pa dang / phyir bshol byed pa'i lam bar du g.yul 'gyed de dmag mi stong phrag gi srog shor/ tshes lnga nyin ming dmag las yongs su rgyal ba bcas kyi thog nas/ nur ha khre ni rang gzhan gnyis ka rtogs pa'i 'thab jus la mkhas pa zhig yin tshul mngon pa lta bu'o/ /58

gzugs rnam bar bshadapa/mi pham zon gra sngon du bsgrig /de rjes 'thab cing thob par byed/ /gzhan mi rgyal ba rang la ste/ /rang nyid rgyal ba gzhan la'o/ /de phyir g.yul la mkhas pa yis/ /gzhan mi rgyal ba khas 'che yang / /rang nyid rgyal ba khas mi 'che/ /rgyal ba dpog tu rung ba las/ /btsan gyis len pa'i gnad ma yin/ /thob par bsam na 'dzing bar byed/ /mi thob bsam na srung bar byed/ /rang sar srung bas mi 'dang zhing / /thad du rgol bas thol ba'o/ /gang zhig srung bar mkhas pa na/ / 59

'og gzhi klu yi yul du yib/ /gang zhig rgol bar mkhas pa na/ /lha dmag dgung nas 'dren pa bzhin/ /rang nyid srung zhing yongs su rgyal/ /zhes gsungs shing / thog mar gzugs (7)zhes bya ba'i rnam bshad kyi ming don ni dpung sde'i bsgrig khungs dang gzhi khyon stobs shugs sogs la go ba dang / sa bcad kyi bstan don ni/ gna' bo'i g.yul 'thab la mkhas pa rnams kyis dgra bo rang las rgyal mi thub pa byed ched/ sngon nas grabasayon tshags su tshun pa byed pa dang / rang nyid dgra las rgyal ba byed chen/ rgyal thub nges kyi go skabs sgug ste skabs dang bstun nas rgol bar byed/ de'i thog nas/ dgra bo rang las mi rgyal ba ni rang la rag las pa dang / rang nyid dgra las rgyal ba ni/ dgra la rag las pa mtshon gyi yod/ der brten dmag dpon mkhas pa dag gis dgra bo rang las mi rgyal ba khas len par byed kyang /rang nyid dgra las rgyal ba khas mi len/ rgyal kha ces pa 'di bzhin blo tshod kyis dpog bya zhig yin pa las btsan shed kyis len par byed pa'i gnad ma yin/ rang gzhan kyi stobs shugs la blta bsdur byas rjes/rang nyid pham pa'i nyen kha yod tshe/ grabs zon gang legs kyis 'gog srung byas te/ mthar mi pham pa byed pa dang / de bzhin du rang nyid la rgyal kha thob rung ba'am thob bzo yod tshe/ phar rgol byas te mthar rgyaX zlor byed ces bstan/ /

rang sar srung bas mi 'dang zhing / thad du rgol bas thol ba'o zhes pa ni/ lhod g.yeng du thor la dogs pas gang sar bya ra byed pa dang / dpung tshosas kha bkrams te bca' srung byas tshe/ 'jog srung gi cha sang sar gnyon chung zhing btsan po med pa dang dpung shugs mi 'dang ba'i snang tshul 'byung nges pa 'di ni rang sar srung bas mi 'dang ba yin pa dang / rang gi dpung shugs gtso bo'am yang na che rigs kyis pha rol gyi dpung stobs 'an sa dang gnyon chung sar thad kur phar rgol byed skabs shin tu rgol sla gdang / 'di la thad du rgol bas 'phar mtho zhes bya/ dper na lu'u khru'i g.yul 'gyed (za lhalo)ces pa'i nagasun lu'u yis wu'u dmag khri gsum hrag bsdus kyi khru'u dmag khri nyi shu tshar bcad pa de ni srung bas mi 'dang rgol bas 'phar ma yod pa mag yin te/ gal srid dpung mi khri gsum gyis srung nas bsdad na gang sar kha bkrams te srung dgos stabs dmag shugs mi 'dang ba dang / dmag mi khri gsum po de dag gong bu gcig tu bsgril te skabs bstun dang yib gsang gis phar rgol byas na rgol bas 'phar ma'am thol pa zhes pa 'di byung ba lta bu'o/ der brten rang nyid srung bar mkhas pa dag gis rang gi dpung stobs dang 'thab 'jus sogs phas rgol gyi mngonadra med pa de'ang 'og gzhi klu yi yul du yib pa ltar lta sa bab kyis dbe+en pyodang / rgol si phyogs kyis 'bral ba zhig byas te/ rgol lan gang nas slog pa'i chi phyogs mi shes pa zhig bzo bar nges/ de bzhin du rgol ba la mkhas pa dag gis zil shugs shin tu che ba'i phar sgo: re

byed skabs/ gnam nas lha yi dpung tshogs 'dren pa bzhin 'gog thabs gtan nas 'bral ba zhig bzos thog gcig thad nas rang nyid srung ba dang / gnyis thad nas phas rgol las yongs su rnam par rgyal bar byed do zhes bstan/ /spyir 'gog srung thad nges par du sgrub dgos pa'i gal gnad gnyis yod pa de'ang gcig ni brdzus spyod dang mgo bskor ba sogs kyi 'thab jus bzung ste rang nyid kyi 'gog stangs dang 'thab stangs sgrib gsang byas te pha rol gyis gang nas rgol ba'i cha mi shes pa bzo dgos pa dang / gnyis ni sa bab zad spyod gang legs byas te dpung shugs drag zhan dang sa gab legs nyesaganyis phan tshun mthun sbyor 'os shing 'tshams pa zhig byas mthar/ dpung stobs sa la brten/ sa ni dpung gis sbud zhes pa'i 'thab jus kyi nus 'bras dang ldan pa bya dgos/de ni don dam du gang zhig srung bar mkhas pa na/ thog phyogs klu yi yul du yib ces pa'i don dang gnyis su masachis/ /dper na bod btsan po'i dus rabs khyi lo 792 lor bod dmag gis thang rgyal rabs kyi mnga' khongs yul pi ling kro'u (deng sang kun su'u lin lu'u)dang ling kro'u (deng sang kun su'u ling kro'u)sogs la dpung drangs nas yan kro'u (deng sang nying 'a yan khre rdzong)zhes pa bzung stabs thang rgyal rabs kyi mtha' mtshams la 'gog srung gi rten gzhi med par gyur ba ma zad/ lin po'o yang bod shamag gis 'dzin ha rda~X 2bde po yin pa dang / de bzhin spru yul dang h+phang yul (deng hran

zhi yi sprus shan rdzong dang hwang lin )yul gru gnyis kyang 'dzin pa'i nyen kha chen po bzos/ thang rgyal pos bod dmag gi btsan 'dzul 'gos thabs bya phyir yan kra'o ru dpung dmag btang ste 'gog srung gi mkhar rdzong bzo rgyu'i thag bcad/ pin zhing (deng hran shi'i shi'i pin rdzong dang rkan su'u nying shan rdzong )gi drag dpung spyi khyab yang khra'o hreng gis dmag don skor kyi snyan zhu zhig gong 'bul zhus shing / thang te tsung li hris ( lkolha yang khu'o hreng bkas 'gug nas dris par de snga yang kra'u byang rgyud mtha' mtshams lu'u yon (deng nang sog lu'u yon rdzong )mkhar rdzong bskrun skabs glang chu'u dang / he ta'o/ mu po bcas 'gag sa gsum la dpung dmangs bdun khri btang nas mkhar rdzong gsum bskrun pa red/ da thengs khyod kyis snyan zhu'i nang gong mas dmag mi gtong mi dgos zhes zhus 'dug pas khyod la thabs bzang po gang zhig yod dam zhes dris bar/ yang khra'o hrong gis zhib cing phra ba'i ngang bka' lan btabs pa de'ang / de snga lu'u yon du mkhar rdzong bskrun skabs dpung mang 'bor chen btang bas bod dmag gis gong ma'i thabs jus snga sa nas shes rtogs byung ba red/ da thengs mkhar rdzong bskun skabs gong mas bka' 'phabs te skrun na gong ma'i dpung dmangs ma mthar chig 'bum btang nas mkhar rdzong bsgrun bzo byas yod pa bod dmag gis dpog nges pa dang / gal te gong mas dpung snon ma btang bar nga rang mnga' 'og gi dpung mis yang gsang sgos mkhar rdzong bskrun par phyin na bod dalag nas rang dmag gis /rdor

rdzong bskruno pa ma mthong bas grabs zon gang yang byed mi srid cing /nyin bcu'i nang gra sgrig byas te zla ba gcis tsam gyi nang mkhar rdzong bskrun grub nges/ de rjes 'bru dang gzan rtswa bsdu gsog dang dpung mis bca' srung byas nas nye 'khor gyi lo thog dang phyugs rtswa tshang ma brnga bsdu byas na/ bod dmag gis dpung 'jug byas kyang gcis nas rang dmag si mthar rdzong btsan rdzong la btsan rgol byed mi thub par ma zad/gnyis nas tshur rgol byid ma thub pa yum ring po sdod thabs bral bas rang mtshams ngang phyi bshol mi byed thabs med yin pa de ni thabs jus yag shosayin/ gal te dpu༄ chen btang no dpu ngamang dang mi ser 'bor chen 'gro dgos pas zad gron sto cang che ba tsam las dmigs yul /kā sdi // /kā dhi dī/cadali/ hris der rgyu mtshan 'dug snyam nas 'phral du yang khra'o hreng gi dpung mang khag gsum du bgos te h+phang chu'u dang nye ta'o mu po bcas so sor gsang stabs kyis zla ba gcig ma 'gor ba'i nang mkhar rdzong gsum bde blag ngang bskrun grub pa dang / 'gog sung dpung dmag kyang bca' sdod byas zin/ tshul de bod dmag gis shes rtogs byung 'phril dpung tshogs bshams ti rgol thabs byas kyang mkhar rdzong shin tu brtan zhing 'bru gzan ri ltar sungs yod pa dang mkhar rdzong gi nye 'khor du rtswa dang chu tsam yang med pas phyi bshol mi byed thabs med byung ba 'di ni dpung stobs sa la brten/ sa ni dpung gis srung ba'i 'a~X jus shig yin la/ yangagasangathog mkhar rdzong ha cang brtan po

zhig bskun pa de la rgol thabs gtan nas ma rnyed pa de yang / gang zhig srung bar mkhas pa na/ /'og phyogs klu yi yul du yib/ /ces pa'i 'thab jus dang yongs su mtshungs/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i nges shes gang / /kun gyi blo las ma 'das na/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa ma yin zhing / /'thab ste thob dang rgyal ba la/ /kun gyis mchog tu bkur na yang / /mchog pa'i mchog tu ma 'gyur te/ /ba spu rkang gcig 'degs pa la/ /shugs su che bar ma 'dzin zhing / /nyi ma mthong ba'i mig shul la/ /zla ba de snazhin mi ga~Xl dang / // spyan pre kāṭā kā sdi byepa ṅgi la/ /gna' rabs g.yul la mkhas pa yis/ /sla ba nyid las rgyal bar byed/'thab mkhas dag gis rgyal ba la/ /'thab la mkhas pa'i ming med cing / /dpa' zhing brtul ba'i mdzad pa med/ / gang gis rgyal bar 'dzol ba med/ / 65

'dzol ba med pa rgyal nges phyir/ /rgyal ba'i yul ni pham po'o/ /g.yul gyi 'thab mor mkhas dag gis/ /pham pa med pa'i gnas bzung ste/ /pha rol brtul ba'i skabs mi glod/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i dpung dag gis/ /thob zin 'thab par byed pa dang / /pham par 'gyur ba'i dpung dag ni/ /'thab ste thob par byed pa'o/ /dpung 'go 'dren par mkhas pa yis /srid kyi don rtsa gsal ba dang / /khrims gshis brtan gyis skyong ba las/ /rgyal pham rang ger gcod par byed/ /ces g.yul las rgyal bar nges pa sngon dpag byed pa'i thabs jus de skye bo kun gyi bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ma byung na mkhas pa'i nang gi mkhas pa ma yin pa dang / 'thab lag sprod res dza drag po byas te thob pa'i rgyal kha der skye bo kun gyis ngo mtshar dang mchog tu 'gyur ba zhig tu 'dzin na yang / mchog pa'i mchog tu gyur ba ma yin te/dper na ba spu rkang gcig yar btegs pa na de ni shugs che bar mi brtsi ba dang nyi ma mthong ba'i mig shul la zla ba de bzhin du mi gsal ba/ rna bsdu 6'brug sgra thos pa la rna lcog gsal po yin par mi brtsi ba lta bu yin/

'dzol ba med pa rgyal nges phyir/ /rgyal ba'i yul ni pham po'o/ /g.yul gyi 'thab mor mkhas dag gis/ /pham pa med pa'i gnas bzung ste/ /pha rol brtul ba'i skabs mi glod/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i dpung dag gis/ /thob zin 'thab par byed pa dang / /pham par 'gyur ba'i dpung dag ni/ /'thab ste thob par byed pa'o/ /dpung 'go 'dren par mkhas pa yis /srid kyi don rtsa gsal ba dang / /khrims gshis brtan gyis skyong ba las/ /rgyal pham rang ger gcod par byed/ /ces g.yul las rgyal bar nges pa sngon dpag byed pa'i thabs jus de skye bo kun gyi bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ma byung na mkhas pa'i nang gi mkhas pa ma yin pa dang / 'thab lag sprod res dza drag po byas te thob pa'i rgyal kha der skye bo kun gyis ngo mtshar dang mchog tu 'gyur ba zhig tu 'dzin na yang / mchog pa'i mchog tu gyur ba ma yin te/dper na ba spu rkang gcig yar btegs pa na de ni shugs che bar mi brtsi ba dang nyi ma mthong ba'i mig shul la zla ba de bzhin du mi gsal ba/ rna bsdu 6'brug sgra thos pa la rna lcog gsal po yin par mi brtsi ba lta bu yin/

gang lags she na gna' rabs g.yul la mkhas ba rnams kyis rgyal sla ba'i dgra las rgyal bar byed pa shin tu mang zhing / der brten g.yul 'thab la mkhas pa de dag la rgyal kha thob na yang 'thab la mkhas zhes pa'i ming grags med la/ dpa' dang brtul phod che ba'i mdzad rjes kyang med/de'i rgyu mtshan yang 'thab mkhas dag gis dgra las rgyal bar byed pa'i thad nor 'dzol phran tsam yang meg nor 'dzol med pa'i rgyu rkyen ni 'thab na rgyal nges yin pa dang / de'ang gsal por brjod na thog ma nas pham kha'i gnas su lhung ba'i dgra las rgyal ba des yin/ 'thab la mkhas pa rnams kyis rang nyidami pham pa'i gnas su bsdad thog pha rol brtul thub pa'i go skabs skad cig tsam yang mi shor ba byed pa yin/des na rnam par rgyal bar byed mkhan dpung dag gis sngon la rgyal nges pa'i mthun rkyen yongs su tshang bar byed pa dang / de rjes gzhi nas dmag 'thab byed kyi yod/ pham par 'gyur ba'i dpung dag gis sngon la dmag 'thab byed pa dang / 'thab bzhin pa'i nang gzhi nas ltos dbang gis rgyal bar byed kyi yod/ gzhan yang dpung tshogs 'dren mkhas pa dag gis rgyund nas dpung sde'i byed phyogs srid jus kha gsal zhig bzo ba ma zad/ dpung khrims kyang nan zhing rgyun 'khyongs byed pa shātā zhe/ sa/ r+sha ba/ rten nas rgyal pham gyi lo' thag gcod thub pa byung spyi na dpung gi choganyid du/ /dang po rgya dang gnyis pa 'bor/ / 67

gsum pa grangs dang bzhi pa bsdur/ /lnga pa rgyal bcas rim par dbye/ /sa nas rgya byung rgya nas 'bor/ /'bor nas grangs 'byung grangs nas bsdur/ /bsdur ba las kyang rgyal ba 'byung / /de phyir rgyal ba'i dpung dag ni/ /khal gyis bre la 'jal ba bzhin/ /pham zhing nyes pa'i dpung dag ni/ /breyis khal la 'jal ba bzhin/ /'thab mkhas can gyis dpung 'dren na/ /g.yang nas 'bab chu bzhur ba bzhin/ /'di ni dpung gi gzugs sam stobs/ /zhes sbyir na dpung tshogs g.yul du 'dren pa'i chos nyid nas —bshad na/ phyogs lnga'i thad do snang bya dgos pa ste/ dang po mnga' sde dang 'thab sa la sogs pa'i rgya khyon dang / gnyis pa dmag spyod dngos mas kyi grangs 'bor/ gsum pa dmag mi dang go mtshon sgrig chas la sogs pa'i grangs/ bzhi pa phyogs gnyis po'i dpung stobs kyi sdur tshan/ lnga pa rgyal pham gyi mthun rkyen bzang nganabacas rnams yin zhing /de dag rim par 'byung tshul ni/ rgya 'jal ba las sa khyon che chung dang /sa khyon che chung las dmag spyod dngos mas kyi 'bor che chung / dmag spyotā 8dngos rdzas kyi 'bor che chung las/ dpung sde'i stobs che chung

bcas rim par byung ba'o/ de phyir rnam pa ra rgyal ba byed pa'i dpung sdes dmag 'thab byed skabs/ rang gzhan bar gyi rgol shusas kyi he bag ni khal gyis bre la 'jal ba lta bur snang ba dang / pham kha thor ba'i dpung sde ni bre yis khal la 'jal ba lta bu'i he bag snang ngo / g.yul la byang zhing mkhas pa'i dmag dpon gyis dpung sne drangs te g.yul bshams skabs/ sayang gzar nas drag tu bzhur ba'i 'bab chu bzhin gyen du ldog thabs bral ba lta bur snang bas 'di ni dpung gi gzugs sam stobs shugs yin zhes gsungs/ /

skabs babakri stobasarnam par bshad pa/sgrigs khungs du mar dbye gan/ /che skyong chu skyong mnyam pa dang / /gzugs dang gzugs ming dpogs pa na/ /che 'thab chung 'thab mnyam pa nyid/ /zhes bstan don gtso bo ni/ dpung dmag bdag skyong byed tshul nas bshad na/ dpung tshogs chen po gang 'dra zhig yin rung / sgrig khungs kha shas su dbye ba dang / de dag so sor 'go dpon bkod 'dzugs kyis bkod 'doms bya thabs sogs shes na dpung chen la sne khrid de dmag 'thab byed pa dang / dpung chung ngur sne khrid de dmag 'thab byed pa gnyis rtsa ba'i 'gro lugs bad gcig mtshungs yin zhes bstan/ 'dir gzugs ming zhes pa'i gzugs ni gzugs dbyibs dang phyi'i mngon tshul/ yang na dpung sde'i sgrig khungs dang sgrig lam bcas la go ba dang / so so'i mtshon byed la ming zhes grags/ ming ga/sdus de dag so sor mtshon pa de rang la'ang brda sprod pa'i go don

yod phyir/ de las mthong ba'i 'phrin brda dang thos pa'i 'phrin brda zhes pa byung ba'o/ de phyir 'dir gzugs dang gzugs ming dpogs pa na zhes dpung sde'i sgrig khungs mi 'dra ba'i gzhi khyon dang nyal langs sogs kyi skul brda mi 'dra ba khong du chud pa na/ dpung chen por sne khrid de dmag 'thab byed pa dang / dpung chung ngur sne khrid de dmag 'thab byed pa gnyis gzhi rtsa'i 'gro lugs thad gcig mtshungs yin zhes bstan/ gzugs dang gzugs ming gnyis kur brda sprod pa'i nus pa ldan pa gong du zhus zin zhing / gna' rabs dmag 'khrug nang phan tshun 'brel gtugs byed pa'i 'phrin brda la thos brda dang mthong brda gnyis yod pa las/ dmag dar dang me du sogs ni mthong brda dang /'khar rnga sogs thos byed yi/ bsdo/ //shā na /sna /sna zlo //sna zlo'i/ phyi/ra/ /gang du /pung tshogs btegs pa'ang / /// lha /// /sdo snarnyi/ zlo ba/ rte/na/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ pha rol dpung gis tshur rgol byas kyang /rang dmag mi pham pa'i gnas bab tu sdod thub pa byung ba 'di ni gtso bo mngon gyur dang lkog gyur gnyis kyi thabs la brten pa des yin zhes bstan/ 'dir bstan pa'i mngon gyur dang lkog gyur ni/ spyir btang dang rgyun srol gyi 'thab jus la mngon gyur du 'dzin pa steng /

dmigs bsal dang skabs 'gyur can la lkog gyur du brtsi ba yi na/gzhan yang 'thab jus thad/ dpung sngon la bton par mngon gyur dang / rjes su 'don par lkog gyur du brtsi ba dang / gdong nas thon par mngon gyur dang / zur nas thon par lkog gyur du brtsi ba/mngon gsal du 'thab par mngon gyur dang / lkog tu rgol bar lkog gyur du brtsi/ de bzhin mi rnams kyis tshon dpags byed thub pa'i 'thab jus la mngon gyur dang / tshod dpags byed mi thub pa dang bsam yul las 'das pa'i 'thab jus laskog gyur zhes bya/ ga'an da dung lkog gis mngon dang / mngon gyis lkog byed pa dang / mngon lkog spel mar spyod pa'i dpogs dka' ba'i 'gyur thabs mang ngo yod pa'o/ gzhan du na/ rang gi dpung tshogs kyis phar rgol byed skabs/rdo yis sgo nga gcog pa bzhin ha cang las tsā por pham nyes gtong thub pa byung ba 'di ni skabs dang bstun te bden rdzun gnyis kyi 'thab jus la brten pa de'ang bden pas rdzun mar rgol ba des yin zhes bstan/bden rdzun gnyis zhes pa ni stobs drag zhan gnyis dang dpung mi mang nyung gnyis ngal ba dang mi ngal ba gnyis sogaso la'ang go ba yin/ /spyir na g.yul gyi 'gyed thabs su/ /mngon pa'i tshul gyis 'thab lag sbyor/ /lkog 'gyur nyid du rgyal bar byed/ / lkog tu rgyal bar mkhas pa dag /72 gnam sa bzhin du spros mtha' med/ /

chu bo bzhin du 'dzad mtha' med/ /nyi zla zung yang de ltar te/ /'khor ba'i bgrod la mtha' thog med/ /dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba'ang de bzhin te/ /shar cing nub 'thims la nub cing shar/ /sgra rnam lnga las ma 'das rung / /de dag 'gyur ba 'bum sde'i dbyangs/ /kha mdog lnga las ma mchis kyang / /sdebs na blta bas chog mi shes/ /ro rnam lnga las ma 'das kyang / /sbyor na myong ba mi zad ldan/ /'thab lag sbyor ba'i thabs su'ang / /mngon lkog gnyis las ma 'das rung / /de yi 'gyur ba bgrangs dang bral/ /mngon lkog spel mar sdebs pa na/ /mtha' thog med pa'i a long bzhin/ /su yis ji bzhin dpogs par nus/ /zhes pa 'di'ang / spyir na dmag 'thab kyi thabs shes ni/rang gi 'thab jus pha rol gyi shes pa'am mngon pa ste rgyun ldan gyi rang bzhin thog nas dmag 'thab byed na'ang / mtha' ma'i rgyal kha ni lkog tu gyur ba yin te/ rang gi 'thab jus la skabs bstun gyi 'gyur+sha ba

btang nas pha rol gyi bsam yul las 'das pa'i ngang rgyal kha blangs par byed pa'o/ pha rol gyi bsam yul las 'das pa'i ngang rgyal bar byed par shin tu mkhas pa'i dmag dpon dag gi thabs 'phrul ni sne mang phun sum tshogs shing rdzogs mtha' med pa de'ang dper na gnam sa'i bar gyi dngos po thams cad skad cig gis 'gyur ba la dpogs pa'i mtha' dang bral zhing / chu bo bzhin 'dzad pa'i mtha' med pa lta bu yin la de bzhin du nyi ma dang zla gle gnyis kyang de ltar yin te/ shar nas nub tu 'khor ba la mtha' ma dang thog ma med pa dang / gzhan yang dper na/dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog yang de ltar te/ nam dus gcig shar skabs/gcig nub pa dang / gcig nub skabs/ gcig shar bzhin no/ /de bzhin du sgra la mtho dman mi 'dra ba lnga las med na yang / de dag phan tshun sdeb sbyor byas te dbyangs su grub na/ shin tu snyan zhing rna ba'i bdud rtsi lta bur 'gyur ba dang / yang dper na rtsa ba'i kha mdog la sngon po dang ser po dmar po dkar po nag po bcas lnga las med kyang/de dag phan tshun sdeb cing sbyor na sne mang phun sum tshogs pa dang blta bas chog mi shes pa'i tshon mdangs su grub pa ro la skyur ba dang /mngar ba/ ska ba/ tsha ba lan tsha ba bcas lnga las med kyang / de dag phan tshun sbyor na ro bcud kyi myong ba zad med du ldan pa bcas dang 'dra bar dmag gi 'thab jus la'ang mdor na rnam pa gnyis las med na yang / de gnyis kyi skabs bstun 'gyur ba grangs las 'das so/mardo/ 'gyur dang lkog gyur gnyis kyi 'thab jus phan tshun spel mar

sdebs na/ sgor du 'khor ba'i a long la mtha' thog 'tshol thabs bral ba bzhin su 'dra zhig gis kyang de ji bzhin dpogs par mi nus so zhes bstan/ mngon lkog 'gyur ba grangs las 'das zhes pa'i sgrub byed dang / gna' rabs rgyun du spyod pa'i bden rdzun dang snang mun nam mngon sgrib kyi bshad srol thad dpe ris dang bcas te gsal bshad mdo tsam zhus na/ mngon lkog gnyis ni ka pa dang kha pa'i dmag 'thab kyi thabs jus yin zhing / de'i nang bkol spyod byas pa'i dmag shugs dang / dpung 'dren sa'i kha phyogs sogs tshud yod/ /bden rdzun gnyis ni/ ka pa dang kha pa phyogs gnyis po'i dpung dmag gi grangs 'bor la zer ba yin/ gzhan yang rdzun zhes pa spyir btang dpung shugs gtso bo ma yin pa dang / dpung mi zhung shas bed spyod byed pa la go ba dang / bden zhes pa dpung shugs gtso bo dang /dpung mi mang po zadaspyod byed pa la go ba'o/ /snang mun ni ka pa dang kha pa phyogs gnyis po'i dmag don gi gnas tshul mngon pa dang sgrib gsang byed pa la go ba de'ang mun ni sgrib gsang gi don dang / snang zhes 0phyir mngon pa dang shegasu 'jug pa'i don yin/ dmag don gyi bya spyod thad/ gsang ba ni rgyun ldan gyi srol lam zhig yin rung / skabs re dmigs yul gang rung gi phyir na/ched mngags rang gi dpung stobs phyir mngon chog /75

sdebs na/ sgor du 'khor ba'i a long la mtha' thog 'tshol thabs bral ba bzhin su 'dra zhig gis kyang de ji bzhin dpogs par mi nus so zhes bstan/ mngon lkog 'gyur ba grangs las 'das zhes pa'i sgrub byed dang / gna' rabs rgyun du spyod pa'i bden rdzun dang snang mun nam mngon sgrib kyi bshad srol thad dpe ris dang bcas te gsal bshad mdo tsam zhus na/ mngon lkog gnyis ni ka pa dang kha pa'i dmag 'thab kyi thabs jus yin zhing / de'i nang bkol spyod byas pa'i dmag shugs dang / dpung 'dren sa'i kha phyogs sogs tshud yod/ /bden rdzun gnyis ni/ ka pa dang kha pa phyogs gnyis po'i dpung dmag gi grangs 'bor la zer ba yin/ gzhan yang rdzun zhes pa spyir btang dpung shugs gtso bo ma yin pa dang / dpung mi zhung shas bed spyod byed pa la go ba dang / bden zhes pa dpung shugs gtso bo dang /dpung mi mang po zadaspyod byed pa la go ba'o/ /snang mun ni ka pa dang kha pa phyogs gnyis po'i dmag don gi gnas tshul mngon pa dang sgrib gsang byed pa la go ba de'ang mun ni sgrib gsang gi don dang / snang zhes 0phyir mngon pa dang shegasu 'jug pa'i don yin/ dmag don gyi bya spyod thad/ gsang ba ni rgyun ldan gyi srol lam zhig yin rung / skabs re dmigs yul gang rung gi phyir na/ched mngags rang gi dpung stobs phyir mngon chog /75

zol(/༷ // /༷ ///zolasnog kha stong 97stong /ga gake dngos/desnang/ snang//ngos/ kho pya/ (wastong / tshostong /she sa/zol/desnang /7 snang //zol/brwarngorgyu / /sto rtsa rwarngorjod/dngos(// ///( /sdu ka/1ngos/gong gsal dpe rnozlo pa/sgri ra/ da / /sa/ gnas tshul gyi 'gyur // / pa/ zlo // dacu / pazhi chayod dī pa/ dī mai d+ngha par+sha /sog/ paspya/ //'gyur ldog de las kyang mang ba yod pas/ des mngon lkog gnyis kyi ༵ / / raṭ+wā /ngas las 'das zhes pa'i sgrub byed de yang dag pa zhig yin

drag tu bzhur ba'i chu rgyun gyis/ /rdo ba 'khur dang 'den pa la/ /stobs kyi bab ces bya ba dang / /myur gyis 'phur ba'i bya rgod po/ /mda' yis sa la lhung byed pa'i/ /gnas skabs de la dus tshigs zhes/ /des na 'thab la mkhas pa yi/ /bab ni nyen zhing dus tshigs myur/ /bab ni bkangs ba'i gzhu 'dra zhing / /skabs bstun 'phen pa'i skad cig nyid/ /zhes bstan pa'i don yang / rang dmag gi grangs 'bor dang blo stobs pha rol las che ba'i khar/ dmag 'thab kyi go skabs ma shor bar/myur du 'thab lag sprad na/ drag tu rgyug pa'i chu shugs kyis rdo thur du 'khur ba ltar/ gzhi nas pha rol gyis 'gog khubs bral ba'i zil shugs 'don thub cing / de la rang stobs 'don pa'i skabs su bab pa zhes bya/ dper na bya rgod kyis dngos po dang srog chags chung gras la ldir lcags gzhu ba'am de 'khyer 'dod na/ sngon la gshog pa bskums tsam byed pa dang / —de rjes mchongs pa'i tshul gyis gzhu 'khyer byed kyi yod/ de ltar byas na gzhi nas dmigs bya'i dngos po'am srog chags der gnad la 'khel ba dang dus tshigs tag tag thog lder lcags gzhu thub pa'am de 'khyer thub kyi yod/ dper na bya rgod kyis ri bong lha/na

skabs/ mchongs bzung gi bar thag ring drag na rjes mi zin pa dang /bar thag nye drag na sgro gshog lteb brtsigs thebs nas gshog par rmas skyon bzo nyen yod/ der brten sun lhas skabs su bab pa de gzhu bkangs ba lta bu dang / dus tshigasade mchongs shing rgol ba lta bur dpe bzhags te/ dmag 'khrug skabs dmag dpung gcig sdud dang dpung mang tshang ma blo stobs dang ldan pa 'thab lag sprod 'dod pa'i tshul du bsdad thog bka' phabs ma thag dpung 'jug byed thub pa bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ bkod 'doms pas sems thog bcad de/bka' 'bebs pa'i 'gag rtsa'i dus 'di ni/ rang gi phan yod kyi go skabs yag shos shig yin zhing / de'ang shin tu thung bas skad cig ma'i yun tshad las med pa'o/rlo/ po za— pa~X bye/ // /kā ṭ+wāṃ shā dā / / /pa rdzu /zlo / /swākā ṭ+wāṃ /sdu// / zhes pa'i don ni/ dmag 'thab nang zhugs mkhan mi rta dang /phan tshun rams 'degs bya thabs sogs tshang ma dus tshod dang sa char lta bsdun byed dgos shing / nor 'dzol phran tsam gyis kyang zang zing du gyur srid/ des na rang nyid rgyal bar bya phyir/ cis nas kyang dpung bstar sogs kyi go rim zang zing du mi 'gyur ba bya dgos/ 'thab ya pha/ 8tshun gyi dpung tshogs mthug la ring che bas yang snying sur thob

skabs/ mchongs bzung gi bar thag ring drag na rjes mi zin pa dang /bar thag nye drag na sgro gshog lteb brtsigs thebs nas gshog par rmas skyon bzo nyen yod/ der brten sun lhas skabs su bab pa de gzhu bkangs ba lta bu dang / dus tshigasade mchongs shing rgol ba lta bur dpe bzhags te/ dmag 'khrug skabs dmag dpung gcig sdud dang dpung mang tshang ma blo stobs dang ldan pa 'thab lag sprod 'dod pa'i tshul du bsdad thog bka' phabs ma thag dpung 'jug byed thub pa bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ bkod 'doms pas sems thog bcad de/bka' 'bebs pa'i 'gag rtsa'i dus 'di ni/ rang gi phan yod kyi go skabs yag shos shig yin zhing / de'ang shin tu thung bas skad cig ma'i yun tshad las med pa'o/rlo/ po za— pa~X bye/ // /kā ṭ+wāṃ shā dā / / /pa rdzu /zlo / /swākā ṭ+wāṃ /sdu// / zhes pa'i don ni/ dmag 'thab nang zhugs mkhan mi rta dang /phan tshun rams 'degs bya thabs sogs tshang ma dus tshod dang sa char lta bsdun byed dgos shing / nor 'dzol phran tsam gyis kyang zang zing du gyur srid/ des na rang nyid rgyal bar bya phyir/ cis nas kyang dpung bstar sogs kyi go rim zang zing du mi 'gyur ba bya dgos/ 'thab ya pha/ 8tshun gyi dpung tshogs mthug la ring che bas yang snying sur thob

min gsal cha med kyang / zing gi khrod du rang gi dpung bstar sgo nga'i gzugs bzhi/ sgozlo sgor du ba/bye na pham par mi 'gyur zhes bstan/ /// bye dī pa/ wa ༵ 'a pa /sdu te////gnyon chung las ni mthu stobs 'argyung / /rnyog dang go rim spus las 'byed/ /dpa' dang sdar ma bab kyis 'byed/ /btsan dang gnyon chung stobs kyis 'byed/ / ces 'thab sar phyogs gcig zang zing rdu gyur bas phyogs gzhan de go rim dang ldan par snang ba dang / phyogs gcig 'jigs shing skrags pa des/ phyogs gzhan de dpa' ngar che bar snang ba/ phyogs gcig stobs med gnyon chung ba las/ phyogs gzhan de mthu stobs dang ldan pa snang ba dang / go rim dang ldan pa'am yang na zang zing du gyur ba gang yin pa 'di ni phyogs so so'i1dbu4gi byang tshad la rag las pa dang / dpa' 'am sdar ma ni phyogs so so'i gnas bab bzang ngan la rag las yod/ de bzhin du stobs dang ldan pa'am gnyon chung gang yispya pa rdo ṭ+wāṃ/ phyogs so so'i dpung sde'i dngos shugs kyi thog nas mngan pa /kā kā/ /dre/na/ la mkhas dag gis/ / brdzus su bcos pa'i tshul la ni/ /dgra yis rjes su 'jug par byed/ / 79

dgra la khe gang 'byin pa na/ /dgra yis de nyid len du 'ong / /khe yis dgra bo 'dren bgyid de/ /dpung gis dgra rnams sgugs par byed/ /ces gsungs te dag bo'i dpung tshogs pham par nges pa'i phyogs su 'dren mkhas pa'i dmag dpon dag gis dgra bor 'thab jus kyi snang tshul ngo ma sbas te rdzun ma zhig bstan nas dgra bo der rab tu 'khrul nas 'thab lan 'jal bar byed/ gzhan yang dgra bor khe bzang zhig byin pa na de len du yong ba dang / de'i tshen rang dmag 'jab sgugs kyis dgra bo mgo 'khor bar byed ces bstan/ /de phyir g.yul la mkhas dag gis/ /rgyal ba bab la brten pa las/ / mi la brten nas len pa med/ /de phyir rang dmagagadams mkhas la/ /bab dang bstun de bkol bar byed/ /bab bstun mkhas pas g.yul bshams tshe/ /rdo shing 'gril dang 'drid pa bzhin/ /rdo dang shing gi rang bzhin ni/ /bde sar mi 'gul rang sor gnas/ / g.yang sar mi sdod 'gril ba'o/ /80 thu bzhi rang sar 'gul med 'dug /

gor mo 'gril zhing rgyu ba'o/ //yul la pakhas sdu'i balha dkā tshul/ /rno / sna paX rnyi pa r+shadī bye ba na/ /zhes thog mar rgyal ba bab la brten pa las/ mi la brten nas len pa med ces pa'i mi zhes pa'i don 'dir go ba len tshul mi 'dra bar yod 'dug pa de'ang / kro'u hong 'ang gis brtsams pa'i sun tsi rgyas 'grel zhes pa'i nang mi zhes pa rang gi mnga' 'og dpung mir go ba ste rgyal kha ni 'thab mo'i bab dang bstun de blangs pa'am yang na bab la brten nas blangs pa las/ mnga' 'og dpung mi rnams kyi dka' 'thab la brten nas len par mi byed ces pa'i don yin zhes bstan/kru'u cun gyis bcoms pa'i sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos kyi rtsa 'grel zhes pa'i nang mi la brten nas len pa med ces pa'i mi zhes pa ni rang gi dgra'am phas rgol la go dgos tshul rgyas par bstan pa 'di la yang rgyu mtshan chen po yod cing / khong gi bzhed tshul ltar gsal 'grel mdo tsam zhus na/ tshig bcad 'di'i bstan don ni/ 'thab jus la mkhas pa'i dmag dpon dag gis gtso bo rang gi dpung dmag stobs dang ldan par bya rgyu gzhi rtsar bzung ba las/ phas rgol gyis rang phyogs kyi 'dod 'dun ltar ya lan 'jal ba'i 'thab jus bzung rgyu gtso bor 'dzin mi srid/ gang lags she na pha rgol gyis so so'i gnas tshul gzhir bzung ba las rang phyogs kyi skul brda nyan mi srid pa des yin/ 8snyir

brten 'thab jus la mkhas pa dag gis dgra stobs mi 'dra bar gzhigs te ya lan sprod thabs mi 'dra ba bzung ba de'ang rtsa ba las de phyir rang dmag gdams mkhas la/ bab dang bstun te bkol bar mkhas zhes pa de red/ sun tsis 'dir bab la bstun pa'am gnas bab bkol spyod bya tshul gyi yongs khyab tu spyod go chod pa'i rtsa don gsal por bton pa de'ang bab bstun mkhas pas g.yul bshams tshe/ rdo shing 'gril ba bzhin/ zhes pa 'di yin/ sun tsis dpung sde'i stobs shugs de shing dang rdo 'gul mi 'gul gyi tshul la dpe bzhag thog dpung sde gnas bca' ba'i khor shug mi 'dra bar brten nas 'gul mi 'gul gyi snang tshul yang 'dra mi srid pa bstan yod/ don dmag du'ang de rang yin te/ zhi bde'i dus mtshams su yun ring bor gnas pa'i dpung sde ni 'gul med zhi 'jags su gnas bde ba dang / dmag 'khrug gi gnas skabs su 'dug pa'i dpung sde ni grabs zon che zhing 'gul bde ba yin/ shing dang rdo la da dung gru bzhi yin na 'gul mi bde ba dang /zlum po yin na 'gul saba'i khyad chos ldan pa de dpung sde'i skabs bstun rang bzhin gyi mthu stobs che chung la dpe bzhag yod/ zlum gzugs can ni pham mi 'gyur zhesapa ltar sun this dmag 'khrug nang skabs bstun rang bzhin gyi nus par brtsi mthong chen po gnang gi yod/skabs bstun rang bzhin gyi shugs che chung ni/ byir phyogs gnyis kyi thad nas mngon pa de'ang gcig ni go mtshon thog gi skabs bstun rang ba/spya gyi nus pa'am yang na dpung 'jug gi nus stobs che chung dang /

gnyis ni dpung mang gi 'thab sems dang chab srid kyi bsam 'dun che chung / lus stobs che chung dang thang los kyi thog nas mngon gyi yod/sun lu'u yis dmag shugs kyi skabs bstun rang bzhin ni ri mtho po'i rtse nas rdo gor mo 'ig thur du 'gril ba dang shin tu 'dra zhing / de lta bu'i sra zhing mkhregs pa'i rdo ril de g.yang sa nas thur du 'gril na/ myur cing mgyogs la shugs drag ha cang che ba dang / de la bab ces pa'am bab las byung ba'i stobs yin par 'dod do/ /

dngos dang zol gyi rnam par bshadapa/'thab sa snga nas bzung bgyid de/ /pha rol sgug pa brtan zhing lhod/ /rjes nas rings kyis dpung btab ste/ /'thab lag sbyor ba ngal zhing dka'/ /de phyir g.yul la mkhas dag gis/ /rang gis pha rol 'dren pa las/ /phas kyis rang nyid 'dren mi 'jug /pha rol ngang gis 'ong ba ni/ /khe yi rjes su chags pa'o/ /pha rol 'ong bar mi nus pa/ /nyes su dogs pas 'jigs pa'o/ /lhod du bca' ba dub par byed/ /khengs pa'i lto ba bkres par byed/ /84 bde bar 'dug pa 'khrug par byed/ /

ces pa mi 'thab sa sngon la bzung na 'thab gra brtan pa dang 'thab gra lhod lhod byed chog cing / gal te 'thab sa dgra yis sngon la bzung ba'i rjes la rang gi dpung tshogs brel gyis drangs te 'thab lag sprod res byed na rgol shin tu dka'/ der brten kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis rang dbang med na pham pa nyid ces gsungs pa ltar/ g.yul gyi bkod 'doms la mkhas pa dag gis 'thab lag dngos spros skabs pha rol rang dmag gi bsam 'dun ltar bya spyod 'dzin du 'jug pa las/rang dmag pha rol gyi bsam 'dun ltar bya spyod 'dzin dgos pa mi bya'o/ /dper na krung go'i bzo zhing dmar dmag gis ku'e kro'u zhing chen du khre hru'e chu bo thengs bzhi brgal ba'i lo rgyus de ni rgyal khab phyi nang dang gna' deng kun gyi dmag 'khrug lo rgyus thog 'byung dkon pa'i rang gis pha rol 'dren pa las/ phas kyis rang nyid 'dren mi 'jug pa'i thabs jus kyi ngo mtshar che ba'i dpe mtshon zhig red/ gzhan yang dper na spyi lo 1905lor u ru su'i mtsho dmag gis rta mtsho dmag 'thab skabs/ ljar pan dmag gru ru khag gi dmag spyi tung shang bing pa lang gis dmag gru'i ru sne drangs te/ rang gi mtsho khongs thog rgyang ring nas yong ba'i u ru su'i mtsho dmag gi dmag spu'i yan lag ru khag gnyis pa sgug nas bsdad de dmag 'thab byas pa de ni 'thab sa snga na bzung bgyid de/ /pha rol sgug pa brtan zhing lhod/ /ces pa'i 'thab jus kyi dpe mtshon zhig yin/ pha rol ngang gis 'ong ba ni/ /zhes pa nas bde bar 'dug pa 'khrug par byed/ /ces pa'i bar gyi tshig do/ ni

pha rol bsru thabs la brten nas drag stobs che ba nas 'an par 'gyur ṣ+ṭṛ /sdu //// rang dmag rang 'gul gyi gnas su 'khod pa'i 'thab ra mda' bral la rgol ba dang / /rgol ba blo las 'das par byed/ /le dbar stong du dpung drangs kyang / /ngal zhing dub pa ma 'byung ba/ /'thab ya med pa'i gnas yin phyir/ /rgol ba rnam par rgyal ba gang / /srung mi thub la gol bas so/ /srung zhing brtan mor 'dug pa'ang / /rgol mi thub la srung bas so/ /de phyir rgol la mkhas gyur na/ /pha rol srung ba'i phyogs ma shes/ /de bzhin srung la mkhas na'ang / /phas kyis rgol ba'i phyogs ma shes/ /ngo mtshar che'o e ma ho/ /blta ba gzugs kyis dben pa'o/ /khyad du mtshar ro e ma ho/ /thos pa sgra yis dben pa dang / /86 phas kyi las dbang rang gis bzung / /

zhes tshig rkang dang po dang gnyis pa'i don ni dgra bor phar rgol byed skabs dpung rogs gzhan gyis rogs skyor bya thabs bral ba'i gnas la phar rgol byed dgos pa ma zad/ drag tu rgol ba'i zil shugs de phas rgol gyi bsam yul las 'das pa zhig byed dgos zhes bstan yod/dper na spyi lo 1941lor lngar pan mtsho dmag gis mu tig gru khar 'jab rgol byed skabs/ a ri'i dmag dpung gis mi mthong ba dang /rgyal khab gzhan gyi tshong gru dang mi 'phrad pa byed ched/ lngar pan gyi dmag gru rnams zhi bde rgya mtsho chen po'i byang rgyud mtsho lam nas mu tig gru kha'i phyogs su dpung 'jug byas shing / gal te a ri'i dmag gis shes rtog byung tshe ljar dmag phyir 'then bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod pas de ni ra mda' bral sar rgol ba dang rgol ba blo las 'das par byed pa'i dpe mtshon zhig yin pa lta bu/ gzhan yang le dbar stong du dpung 'jug byed skabs/ lam bar 'gog rkyen dang ngal ba gang yang ma 'phrad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni pha rol gyi 'gog srung byed mkhan med pa des yin zhing / rgol ba rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ pha rol gyi 'gog srung byed mkhan med pa'am 'gog srung byed dka' ba'i gnas yin pa des yin/ rang gi 'thab sa brtan por srung nas sdod thub pa 'di ni/ pha rol gyis dpung 'jug mi byed pa'am byed dka' ba'i gnas shig yin pa des yin/ dper na 'dzam gling dmas chen gnyis pa'i skabs/ de snga'i su'u len gyi nub rgyud sa mtshams kyi 'gog srung byed sa gtso bo ni wu'u khe la'an yin rung / 'jar man gyi daswā/

shugs gtso bos mu ru su dkar po'i sa khongs nas dpung 'jug byas zhing / de ni srung mkhan med sar rgol ba'i 'thab jus shig yin pa red/ de bzhin dpung sde'i bya spyod zab gsang byed rgyu yang gal 'gangs shin tu che bas 'gog pa'am rgol ba gang yin rung blta ba la gzugs kyis dben pa dang / thos pa la sgra yis dben pa zhig bya dgos/ de rdor byaX na phas rgol gyi las dbang rang gis kha lo bsgyur thub pa bsta/ bye dī pa / kyi/sa mi khegs pa/ /gnyon med gnas la rgol ba'i phyir/ /bshol ba rjes su mi 'den pa/ /myur ba'i rkyen gyis ma zin phyir/ /gal te bdag ni 'thab 'dod na/ /pha rol mkhar ni btsan na yang / /rgol na ra mda' sprod bde'i phyir/ /phyi ru bdag dang ma 'thab med/ /bdag ni 'thab par mi 'dod na/ /sa thig tsam gyis srung bar byed/ /'thab ya 'thab thabs bral ba ni/ /bslus shing 'dzol te 'dren pa'i phyir/ /zhes bstan pa 'di'i tshig don tsam ni go sla zhing / bslus shing 'a~X te 'dren pa'i phyir ces pa'i dpe mtshon zhig zhus na/ go mtshon

dang sgrig chas rtser son pa'i deng rabs kyi dmag 'khrug nang la yang 'thab jus 'di spyod chog ste/ dper na me shugs 'phur mdel 'gog pa'i bya thabs nang mdel mgo bsru 'dren dang 'phrin rlabs 'khrug 'chol bzo byed la brten nas pha rol nas 'phangs pa'i me shugs 'phur mdel gyi dmigs 'ben kha phyogs 'dzol bar byed pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang dper na/ spyi lo 1938lo'i zla ba 9par dbyin ji'i krang po lun dang h+pha ran si'i ta la tes she the ler 'jam thabs bzung thog / ce khe si lo t+pa khe'i khe phan blos btang ste/ mu nyi lha'i gros chod ces pa bzhags/ de'i dmigs yul ni/ 'jar man gyi dpung 'jug byed sa'i kha phyogs de snga'i su'u len la bsgyur nas 'jar man gyis yo rob nub mar dpung 'jug byed rgyu'i bsam jus med pa bzos pa lta bu'o/ /de phyir dgra gzugs snang ba las/ /rang gzugs ji bzhin mi mngon pas/ /rang nyid sgril zhing pha rol thor/ /rang dpung sgril ba gong bu gcig /dgra sde thor ba bcu phrag gcig /'di ni bcu yi gcig la rgol/ /rang dmag mang zhi dgra dmag nyung / //dro dīkā /dri zlo/ /kā ba na/ /'thab sa 'thab yas ma dpogs na/ / 89

'thab ya grabs sne mang ba dang / /grabs sne mang bas 'thab mi nyung / /zon gra mdun du bsgrig pa na /rgyab tu dpung shed zhan pa dang / /zon gra rgyab tu bsgrig pa na/ /mdun du dpung shed zhan pa'o/ /zon grabs g.yas su bsgrig pa na/ /g.yon du dpung shed chung ba dang / / zon grabs g.yon la bsgrig pa na/ /g.yas su dpung shed chung ba'o/ /zon grabs med pa'i gnas med na/ /dpung shed mi dman cha yang med/ /dpung shed dman pa'i rgyu'am rkyen/ /gang sar zon grabs bsgrigs pas so/ /rang dpung stobs su rdzogs pa yis /pha rol zon grabs bsgrig tu skul/ /zhes te 'dir yang dmag 'khrug nang dmag mi mang nyung dang stobs che chung bkol spyod bya thabs mu mthun rgyas bshad byas yod pa ma zad/ da dung rang dmag gi 'thab jus dang bkod sgrig khag gsang ba gang zab byas te pha rol gyis mngon mi thub pa byed pa dang / pha rol gyi ga/sdu tshul cis nas kyang zhib gsal dang / yang dag pa/ dus thag

bcas kyi sgo nas shes pa bya dgos/ de ltar byas na gzhi nas rang nyid kyi thabs jus 'dod 'dun ltar sgrub thub/ de'ang gtso bo dmag shugs dang go mtshon gcig sdud kyi bzang cha'i thog nas pha rol gyi dpung stobs zhan sar dpung 'jug byed pa ma zad/ de 'gag gnad 'grol sa zhig tu byas nas mu mthud dpung 'jug dang dmag thabs kyis mthar phas rgol pham par bya dgos pa 'di bstan yod/ 'dir sun tsis zon grabs med pa'i gnas med na/ dpung shed mi dman cha yang med ces pa'i don ni/ sa phyogs gang sar zon grabs ste dogs zorna gyis dmag grabs ma byas pa'i sa med na/ de rtsis kyis dmag shugs kha 'thor te/zon grabs sgrigs sa'i dpung stobs tshang ma gcig las sacig zhan pa ma gtogs ma zhan pa'i gnas med/ de ltar pha rol gang sar grabs zon gu/ /gos pa'i rgyu rkyen ni rang dpung stobs su rdzogs pa des yin zhes g.yul gyi yul dus dpogs pa na/ /le dbar stong du 'dus shing 'thab/ /g.yul gyi yul dus ma dpogs na/ /g.yas nus g.yon ru skyob min la/ /g.yon rus g.yas ru skyob mi bya/ /mdun gyis rgyab phyogs skyob min la/ /rgyab kyis mdun phyogs skyob mi bya/ /de phyir ring na le dbar bcu/ / 91

nye na le byibar /ga' spug gis/ /dro kā hā ༷/ / ci bye /pyawa/ pa/ na/ / rgyal khams grol ba'i dpung gi go /hrag cing rgyal yang phan cha ci/ /zhes 'dir saru bo dmag 'thab byed sa'i sa cha dang dus tshod shes rtogs zab mo bya dgos shing / de dag shes pa na bar thag le dbar stong gi sa la dpung tshogs 'dren dgos rung / dus bkag ltar g.yul sar 'dzoms nas 'thab lag sprod res byed chog gal te yul dus gsalapor ma shes na rang gi dpung grogs ga tshod thag nye por gnas kyang / phan tshun 'thab rogs byed mi thub na/ phan tshun bar thag ring mor gnas tshe de bas kyang ram 'degs byed thabs bral/ der brten ngas bltas na/ rgyal khams grol ba'i dpung yin phyin stobs la sdu/shā /sna ṭ+wāṃ /snan rgyal kha thob na yang phan pa'i cha ci mchis te/ ma dper na spyi lo 1942lo'i zla ba 11tshes 8nyin dbyin ji dang a ri rgyal khab gnyis kyi dpung dmag gis gling a h+phe ri kha byang mar dpung 'jug byed pa'i dmag 'khrug de/ g.yul gyi yul dus dpogs pa na/ /le dbar stong du 'dus shing 'thab/ /ces pa'i 'thab jus kyi dpe mtshon zhig yin par grags/ skabs der dpung 'jug bya yul khag ga~X yod pa de'ang gcig ni gling a h+phe ri kha byang ma'i nub rgya mtsho'i

'gram ste kha sa pu lan kha'i tar pe ta sa khul dang / gnyis ni ar ci ri ya'i ti krung rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi a'o lan nye 'dabs kyi wa ho lan zhes pa/gsum ni ar cir gyi sa khul bcas yin pa dang / dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i dus tshod ni zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad nyin gyi chu tshod gnyis pa yin pa red/ dpung 'jug byed pa'i lam khag gsum la dbye yod pa de'ang nub lam gyi the hun gru dmag a ri'i shar rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi hān phu tun nas chas/ des kha sa pu lan sa khul bar du dmag mi 24500sung skyel byed pa dang / dbus lam gyi the hun gru dmag srung skyel byed mkhan a ri'i dmag mi 18000yod pa de dag dbyin ji'i la'i te mtsho khug nas a'o lan sa khul du srung skyel byas/ shar lam gyi the hun gru dmag gis dbyin ji dang a ri phyogs so so nas dmag mi 9000ra mnyam 'brel thog mar ci'ar gyi nye 'dabs su srung skyel byas pa red/ ma gzhi the hun gru dmag khag gsum dpung skyod bya yul gyi bar thag dang dmag gru'i myur tshad mi 'dra yang / tshang ma dus thog tu g.yul sar slebs pa ma zad/ dpung 'jug byed sa'i phyogs gsum gyi dpung 'jug dmigs yul tshang ma dus thog tu legs sgrub byas yod/'thab jus 'dir brgyud nas g.yul dngos su bshams pa'i bar gyi bya rim la zhib 'jub byed skabs/ 'thab sa dang 'thab pa'i dus tshod sogs shes rtogs bya dgos rigs tshang ma tshud yod/ gzhan yang dper na nye rabs su a ri'i mkha' dmag gis li pi ri yar 'jab rgol dmag 'thab byed skabs/ dmag 'thab nang zhugs mkhan a zlo'i

mkha' dmag dpung sde khag tu dbye ste/ dbyin jir yod pa'i mkha' dmag rten gzhi dang / ti krung rgya mtsho'i mkha' skyod spu gzings a ma'i steng nas 'phur skyod kyis sngon gtan khel byas pa'i dus bkag dang dmigs 'ben ltar tsung thung las shag la 'bar mdel 'phangs pa de'ang yogayul gyi yul dus dpogs pa na/ le dbar stong du 'dus thing 'thab mi ces pa'i 'thab jus kyi dpe mtshon zhig yin pa red/ /rgyal ba mi yi sbyor bas gtod/ /pha rol dpung tshogs stug na yang / /'thab pa'i mthu nus ma ldan no/ /tshul rnams zhib por brtags pa na/ /rgyal pham gnyis kyi rgyu rab rtogs/ /'khrug rkyen bzo ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /pha rol bab ni dpogs pa'o/ /g.yul sar myul zhing brtags pa na/ /'chi gson zung gi sa rgyud chod/ /'thab ra cha tsam spros pa yis/ /bsgrun zla'i stobs kyi chad lhag shes/ /zhes bstan pa'i don gtso bo yang / gzugs rnam par bshad pa'i nang gtso cher dmag 'khrug gi mtha' ma'i rgyal kha de rang phyogs kyi stobs dang 'thab jus sogs la brten dgos pa las/ dgra bo'i nor 'a~X kho na sgug nas rang nyid la rgyal kha thob re byed mi rung ba rgyas

mkha' dmag dpung sde khag tu dbye ste/ dbyin jir yod pa'i mkha' dmag rten gzhi dang / ti krung rgya mtsho'i mkha' skyod spu gzings a ma'i steng nas 'phur skyod kyis sngon gtan khel byas pa'i dus bkag dang dmigs 'ben ltar tsung thung las shag la 'bar mdel 'phangs pa de'ang yogayul gyi yul dus dpogs pa na/ le dbar stong du 'dus thing 'thab mi ces pa'i 'thab jus kyi dpe mtshon zhig yin pa red/ /rgyal ba mi yi sbyor bas gtod/ /pha rol dpung tshogs stug na yang / /'thab pa'i mthu nus ma ldan no/ /tshul rnams zhib por brtags pa na/ /rgyal pham gnyis kyi rgyu rab rtogs/ /'khrug rkyen bzo ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /pha rol bab ni dpogs pa'o/ /g.yul sar myul zhing brtags pa na/ /'chi gson zung gi sa rgyud chod/ /'thab ra cha tsam spros pa yis/ /bsgrun zla'i stobs kyi chad lhag shes/ /zhes bstan pa'i don gtso bo yang / gzugs rnam par bshad pa'i nang gtso cher dmag 'khrug gi mtha' ma'i rgyal kha de rang phyogs kyi stobs dang 'thab jus sogs la brten dgos pa las/ dgra bo'i nor 'a~X kho na sgug nas rang nyid la rgyal kha thob re byed mi rung ba rgyas

bshad byas yod cing / 'dir yang dzirgyal ba mi yi sbyor bas gtod ces dmag 'khrug nang rang phyogs kyi thabs nus gang yod 'don spel byas rjes pha rol 'khrul ba dang bsam yul las 'das par byed pa dang /pha rol gyi gnas tshul dang / sa bab/ dmag 'thab kyi go skabs bcas rtog zhib gsal po byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog dpung dmag hrag sdud dang / gra sgrig 'thus tshang byas te/ bya spyod myur cing drag shugs dang ldan pa'i thog nas pha rol gyi dpung stobs zhan sa nas 'go bcoms te pham nyes su gtong dgos pa rgyas bshad sngar lhag byas yod/ gzhan yang mtshul rnams zhib mor brtags pa na mi zhes pa 'dir dmag don nang sbyong gi thabs la brten nas 'thab sa'i sa bab dang 'thab ya'i dpung stobs la brtags pa'i don yang tshud yod cing / de'ang nang sbyong byas rjes/ gzhi nas dpung mang bkol spyod kyi jus gzhi bzos thog dpung stobs ngo ma sbas te rdzun ma mngon pa'am yang na rang gi dpung stobs che bas pha rol gyi dpung stobs chung bar phar rgol byed pa'i tshul ston dgos shing / de'i dpe mtshon zhig zhus na/ spyi lo 1932lor/ a ri'i mtsho dmag dmag gru ru khag gis zhi bde rgya mtsho chen po'i thog zha we'i yi'i (mtshom)'gog srung nang sbyong zer ba zhig byas pa de'i phar rgol byed mkhan ni tsha lu ma pha cha zhes pa'i (lngar pan gyi dpung sde'i ming tshab )dmag gru ru khag gcig yin zhing dmag spu ru khag der mkha' skyod gru gzings a ma gnyis dang mthar skrod gtong byed dmag gru bzhi yod/ tsha lu ma'i dpung sde spyi zla 2tshes 6nyinā gyi

mtshan mo pha rol gyis shes rtogs gtan nas ma byung ba'i gnas tshul 'os byang shar nas wa hu'u gling phran gyi nye 'dabs su skyod pa dang / tshes 7nyin nyi ma ma shar gong wa hu'u gling phran dang bar thag sbyi le 108yod pa'i sar bslebs / khyon bsdom gru thog gnam gru 152'phur skyod kyis mu tig gru khar yod pa'i pha rol gyi dmag gru ru khag la 'bar mdel 'phangs pa dang de ni glo bur gyis 'jab rgol ngo ma zhig yin khul byas pa red/ nang sbyong byas 'bras thog nas pha rol gyi 'gog srung gnam gru gcig kyang 'phur ma thub pa'i sngon du tshang ma gtor brlags gtong thub pa ma zad/ gru khar bzhags pa'i dmag gru gtso bo rnams kyang gtor thub pa shes rtogs byung ba red/ 'on kyang dmag jus nang sgrub thub med skabs de'i nang sbyong ni/ lo dgu phyin rjes lngar pan mtsho dmag gis mu tig gru khar 'jab rgol byed thabs dang shin tu 'dra ba dang /bgod bro ba zhig la a ri'i dmag gis lo dgu'i gong na sngon sbyong ngam nang sbyong byed thabs de/ lo dgu'i rjes su lngar pan mtsho dmag gis a ri'i dmag dpung stong la bed spyod btang ba red/ a ri'i dmag gis rang gi nang sbyong dmag jus sgrub ma thub pa'i rgyu rkyen ni sngon sbyong byas pa'i rjes 'bras la bsam zhib gzab nan byas med pa de'ang pha rol gyi 'gog srung dpung sde'i gnam gru gcig kyang ma 'phur gong tshang ma gtor brlags gtong thub rgyu dang gru khar yod pa'i dmag gru yang rang sar gtor thub pa'i ngos 'dzin kho na byas pa las pha rol gyi chogs su tshud pas /na grabs la dogs zon ma byas pa des yin pa red/ /

mtshan mo pha rol gyis shes rtogs gtan nas ma byung ba'i gnas tshul 'os byang shar nas wa hu'u gling phran gyi nye 'dabs su skyod pa dang / tshes 7nyin nyi ma ma shar gong wa hu'u gling phran dang bar thag sbyi le 108yod pa'i sar bslebs / khyon bsdom gru thog gnam gru 152'phur skyod kyis mu tig gru khar yod pa'i pha rol gyi dmag gru ru khag la 'bar mdel 'phangs pa dang de ni glo bur gyis 'jab rgol ngo ma zhig yin khul byas pa red/ nang sbyong byas 'bras thog nas pha rol gyi 'gog srung gnam gru gcig kyang 'phur ma thub pa'i sngon du tshang ma gtor brlags gtong thub pa ma zad/ gru khar bzhags pa'i dmag gru gtso bo rnams kyang gtor thub pa shes rtogs byung ba red/ 'on kyang dmag jus nang sgrub thub med skabs de'i nang sbyong ni/ lo dgu phyin rjes lngar pan mtsho dmag gis mu tig gru khar 'jab rgol byed thabs dang shin tu 'dra ba dang /bgod bro ba zhig la a ri'i dmag gis lo dgu'i gong na sngon sbyong ngam nang sbyong byed thabs de/ lo dgu'i rjes su lngar pan mtsho dmag gis a ri'i dmag dpung stong la bed spyod btang ba red/ a ri'i dmag gis rang gi nang sbyong dmag jus sgrub ma thub pa'i rgyu rkyen ni sngon sbyong byas pa'i rjes 'bras la bsam zhib gzab nan byas med pa de'ang pha rol gyi 'gog srung dpung sde'i gnam gru gcig kyang ma 'phur gong tshang ma gtor brlags gtong thub rgyu dang gru khar yod pa'i dmag gru yang rang sar gtor thub pa'i ngos 'dzin kho na byas pa las pha rol gyi chogs su tshud pas /na grabs la dogs zon ma byas pa des yin pa red/ /

gzugs ṭ+wāṃ 'a/ba por mkhas pa na/ ///kāpa bye/ wakā nā /rdo dro shāng / /blo dang ldan pas dpogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don ni pha rol mgo 'khor bar byed pa'i dpung bi gzugs thun ma'am snang tshul rdzun ma ston pa'i thabs 'phrul la shin tu mkhas par gyur na de yis rang dpung gi gzugs ngo ma pha rol gyis gtan nas mthong mi thub par ma zad gsang ba'i myul ma dag gis kyang 'tshol zhib byed mi thub la/ blo gros dang ldan pa'i skye bos kyang ji bzhin dpogs mi thub ces bstan/ dper na mna' 'brel ( ༅stso)dpung sdes spyi lo 1944 lor no man ter dpung 'jug byed skabs/'jar man gyis dmag dpung bkod 'doms pu'u nas ma gzhi dmag 'thab ma byas gong mna' 'brel dpung sdes no man ter dpung 'jug byed nges yin pa shes na yang dus tshod gang dang sa phyogs gang zhig nas dpung 'jug byed rtsis yod pa shes med/ mna' 'brel dpung sdes zhib cing phra ba'i bya thabs rdzun ma mang po zhig bzung yod pa de yang /dpung 'jug rdzun ma byed pa'i bkod 'doms pu'u btsugs nas skad grags yod pa'i dmag dpon pā tun bkod 'doms par bkod pa dang /gnam gru rdzun ma dang rlangs 'khor rdzun ma bzos pa/ dmag sgar gnyis phyin rin kyang / she the les da dung no man ter dpung 'jug byas pa de ni rdzun rgol tsam yin pa dang / tsā la'i la dpung 'ju/ gi

nang skyong byas pa de dpung 'jug ngo ma dang drang rgol yin par ngos 'dzin byas/ der brten no man ter dpung 'jug byed pa'i bya thabs rdzun ma de ni gzugs kyi 'thab mor mkhas pa na/ /gzugs med nyid du snang ba dang / /zhes pa'i 'thab jus dang yongs su mthun pa'o/ /gzugs kyi 'thab mo'i bab bstun gyi/ /rgyal 'bras kun la bstun na yang / /phra mo'i rkyen ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /rgyal ba gzugs kyi thabs 'phrul la/ /brten pa'i phyi tshul rtogs gyur yang / /de yis de ltar rgyal byed pa'i/ /nga yi nang tshul rtogs mi 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i thabs ni mi zlos shing / /bab bskun gzugs kyi thabs 'phrul dag /'dzad pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bstan don gtso bo ni/ spyir na gzugs ni phyi'i mngon tshul zhig yin zhing / der yang phyi nang dang bden rdzun gyi dbye ba yod/gang 'dra byes te 'thab mo'i gzugs kyi bden rdzun dbye ba phye ste dmag 'thab byed rgyu dang dmag 'thab la bkod 'doms byed rgyu de ni las sla po zhig gtan nas ma yin/ mi rnams kyis dmag 'thab kyi phyi gzugs kyi mngon tshul rtogs sla yang / nang gzugs kyi gnas tshul ji bzhin da~Xs par dka'/ der brten 'dir gzugs kyi 'thab 'phrul la

brten te thob pa'i rgyal kha'i 'bras bu mi rnams kyis mthong na yang /de yi rgyu rkyen zhib phra rtogs mi thub pa dang / mi rnams kyis rgyal kha thob pa'i phyi'i 'thab tshul shes na yang / thob pa'i rgyu rkyen du gyur pa'i nang gi thabs jus shes mi thub ces bstan yod pa'o/ /'thab mo'i chos nyid chu phran bzhin/ /chu phran bzhur ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /sgang sa g.yol zhing rong sa 'grims/ /g.yul ngor 'thab ra sprod pa'i tshe/ /che la g.yol zhing chung la rgol/ /chu bo sa bab bstun bzhin bzhur/ /g.yul ni dgra dang bstun bzhin 'gyed/ /dpung gi 'dren tshul mi gcig la/ /chu yi bzhur phyogs brtan mi 'gyur/ /phas rgol 'gyur la brten bgyid de/ /mtha' mar rnam par rgyal byed pa/ /de yi blo gros rab tu mchog /'byung ba lnga yang mi rtag par/ /phan tshun dgra grogs 'gyur ba bzhin/ /dus bzhi phan tshun 'khor res las/ /gcig gi kun du bzung ba med/ /nyi yun la yang ring thung dang / / 99

ces /su dī kā /trī pa// sdidī di// bo/ ni g.yul 'dren tshul ni chu phran bzhur ba'i chos nyid dang yongs su mtshungs shing / pha rol gyi 'gyur ba la brten nas mtha' ma'i rgyal kha len mkhan ni thabs dang blo gros mchog tu ldan pa zhig yin zhes bstan yod/ gzhan yang dmag 'khrug nang / 'thab ya phyogs gnyis ka gcig la brten nas gcig byung bas 'gal ba yod la 'brel ba'ang yod/ der brten krung go'i gna' rabs mkhas dbang rnams kyis 'byung ba lnga'i thog nas 'jig rten gyi dngos po thams cad kyi 'byung tshul dang 'pho 'gyur/ sne mang gcig gyur la sogs pa gsal bshad byed pa ltar 'dir yang 'byung ba lnga dang dus bzhi nyi zla bcas kyi chos nyid thog nas 'thab ya phan tshun /spyanā /sdo /zlo zlo/kā /sa de bzhin 'pho 'gyur bcas kyi gnas lugs 'byung ba lnga yi phan tshun gcig las gcig 'byung stangs ni/shing las me dang me las sa/ sa las lcags dang lcags las chu/ chu lasbya shirdo sducas rim parā byung / phan shān ༷jig spyangakā ni sbri yis me shā sna ṭ+wāṃ rdokā ༵ /shā dzer+sha // lcags cas sbyang 'a ga sang rgyas sa 100

rtsod cing len parnam par bshadapa/spyir na 'thab ra sprod pa'i thabs/ /rje bo'i bka' ltar dpung 'go yis/ /mi ser dpung du sdeb pa dang / /kha gtad nyid du mkhar sgrun pa/ /de dag nang nas ches dka' ba/ /rtsod cing len par byed pa'o/ /rtsod cing len par dka' ba'ang / /gya gyus thad du len pa'am/ /gyong gis khe bzang sgrub pa'o/ /gya gyus len pa'i thabs dam pa/ /pha rol khe yis bsru ba'o/ /de ltar mjug tu rgol ba las/ /'dod don sngon du sgrub pa'o/ /'di ni gya rgyu'i rang bzhin dag / 101

// hā zlo/bye dro ༵ ṭ+wāṃ pazlo 'phrul la/ /zhes phan tshun kha gtad du langs te rgyal bar byed pa'i mthun rkyen rtsod len bya rgyu ni dka' tshegs shin tu che zhing / rtsod cing len pa'i nang nas kyang dka' tshegs che shos ni thabs lam bkol nas 'gro ba'am gya gyu'i thabs la brten nas thad ku'i dmigs don sgrub pa bya rgyu dang /yang na gnas skabs gyong nges can zhig khur nas mtha' ma'i khe bzang rags pa bya rgyu de yin/ gya gyu'i thog nas mthar thug gi rgyal kha len thabs yag shos ni'ang / pha rol la khe bzang byin te bsru thabs bya rgyu de yin zhing / de ltar byas na phar rgol byu rgyu dgra bo las phyi ba yod rung / dmigs yul ni dgra bo'i sngon la sgrub thub/ 'di ni gya gyu'i rang bzhin de thad kur gyi rang bzhin zhig tu bsgyur rgyu'i thabs shes la yongs su byang ba zhig yin pa'o zhes bstan/ 'dir gyong gas khe bzang sgrub pa zhes pa'i dpe mtshon zhig zhus na/ 'jam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs te/ spyi lo 1940lo'i zla ba 11tshes 14nyin dbyin ji'i grong khyer kha'o kun khru'e la 'jar man gyi gnam grus 'bar mdel tshabs chen po dbyugs shing / 'bar mdel ma dbyugs gong gi chu tshod 48tsam na dbyin ji'i gsang 'phrin las khungs kyi rim 'das gsang ba zhes pa'i gsang rtags 'phrul 'khor gyis 'jar man dmag gi 'bar mdel dbyugs rgyu'i 'char gzhi de shes rtogs byung ba red/ 'on kyang da/nā ji'i dbu bzhugs blon chen chi'u cer gyis gsang ba de shes rtogs

byung zin pa 'jar man dmag phyogs nas ha mi go ba byed ched/ grong khyer kha'o wun khru'e la mkha' thog gi 'bar mdel dbyugs rgyur nges pa'i gsang 'phrin de grong khyer de'i dmag dmangs la brda khyab gang yang ma byas pa red/ der brten de'i rjes su dbyin lun gling phran gsum srung skyob byed pa'i yun ring gi dmag 'khrug nang / gsang rtags 'phrul 'khor des shes rtogs byung ba'i gsang 'phrin la brten nas dbyin jir thob pa'i khe bzang ni grong khyer kha'o kun khru'i yi gyong kun phog tshad las ha cang che ba'am mang ba byung yod/ de ni gnas skabs kyi khe phan chung ngu blos btang nas yun ring gi khe phan chen po rag pa byed pa'i 'thab jus sheg yin pa red/ /gzhan yang mu ru su'i dmag 'thab lo rgyus thog spyi lo 1799lo'i zla ba brgyad par/ u ru su'i yon hru'e dmag dpon su a'o lo sprus u ru su'i dpung sne drangs te dbyi ṭa li'i ar pe si ri khug brgyud su'e sir skyod nas lim si ci khor sa kho spu'i dmag shog dang gcig tu sgril nas h+pha /nā spra/ /sdong 'jug byas pa de yang gyong gis khe bzang sgrub pa'i 'thab rtson cing len par khe yod la/ /sdo zlo/ / /sna ṭ+wāṃ nā sna d+ngha swār+sha/ //'khyer bzhin 'thab la chas pa na/ /dus rjes dpung gis zin mi 'gyur/ / 103

tshon lci 'dor te lhags pa na/ /tshon lci dpung dang 'bral zhing nyams/ /go khrab sgril zhing khur yang pos/ /nyin dang mtshan mo dbyer med du/ /myur ba ldab tu chas bgyid de/ /le dbar brgya na 'thab pa na/ /dpung 'go phas kyis bzung ba'o/ /zungs shugs ldan pa snga na gshegs/ /zungs med rjes su chas 'gyur na/ /slebs pa bcu cha gcig tsam du/ /nges pa de yi chos nyid do/ /le dbar lnga bcur 'thab pa na/ /'byor ba phyed gcig chos nyid dang / /snga ma'i dpung 'go pham par nges/ /le dbar sum cur 'thab pa na/ /'byor ba gsum cha gnyis su nges/ /gzhan yang dpung gi go tshon dang / /rgyag chas la sogs sngon gyi grabs/ /mi byed pa yang pham pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dir gnad don gsum bstan yod pa ste dang po da/sdu 'khrug gi dmigs yul ni rgyal khab dang mi rigs la phan pa'i bya

'brel lam bcad/ khu thu tso sprus da dung dmag 'khrug gi me lce ma mched pa'i lho rgyud sa khul du 'gro sa'i lam tshang ma bkags pa dang /h+pha ran si'i dpung dmag la de nas 'bru rigs len thabs bral bas na pho lun bkres ltogs kyi nyams nyen ma bzod par mu ru sur zhi gros mi byed ka med byung ba dang / khu thu tso sbos phral thag chod pos re 'dun de khas ma len par ma zad/ h+pha ran si'i dpung dmag mu ru su nas mthar sgrod ma btang bar dmag mtshams gtan nas 'jog thabs med ces bshad/ der brten h+pha ran si'i dpung dmag gis spyi zla 10tshes 19nyin nas mo si kho btsan bzung byed mtshams ma bzhags thabs med byung ba dang / de nas bzung h+pha ran si'i dpung dmag yongs rdzogs rtsa med btang / de ni dpung la za 'bru med na pham pa'i dpe mtshon ngo ma zhig yin pa red/ phyir khu thu tso spu'i dpung sdes mo si kho re zhig blos su ma gtong thabs med byung ste spyong gun tshab chen po 'phog yod rung /khong gi dpung sdes dpung dmag la mkho ba'i grabs gsog rgyu dngos sna tshogs 'jog sa kha lu ca zhes pa dang / go mtshon bzo grwa thu la zhesapa dang pu leng si khe zhes pa gsang ba'i thog srung nas bsdad yod stabs/lho phyogs sa khul khag dang 'brel ba bya rgyu 'gan srung thub pa dang / de la brten nas mi rta go mtshon la sogs pa dus thog tu gsab sprod byed thub pa byung nas/ pham pa nas rgyal bar gyur pa'o/ /rgyal phran gzhan gyi sgyu thabs dag /106 mi rtogs phan tshun 'brel mi bya/ /

nags ri gnyan sa na 'dam sogs/ /mi dpogs dpung tshogs 'dren mi bya/ /yul gyi sne shan mi brten pa/ /de la bab bzang thob mi 'gyur/ /dpung gi zil shugs brdzus te ston/ /phan char dmigs bzhin sbyor ba rtsom/ /phyes sdud 'gyur ba thabs su brten/ /myur ba rlung gi bgrod pa dang / /dal ba nags kyi skyed tshal bzhin/ /drag pa 'bar me'i rang bzhin dang / /mi 'gul lhun po'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /dpogs par shin tu dka' ba ni/ /nyi ma sprin gyis 'gebs pa dang / /dpung tshogs g.yul du 'dren pa ni/ /gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs pa bzhin/ /pha rol yul gru len pa'i tshe/ /dpung tshogs yan lag bgo bar bya/ /'thab sa skyed de bzung ba'i tshe/ /sa yi dge skyon dbye ba dang / /khe gyong dpyad de 'jug par bya/ /gya gyus thad du len pa'i thabs/ / 107

nags ri gnyan sa na 'dam sogs/ /mi dpogs dpung tshogs 'dren mi bya/ /yul gyi sne shan mi brten pa/ /de la bab bzang thob mi 'gyur/ /dpung gi zil shugs brdzus te ston/ /phan char dmigs bzhin sbyor ba rtsom/ /phyes sdud 'gyur ba thabs su brten/ /myur ba rlung gi bgrod pa dang / /dal ba nags kyi skyed tshal bzhin/ /drag pa 'bar me'i rang bzhin dang / /mi 'gul lhun po'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /dpogs par shin tu dka' ba ni/ /nyi ma sprin gyis 'gebs pa dang / /dpung tshogs g.yul du 'dren pa ni/ /gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs pa bzhin/ /pha rol yul gru len pa'i tshe/ /dpung tshogs yan lag bgo bar bya/ /'thab sa skyed de bzung ba'i tshe/ /sa yi dge skyon dbye ba dang / /khe gyong dpyad de 'jug par bya/ /gya gyus thad du len pa'i thabs/ / 107

sngon nas dpogs pa rgyal ba 'di/ /'thab ste len pa'i thabs dam pa/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dir don gnad lnga bstan yod pa ste/dang po/ rgyal phran gzhan gyi sgyu thabs dag / mi rtogs phan tshun 'brel mi bya/ /zhes chab srid dang 'thab jus kyi mtho tshad la gzhigs te/ srid dang dmag gi 'go 'dzin gang rung tshang mas rgyal khab gzhan gyi rgyal jus dang 'thab jus/ de bzhin pha rol gyis rang gi rgyal khab la 'dzin pa'i chab srid kyi rnam 'gyur rtog zhib bya dgos pa dang / de la brten nas rang rgyal khab kyi phyi 'brel srid jus gtan la 'bebs dgos tshul bstan yod sun lu'i dgongs pa 'di ni deng rabs kyi rgyal spyi'i 'brel ba dang / phyi 'brel/ dmag don/ nyo tshong 'brel ba sogs kyi thad sngar bzhin phan nus thon dang thon mus su mchis te dper na kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis spyi lo 1926lor gral rim dbye zhib bya thabs la brten nas krung go gsar brje'i dgra dang grogs po'i dbye mtshams gsal po bzo pa ma zad/ grogs po ngo mar mthun sgril byas te dgra bo ngo mar rgol rdung gtong dgos zhes bstan yod pa 'di ni sun sdi/ ṭā /dris pa dang 'dra mtshungs su snang la deng gi dus su yang spyod go gnyis pa/ dmag 'thab nang yodapung gi zil shugs brdzus te ston/ /phan char dmigs bzhin sbyor ba rtsom/ /phyes sdud 'gyur ba za~X su brten/ /zhes dpung mang bkol spyod bya thabs bstan pa de ni

gzhi rtsa'i bya thabs shig red/gsum pa/ dpung gi bya spyod kyi mngon tshul mi 'dra ba kha shas /ṭā/ bshā / /sa yo/nga/ byung khams kyi snang tshul la dpe bzhags nas bzhi pa/ pha rol yul gru len pa'i tshe/ /dpung tshogs yan lag bgo bar bya/ /zhes gsungs te za ma dgra yi yul nas len zhes pa'i zhib phra'i bya thabs gsal por bstan pa de'ang / rang gis bzung ba'i pha rol gyi grong khul du btsan shed ngang za 'bru bsdu ba'am yang na dmag la mkho ba ci rigs sa cha de rang nas rag thabs byed pa de dag tshang ma dmag 'thab kyi thad ku'i dmigs yul 'grub ched yin pa bstan yod/ /lnga pa/ 'thab sa skyed de bzung ba'i tshe/ /sa yi dge skyon dbye ba dang / /khe gyong dpyad de 'jug par bya/ /zhes bstan pa ni gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i 'thab jus shig yin zhing / de'ang thog mar rang gis bzung zin pa'i sa char dmag mi khag bgos kyis gal gnad che ba'i sa cha /mas/da 'a/na bya dgos par dang / de rjes rim bzhin rten gzhi rgya byud gatshokā sdo /sna gāl tho dīsta zlo bye/ ba/ rdu/nga / /bltas pas ma mthong dmag dar sbrengs/ /zhes pa dmag gzhung rnying mar gsal/ /dmag dar dpung gi bkod pa gang / /gcig tu nyan dang thos byed do/ / 109

rgol thabs gcig tu bzung ba'i rjes/ /dpa' rtul rang khor mchongs min la/ /sdar ma rang kher bshol mi bya/ /'di ni dpung tshogs 'dren thabs so/ /mtshan mo'i g.yul la me dang rnga / /nyin mo'i g.yul la dar gyis 'doms/ /'di ko g.yul gyi 'thab mo ba'i/ /mthong thos gnyis su mtshams pa'o/ /zhes g.yul sar bkod 'doms pas dpung mang la bkod pa gtong skabs/ nyan pas ma thos pa dang / lta bas ma mthong tshe/nges par du don brda 'phrod byed cig yod dgos par ma zad/ dpung mang gis don brda spyod stangs de'i nang bstan pa'i 'thab jus sam bka' rgyar nan gyis gzhigs te bya spyod 'dzin dgos tshul bstan yod/dmag dar ni don brda gtong byed cig yin stabs/ gna' rabs su dmag dar gyi tshon mdog dang / bzo dbyibs/ gong 'og dang g.yas g.yon du 'phyar pa'i thengs grangs bcas kyi thog nas/ bkod 'doms pa'i 'thab jus kyi don snying ston par byed pa yin/ du ba dang me ni gna' rabs su dmag brda'i du stegs zhes (spyang du'i stegs bu yang zer te spyang ki'i rtig pa mer bsregs te du ba gtong ba la go'o )bar thag ring mo'i sar don brda sprod stangs shig yin pa red/ dpal 'a~X dang / me phung / sgron me bcas ni mtshan mo'i don brda yin

pa dang / phyis su glog sgron dang ldang gzhu'i 'phrin brda la sogs par 'phel rgyas byung ba de dag mtshan mor bed spyod byed pa tsam ma zad/skabs re nyin mor yang brda gtong glog sgron la brten nas don brda sprod kyi yo da/ gong gsal gyi 'phrin brda sprod stangs de ko mthong brda'i 'phrin skyel gyi rigs su gtogs shing / gzhan yang go brda'i 'phrin skyel gyi rigs su gtogs pa dper na 'khar rnga dang / dung / zangs dung sogs yod cing / deng rabs dper na skud yod glog 'phrin dang /skud med glog 'phrin/ de bzhin dmar phyi'i 'od (077)zhesapa sogs tshan rig gi 'phrin brda'i yo byad mang po yod kyang / mna' rabs kyi 'phrin brda'i yo byad de rigs kyi nus pa bed med du phyin med de/dmag dpung nang da dung dmag dung dang / shu/ zhu 'od/ dar cha sogs 'phrin skyel yo byad khag sngar bzhin bed spyod byed mus yin/skabs babs kyi stobs rnam par bshad pa'i nang / gzugs dang gzugs ming dpogs pa na/ /che 'thab chung 'thab mnyam pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa las/ gzugs ni mthong thos kyi brda sprod pa'i bzo dbyibs la go ba dang / ming ni brda gang dang gang mtshon byed yin pa bstan zhing / de lta bu'i gdod ma'i 'brel brda de dag deng kyi dus su'ang spyod go chod kyi yod na'ang / mtsho khug dmag 'khrug skabs/dbyi rag gi deng rabs 'phrin skyel yo byad gtor brlags song rjes/gdod ma'i 'phrin brda gtong stangs la brten nas dus thog tu 'brel gtugs kyis bkod 'doms byed ma thub pa de yang pham pa'i rgyu rkye/1 snyig

yin pa'o/ /dpung gi zil shugs 'phrogs rung la/ /dpung 'go'i blo yang bcoms su chog /zhogs pa stobs su rdzogs pa las/ /nyin gung stobs ni nyams pa dang / /dgong dro dpung stobs yongs su 'dzad/ /de phyir g.yul la mkhas dag gis/ /phas rgol stobs la stabs bstun gyis/ /che ba g.yol zhing chung ba bcoms/ /'di ni zil gyi gnon pa'i thabs/ /sgrig dang ldan pas sgrig med gcun/ /bab cing brling bas zang zing gcun/ /'di ni blo yi rtul thabs so/ /nye bas ring ba sgug pa dang / /mi ngal ba yis ngal ba sgug /lto ba khengs pas bkres pa sgug /'di ni lus kyi rtul thabs so /dpung gral nan du bsgrigs pa yi/ /phas rgol lam sne 'gog min la/ /'thab gra tshags su tshud pa yi/ /112 phas kyi dpung la rgol mi bya/ / tsho

zhes //nga gā sta// // dī pag /sdu rdzu ṭ+wāṃ/la/ nyams dang blo sems/stobs nus/ thabs 'phrul bcas rtul thabs bzhi zhib tu bstan zhing /rtul thabs 'di dag gi 'byung khungs ni/ bab chags gtso sgrub dngos gtso smra ba'i mi'i rigs kyi lus srog gi lta tshul nas byung ba zhig yin pa red/ kon tsi'i nang las zhes par gzhigs na/ /mi'i srog ni sems dang rlung zung du 'brel zhing gnas pa las byung ba dang / rlung sems gnyis las lus srog grub par ngos 'dzin pa ltar/ sems ni dngos po'i steng du gnas pa dang / rlung ni rlung khams chen mo dang 'brel nas yod pa red/ gna' rabs kyi gtan tshig rig pa 'dzin pa rnams nas mi yi rlung sems dang zungs shugs ni lhan gcig tu gnas shing /phan tshun rten cing 'brel ba zhig yin par ngos 'dzin pa'o/ gzhan yang gna' rabs mkhas dbang rnams kyis rlung sems kyi grub cha'i byed las de/ mi yi kun spyod dang mi dang mi'i bar 'brel ba bya thabs kyi tshad gzhi dang phan tshun 'brel thog de gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba dang phan tshun shan zhugs byed pa'i thad mtha' dpyad byas yod/ sun lu'u yis rtsa ba'i rigs pa der shes rtogs zab mo gnang ba ma zad/ rtsa ba'i rigs pa de la brten nas dmag 'khrug la bkod 'doms byed kyi yod/ khong gis da dung rlung ni dus tshod kyi 'gyur ba la brten nas ngar ba dang 'jam stod gnyis byung ba dang / nang sems kyi 'gyur ba ni 'khor yug gi 'pho 'gyur la brten nas bying rgod gnyis su 'a/stu ba/

zungs shugs la bkres ltogs dang / ngal pa dang / ngal gso ba la brten nas stobs drag zhan gnyis byung ba bcas gsal po mkhyen gyi yod/de dag tshang ma mi'i lus sems la phyi rol yul gyi shan zhugs te 'pho 'gyur byung ba'i rang bzhin can yin pa red/ der brten rtul thabs bzhi po de dag shes pa byed par/ rang byung khams kyi chos nyid dang /mi chos kyi rgyun srol/ g.yul gyi 'dren thabs/ dmag 'thab kyi rtsa don bcas shes pa bya dgos pa'o/ /dpung tshogs g.yul du 'dren thabs su/ /mtho sar gyen du mi rgol zhing / /rgyab ri can la rgol mi bya/ // rnyi/ sdu/ kār+sha dī trī /ded cing / /bsru zan 'dra ba'i dpung mi rgol/ /phyir bcol dpung gi lam mi 'gog /'thab ya mtha' nas bskor ba la/ /srog sdi thar lam ngeX par 'jog /༵༵ bye sdu/trī ༵ ṭī /sna/ so/ // /'di ni g.yul gyi don rtsa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang / dang po/ phas rgol gyis 'thab sa /sdus pa bzung yod na/ rang dmag gis 'gog rkyen sna tshogs khyad

du bsad nas btsan shed kyis thad kur dpung 'jug mi bya bar/ pha rol gyi zhan cha btsal nas phar rgol bya dgos zhes bstan/ deng rabs kyi dmag 'thab yin kyang / rtsa don der snang chung bya mi rung / deng rabs go mtshon sgrig chas kyi 'thab rtsal dang / rang dang dgra sde'i gnas tshul/ dus bab dang sa bab bcas la gzhigs te/ skabs bstun gyi dmag spyod rtsa don bod spyod bya dgos/ /gnyis pa/ pha rol pham dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rtsa ba nas med rung / pham te bros byol ba'i snang tshul thon tshe/ der rjes 'ded kyis phar rgol bya mi rung / gang lags she na pha rol gyi 'jab rgol 'phog pa'i nyen kha yod/ ga'an yang pha rol dpung shed che bas rang sder rgyal kha thob mi srid par nges na/ stobs che sar g.yol te chung sar rgol dgos/ de bzhin du pha rol gyis rang dmag bsru thabs byed ched/dpung stobs chung ngu zhig rang dmag gi mdun du za ma ltar bza' chog chog tu bzhags tshe/ za ma de bza' mi rung / gang lags she na dgra bos skabs dang bstun nas tshur rgol bya ba'i nyen kha yod ces bstan/dper na spyi lo 1916lor/ 'jar man mtsho dmag gis lngar pan dang 'jar man mnyam 'brel gyi lan ha'i rgya mtsho'i dmag 'thab (5 7lo)rgyag skabs/ dmag 'thab bskor skyod gru gzings che gras/ si kha ke la'i mtsho khug tu btang ste/ dmag 'thab bya spyod spel tshul gyi g.yo thabs thog nas/ dbyin ji'i dmag gru ru khag nang nas dmag shugs khag cig 'jar dmag gi gtso shugs dpung dmag gi phyogs rdi :sru
