'dren byas rjes/ rtsa brlags gtong rgyu'i lkog jus btings thing /dbyin ji'i dmag phyogs nas skud med glog 'phrin nang nas 'jar dmag gi lkog g.yo de shes rtog byung rjes/ mtsho dmag gi dmag shugs /sdo tshad btang bas/ 'jar dmag gi lkog g.yo de sgrub ma thub pa gsum pa/ 'thab ya mtha' nas bskor ba la/ tshe yi thar lam nges par 'jog / ces pa ni 'thab jus gal chen zhig yin/ rgyu mtshan gang lags she na/ phyogs gsum nas mtha' bskor te phyogs gcig nas dgra bor bros lam zhig bzhags na/ dgra bo'i dpung mang gi zhum pa med par 'gog rgol byed pa'i dpa' sems chags pa dang /dgra dmag rnams lam de brgyud de 'thab sa dang grong khul nas phyir bros 'ong bas/ thang 'thab dmag 'khrug nang phas rgol rtsa brlags gtong rgyu'i dmigs yul 'grub thub ste/ dper na spyi lo 1928lo'i zla ba 2par krung go bzo zhing dmar dmag gis cang zhi'i nying gang du kru phe te'i dpung dmag dbyin shog gcig rtsa brlags gtong skabs/ phyogs gsum nas grong khyer du dpung 'jug byas pa dang / phyogs gcig dgra dmag bros lam lta bur bzhags nas dgra dmag grong khyer phyirol du bsru 'dren byas rjes/ snga sa nas 'jab 'gug byas nas bsdad pa'i dmar dmag gis tshang ma rtsa brlags btang ba lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa/ 'dir phas rgol mtha' la tshud pa na/ /thal gyis ma/sdu ba mi rigs so/ /zhes pa dang / gzhan yang kha rgyun du ri dwags

rmas mas mi la rgol zhes pa ltar/ 'u thug tshe 'chi bar mi 'jigs pas 'u thug can dang 'thab na de las rgyal bar dka' zhing / de bas na re 'ig gu yangs su btang na dge mtshan che ba yod pa'i don bstan/dper na sun lu'u rang nyid zhugs myong ba'i wu'u khru'i g.yul 'gyed nang /wu'u rgyal khab kyi dpung dmag khru'u rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa dbyin tu'u la dpung 'jug ma byas gong / lu'u rgyal khab kyi dmag dpon dru'i ku'i (za )yis khru'i rgyal khab kyi dmag dpon wu'i hre zhes pa'i sgar sa gnas spos bya rtsis yod pa shes rtogs byung nas/ sgar gnas gang du spos pa de'i rjes su gsang 'ded byas shing / ching h+pha zhes pa'i sa char slebs rjes/ khru'u dmag bskong 'du byas te de gar gtsang po zhig yod pa de brgal grabs byas nas sdod pa la/ lu'u dmag gi dpung mis thad kur 'thab lag sprod rtsis byed skabs/ spru ku'e yis bshad par ri dwags rmas mas kyang mi la rgol srid na/ mi 'u thug na de bas kyang smod ci dgos/ gal te phas rgol mnar drag na ma 'chi bar du 'thab par byed pas na re zhig sgug tsam gyis khru'u dmag chu phyed ka tsam brgal rjes 'phar rgol byas na legs te/ sngon du brgal mkhan tshe thar dang /mjug tu brgal mkhan thar thabs bgyi ba las/ 'chi yang 'thab phod mkhan yod mi srid ces ba da pa lta bu'o/ /117

thabs 'phrul rnam par bshadapa/spyi na g.yul gyi chos nyid ni/ /rgyal rje'i bka' bzhin dpung 'go yis/ /mi ser dpung du sdebs pa'i tshe/ /gnyan sar phru ma btab mi bya/ /chas su bde ba'i lam mdo ru/ /rgyal phran dpung dang stongs grogs sgrig /rtsa chus dben pa'i sa dag la/ /gnas su bca' ba mi rigs so/ /nyen gyis bskor ba'i 'gag sa ru/ /ngo mtshar sgyu yi 'phrul thabs 'don/ /'chi bar nges pa'i gnas dag la/ /'chi gson gcod pa'i 'thab lag sbyor/ /zhes gsungs te/ thabs 'phrul rnam par brjod pa'i thog ma ni sa ༵༵ nas 'go brtsams shing / de'i rgyu mtshan yang sa ngos kyi dmag

'thab ni sa rgya nges can zhig gi thog bya dgos stabs/ dmag 'thab kyi bya spyod dang bkod sgrig gi ngos nas bshad na sa bab ni gal 'gangs zhin tu che/ bkod 'doms pas rang gi dpung sde'i las 'gan dang /dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul/ de bzhin pha rol gnas bca' ba'i sa bab dang sa bab kyi mthun rkyen sogs la gzhigs te bkod sgrig bya dbos/gal te de 'dra ma byas na thabs 'phrul gyi don dam rtogs mi thub/gong du bstan pa'i sa bab lnga po de'i nang spyi tshogs kyi sa khams dang rang byung gi sa khams sogs cha tshang ba gleng med/ gsham du da dung dpung 'jug dang sa bab khor yug bcas kyi rnam bshad ston par bya/ de dag tshang ma sa khams kyi bab dang 'brel ba yod cing / 'dir gtso bo sa khams kyi mthun rkyen mi 'dra ba'i 'og dmag dpung gnas bca' ba'i thabs shes mi 'dra ba bzung thog gnas tshul mi 'dra bar lta stangs kyang mi 'dra ba 'dzin shes pa bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ /shul lam 'ga' la sdu ༷gro1 chog /lha: rnyi /r+sha/ ji trī /rdoX bye/ //sa yang re 'ga' mi rtsod chog /bka' yang skabs re mi bkur chog /ces gsungs pa'i mi chog pa lnga'i brjod don gtso bo ni bkod 'doms pas 'thab sar bkod 'doms byed skabs/ spyir gong rim gyi 'thab jus dang las 'gan la gzhigs te bya spyod rtsom dgodi sdung /

mtshams re skabs bab dang bstun nas rang 'tshams kyis dmag 'thab dang bya spyod 'dzin dgos tshul bstan yod/ 'on kyang de ltar byed pa'i sngon 'gro'i dmigs yul ni rgyal khab la phan pa dang / dmangs la phan pa/gro khyon /sdus kyi dmag 'thab rgyal kha thob rgyur phan pa bcas bya da sa pa 'bye /spya/ sgyu/ra phan pa shes pa ni/ /dpung tshogs bkol la byang zhing chub/ /thabasasgyurapanasdum shesan/ /sdo / ṭā /dri ༷pa /tā nā sdushā / /dpung sne 'dzin zhing skyong ba la/ /stabs bstun tha/bas 'phrul ma rtogs na/ ///dro zlozlo ṭ+wāṃ thu bye/ sdud/ mi/ thub/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dir don gnyis bstan yod pa ste gcig nas skabs bab dang bstun pa'i thabs 'phrul gyi phan cha shes dgos pa dang /gnyis nas thabs 'phrul de dag bkol spyod bya thabs shes dgos pa de yin zhing / gal te de gnyis ka ma shes na/ dmag 'thab nang rgyal kha thob mi thub pa bstan yod/ /gang zhig blo gros ldan pa yis/ /120 dge dang mi dge zung du dpyod/ /

mi dge'i nang gi dge ba'i cha/ /rtogs na bya ba'i 'jug pa bde/ /dge ba'i nang gi mi dge'i cha/ /rtogs na lan chags sel bar bde/ /'tshe bas rgyal phran mgo bo btud/ /las kyis rgyal phran bran du bkol/ /khe yis rgyal phran bsru zhing brid/ /de phyir dpung tshogs 'dren pa'i thabs/ /pha rol 'ongs min mi re bar/ /rang gi sgug gral legs par sgrigs/ /phas kyis rgol min mi re bar/ /lhags mi rnyed pa rang gis bgyid/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dir don gnad gsum bstan yod pa de'ang gcig ni/ 'gyur ba'in pa'i gnas tshul gang thig la zhib dpyad byed skabs/ phyogs yongs nas blta dpyod byas thog tshul gang dang gang gi phan pa'i cha mthong thub bya dgos la/ gnod pa'i cha yang mthong thub pa bya dgos/ gal te phan gnod gnyis ka ldan pa'i gnad yin phyin nges par du gtso phal dang ljid yang la bsam gzhig bya dgos/ dmag gi don dngos dang mtshams pa'i bkod jus yang dag cig la cha mtsho na yang tshang ma yid bzhin lhun gyis 'grub pa 'byung mi srid na/ bkod jus lag len bstar ba'i bya rim nang gnas tshul la 'gyur ba zam rdo 2rdod

mi dge'i nang gi dge ba'i cha/ /rtogs na bya ba'i 'jug pa bde/ /dge ba'i nang gi mi dge'i cha/ /rtogs na lan chags sel bar bde/ /'tshe bas rgyal phran mgo bo btud/ /las kyis rgyal phran bran du bkol/ /khe yis rgyal phran bsru zhing brid/ /de phyir dpung tshogs 'dren pa'i thabs/ /pha rol 'ongs min mi re bar/ /rang gi sgug gral legs par sgrigs/ /phas kyis rgol min mi re bar/ /lhags mi rnyed pa rang gis bgyid/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dir don gnad gsum bstan yod pa de'ang gcig ni/ 'gyur ba'in pa'i gnas tshul gang thig la zhib dpyad byed skabs/ phyogs yongs nas blta dpyod byas thog tshul gang dang gang gi phan pa'i cha mthong thub bya dgos la/ gnod pa'i cha yang mthong thub pa bya dgos/ gal te phan gnod gnyis ka ldan pa'i gnad yin phyin nges par du gtso phal dang ljid yang la bsam gzhig bya dgos/ dmag gi don dngos dang mtshams pa'i bkod jus yang dag cig la cha mtsho na yang tshang ma yid bzhin lhun gyis 'grub pa 'byung mi srid na/ bkod jus lag len bstar ba'i bya rim nang gnas tshul la 'gyur ba zam rdo 2rdod

par 'byung bzos yod pa dang / 'gal rkyen gsar pa gang yang 'phrad bzo yod pa smod ci dgos/ de'i thog nas bya ba dang dngos po gang 'dra zhig yin rung tshang mar phan gnod kyi rgyu rkyen gnyis yod pa mtshon zhing / phan yod gyi cha la do snang che tsam byas na/ dmag 'thab kyi rgol nus che ru 'gro thub pa dang / de la brten nas dpung mang gi 'thab sems kyang che ru 'gro thub/ gnod byed kyi rgyu rkyen mthong tshe/sngon nas de la dmigs pa'i 'thab jus bzos te 'gog thabs bya dgos/sngon nas 'gog thabs byas na lan chags sel bar bde zhes gnod byed kyi rgyu rkyen med pa bzo bde ba bstan/ /gnyis ni/ 'dir drag shugs ma yin pa'i gzhi rtsa'i thabs jus bstan zhing / de ltar bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dmag 'khrug ni drag shugs kyi rang bzhin dang ldan la phyogs yongs nas 'thab cing rtsod par byed pa'i tshul spyod yin phyir/ de lta bu'i drag 'thab la drag 'thab ma yin pa'i thabs lam zhig med du mi rung ba yin/ me mtshon gyi du ba med pa'i 'thab sar drag shugs la mi brten pa'i 'khrug rtsod ni/'khrug rtsod kyi rnam pa gtso bo 'ig yin par ma zad/ rgya khyab kyang thin tu che/ des na sun wu'u yis/(1)'tshe bas rgyal phran mgo bo btud/ /ces gsungs pa dang /gzhan yang ca ling gi zhib 'grel bcu gcig ces pa'i nang / de'i thad 'grel bshad zhib gsal byas yod pa de'ang / pha rol 'tshe bar byed pasdo 2sbyabs/ /rnam pa gcig tu ma nges te/ /shes rab can ni bsru ba

dang / /blon po rang gis 'gugs pa'am/ /g.yo 'phrul can ni mngags byas te/ pha rol srid bka' 'khrol bar byed/ /yang na rgyu yis pha rol blon/ /bsru zhing myul mar bkol ba'am/ /bzo bo mkhas pa btang ba las/ /pha rol rgyu nor 'phongs pa dang / 'dod bde'i rol byed 'byin pa las/ /pha rol srol ka 'gyur bar byed/ /yang na mdzes ma'i yo na tan gyis/ /pha rol yid sems 'khrug par byed/ /gal te sgyu thabs 'di rnams kun/ /gsang zhing mngon du mi 'gyur na/ /pha rol 'tshe zhing 'dud par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sgyu thabs de dag phal mo che tshig snyan po dang don bzang po'i tshul gyis pha rol dga' bar byed cing /de ni phyi tshul du byams pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan te/ don dam du gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa zhig yin/ gzhan yang zil shugs dang dpung /dropa / ngastozlo/ /cas la brten nas mngon gsal thog 'jigs snang (2)las kyis rgyal phran bran du bkol/ /zhes 'dir bstan pa'i las zhes pa ni kun slong mi legs pa'am pha rol bsru bar byed pa'i bya thabs shig yin te/ ma'o yi rnam thar ces pa'i nang du yang skabs 'di'i rgya'i skad dod kyi las zhes par las kyang nyen no zhes gsungs pa yod pa dang / zhib 'grel bcu gcig ces pa'i nang du yang / las kyis pha rol rgyal phran dag / bran du bkol na bzod mi bde/ /dper na tan mis (ma'i)ching mi( 'i)la/ /mthud par dka' ba'i sne mo dag / btsan gyis sbyar du 'jug la ltos/ /yang na mtshar ba'i snyi nyusdus

dang / /blon po rang gis 'gugs pa'am/ /g.yo 'phrul can ni mngags byas te/ pha rol srid bka' 'khrol bar byed/ /yang na rgyu yis pha rol blon/ /bsru zhing myul mar bkol ba'am/ /bzo bo mkhas pa btang ba las/ /pha rol rgyu nor 'phongs pa dang / 'dod bde'i rol byed 'byin pa las/ /pha rol srol ka 'gyur bar byed/ /yang na mdzes ma'i yo na tan gyis/ /pha rol yid sems 'khrug par byed/ /gal te sgyu thabs 'di rnams kun/ /gsang zhing mngon du mi 'gyur na/ /pha rol 'tshe zhing 'dud par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sgyu thabs de dag phal mo che tshig snyan po dang don bzang po'i tshul gyis pha rol dga' bar byed cing /de ni phyi tshul du byams pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan te/ don dam du gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa zhig yin/ gzhan yang zil shugs dang dpung /dropa / ngastozlo/ /cas la brten nas mngon gsal thog 'jigs snang (2)las kyis rgyal phran bran du bkol/ /zhes 'dir bstan pa'i las zhes pa ni kun slong mi legs pa'am pha rol bsru bar byed pa'i bya thabs shig yin te/ ma'o yi rnam thar ces pa'i nang du yang skabs 'di'i rgya'i skad dod kyi las zhes par las kyang nyen no zhes gsungs pa yod pa dang / zhib 'grel bcu gcig ces pa'i nang du yang / las kyis pha rol rgyal phran dag / bran du bkol na bzod mi bde/ /dper na tan mis (ma'i)ching mi( 'i)la/ /mthud par dka' ba'i sne mo dag / btsan gyis sbyar du 'jug la ltos/ /yang na mtshar ba'i snyi nyusdus

dang / /g.yems kyi rtsal la brten byas te/ /khongs nas bkur cing 'dud par byed/ /ces gsungs yod pa de dag las kyis rgyal phran bran du bkol ba'i bya thabs red/ don dam du bya thabs de rigs kyis rgyal phran pha rol la phyi tshul thog nas 'dzugs skrun byed rogs dang / ma dngul btang nas slob gso gnyer rogs byed pa/ yul bskor spro 'cham gyi las sgo gnyer rogs byed pa sogs mdor na/ pha rol gyis sgrub dka' ba'am sgrub mi thub pa'i bya ba rnams bsgrubs thog mthar bsru thabs la brten nas pha rol rang thog la 'dud par bya ba'i thabs jus shig yin te/ dper na dbyin jis shang dang thog mar 'dzin skabs/ nga tshos shang rkang la phan pa'i yo rob kyi bzo las gsar brje 'khyer yod zer ba sogs zhi drag zung spyod kyi thabs la brten nas da bar yun ring shang kung dbang sgyur byas pa lta bu'o/ /bya thabs gzhan zhig ni tsha'o tsha'o yis/ gnas su mi bde'i rkyen byin te/ /phas rgol 'dzul na rang sde thon/ /phas rgol thon na rang sde 'dzul/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / wang zhi'i yis/ yang yang skabs su rgol ba yis/ /phas la god chag bzo bar bya/ /zhes bstan yod pa 'di dag tshang ma sa mtshams su 'khrug rkyen yang yang bslangs te/ phas gol ṭ+wāṃ //zlo stobs dang rgyu stobs kyis mi 'khus pa bzo ba'i thabs jus shig ( 2) khe yis rgyal phran bslu zhing brid/ / ces gsungs pa ni/rgyardo 21na re 'gar khe phan phran bu byin te rang rgyal khab la zhabs

'desas zhu ru 'jug pa'i don yang bstan yod/ dengs skabs rgyal lab chen po 'ga' zhig rang dang 'dra ba'i rgyal khab gzhan la rang dgar 'khrug rtsod byed mi phod rung / rgyal spyi'i 'thab 'khrug nang gnya' 'khur mi 'dod pas 'thus tshab dmag 'khrug ces pa 'di byung yo da/'dir bstan pa'i 'thus tshab ces pa ni gna' rabs kyi glas dmag ces pa nas rim 'gyur byung ba zhig yin te/ stobs 'byor che ba'i rgyal lab kyis dngul dang go mtshon 'don pa dang / stobs 'byor zhan pa'i rgyal lab kyis dpung mi btang nas 'thab sar dmag 'thab byas te/stobs 'byor che ba'i rgyal khab la 'bas 'degs zhus nas dngul lam yang na khe phan gzhan dag rag thabs byed pa ra go ba yin/ dper na t+pa ran si'i gsar 'gyur khang gis ro ma nas spel ba'i gnas tshul zhig gi nang 'khod par ga'igs na/ yo rob dpal 'byor thun mong ma lag gi khongs gtogs rgyal khab bcu gnyis kyi rgyal khab so so'i gtso 'dzin dang srid gzhung gi 'go gtsos spyi lo 1990lo'i zla ba 12tshes 14nyin yo thun (mo'i 4)ro ma'i gros tshogs thog de snga'i su'u lan la gzigs skyong thog rin thang a sgor dung phyur bcu kha tsha dgos thug gi rogs skyor du sprod rgyur mos mthun byas yod cing / de'i rgyu mtshan ni khong tsho'i ngos nas bltas na/ kur pa cha'o spru'i bsgyur bcos 'char gzhir dngos yod kyi don snying ldan pa'i ngos 'dzin byed pa dang chabs cig gtso cher kho tsho'i chab srid kyi dmigs yul la bsam blo btang yod pas/de'ang phan pas rgyal phran bslu zhing brid/ /ces pa'i 'thab ju/ 21de

'desas zhu ru 'jug pa'i don yang bstan yod/ dengs skabs rgyal lab chen po 'ga' zhig rang dang 'dra ba'i rgyal khab gzhan la rang dgar 'khrug rtsod byed mi phod rung / rgyal spyi'i 'thab 'khrug nang gnya' 'khur mi 'dod pas 'thus tshab dmag 'khrug ces pa 'di byung yo da/'dir bstan pa'i 'thus tshab ces pa ni gna' rabs kyi glas dmag ces pa nas rim 'gyur byung ba zhig yin te/ stobs 'byor che ba'i rgyal lab kyis dngul dang go mtshon 'don pa dang / stobs 'byor zhan pa'i rgyal lab kyis dpung mi btang nas 'thab sar dmag 'thab byas te/stobs 'byor che ba'i rgyal khab la 'bas 'degs zhus nas dngul lam yang na khe phan gzhan dag rag thabs byed pa ra go ba yin/ dper na t+pa ran si'i gsar 'gyur khang gis ro ma nas spel ba'i gnas tshul zhig gi nang 'khod par ga'igs na/ yo rob dpal 'byor thun mong ma lag gi khongs gtogs rgyal khab bcu gnyis kyi rgyal khab so so'i gtso 'dzin dang srid gzhung gi 'go gtsos spyi lo 1990lo'i zla ba 12tshes 14nyin yo thun (mo'i 4)ro ma'i gros tshogs thog de snga'i su'u lan la gzigs skyong thog rin thang a sgor dung phyur bcu kha tsha dgos thug gi rogs skyor du sprod rgyur mos mthun byas yod cing / de'i rgyu mtshan ni khong tsho'i ngos nas bltas na/ kur pa cha'o spru'i bsgyur bcos 'char gzhir dngos yod kyi don snying ldan pa'i ngos 'dzin byed pa dang chabs cig gtso cher kho tsho'i chab srid kyi dmigs yul la bsam blo btang yod pas/de'ang phan pas rgyal phran bslu zhing brid/ /ces pa'i 'thab ju/ 21de

khong tsho'i skul slong ngo ma de yin pa red/ gong gsal gyi 'thab jus rigs gsum po de dag drag shugs la mi brten pa'i 'khrug rtsod bya thabs thig yin 'ing / de'i nang chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ phyi 'brel/ rig gnas/ 'du shes 'dzin stangs/ tshan rtsal bcas phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi 'thab rtsod tshud yod/ yo rab shar ma'i spyi tshogs ring lugs rgyal khab la 'gyur ba byung ba'i rgyu rkyen ni rang ngos kyis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rtsa don dang 'gal te nor 'khrul shor ba'i nang rkyen yod pa'i khar/ rgyal spyi'i thog gung khron tang la ngo rgol dang spyi tshogs ring lugs la ngo rgol byed mkhan gyis phyogs gang sar me mtshon med pa'i dmag 'khrug ste/ drag shugs la mi brten pa'i 'thab rtsod byed pa'i bya thabs de yang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs rtsa brlags song ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig yin pa smos ci dgos/ dper na a ri'i tsung thung zur pa nyi khe sung gis spyi lo 1991lo'i zla ba drug pa'i tshes gnyis nyin rgyus hreng tun yig gzam chogs par 〉gyi 'go brjod du/ kur pa cha'o spru'i nyams nyen dang a ri'i go skabs zhes pa'i rtsom yig cig spel ba'i nang / mngon sum 'jom med ngang a ri'i 'thab jus thad kyi khe phan gyi 'gag rtsa ni dpal 'byor thog nas mo su kho skyob thabs bya rgyu de ma yin par/ su'u lan gyi gung khran ring lugs kyi lam lugs rtsa brlags sna/dro /// ༵ py-i bu rdi / pas/ de'i thad yid gzab bya dgos zhes 126gsum pa/ dmag 'khrug ni phyogs yongs kyi rang bzhin dang

ldan pa dang rnam pa sna tshogs pa zhig yin stabs/ 'gal rkyen yang yongs khyab tu gnas/ des na 'dir/ de phyir dpung tshogs 'dren pa 'i thabs/ /pha rol 'ongs min mi re bar/ /rang gi sgug gral legs par sgrigs/ phas kyis rgol min mi re bar/ /brlags mi rnyed pa rang gis byed/ / ces gsungs nas rnyog rdzob che ba'i g.yu la 'thab nang /phas rgol gyis rang phyogs la dpung 'jug mi bya na legs sam snyam pa'am yang na dpung 'jug mi bya ba der re ba bcol ba sogs byed mi rung bar/rang gi 'jug pa zab pa'i blo gros dang tshags su tshud pa'i grabs zon la sdu/na dgos/ de ltar byas na rang nyid pham kha shor mi srid pa bstan sun tsi'i phyogs yongs nas rgyal kha len thabs kyi dgongs gzhir go ba len bde ba'i phyir dpe mtshon zhig zhus na/ de'ang sbyi lo 1990lo'i zla ba 8tshes 12nyin a ri'i 〈skabs don chogs par 〉zhes pa'i thog ljar pan gyi rtsom pa po pan than hreng dbyis kyis 'go brjod du ljar pan gyis rigs rgyud ring lugs dang dmag 'khrug gi tsub spyod nges par du khas len dgos zhes pa'i rtsom yig cig spel ba'i nang /lngar pan srid 'dzin tang gi tang yon hri yon kren tha'i lang gis brtsams pa'i 〈ma red ces brjod par phod pa'i ljar pan 〉zhes pa'i deb cig yod 'dug pa der dgag pa rgyab yod pa red/ deb de'i nang dpal 'byor gyi 'phel tshad cung legs pa'i kho ri ya lho ma dang the dban sen por bcas tshang mar 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa mjug ma sdusal

rgong ljar pan gyis dbang sgyur byas yod/ 'on kyang nga tshos rgyal khab de dag la shugs rkyen bzang po bzos yod pa yang khas mi len thabs med yin/ zhes btsan 'dzul de byas rjes la brtsis yod pa dang / gzhan yang deb de'i nang slad phyin gyi gnad 'gag che shos ni lngar pan gyis gang 'dra byas te don snying gang legs ldan pa'i thog nas rang nyid kyi dpal 'byor dang chab srid stobs shugs 'di bzhin/ e shi ya shar lho'i rgyud du chab srid kyi 'thab jus zhib phra zhig bzos thog de dang zung 'brel byed thub pa bya rgyur thug yod/ de ltar byas na lngar pan gyis gling e shi ya'i gong 'phel la rogs skyor byed pa dang chabs cig gling e shi ya dang 'cham mthun mnyam gnas yong ba byed thub ces bshad yod/ de'i thog nas hri yon kren tha'i lang gis gcig nas btsan 'dzul de byas rjes la brtsi ba mtshon pa dang / gnyis nas dpal 'byor gyis rogs skyor byed pa'i thabs lam la brten nas rang rgyal gyis chab srid thog nas tshod 'dzin bya rgyu'i dmigs yul phyir mngon pa'o/ /dpung 'dren nyams byed rgyu lnga ni/ /'chi bar nges pa gsod sla zhing / /gson la nges pa bzung bar sla/ /khyo zhing gtum pa brnyas bde zhing / /tshul spyod gtsang ba dma' 'bebs bde/ /'bangs la byams pa sun par bde/ /128 rnam pa lnga po 'di rnams kun/ /

g.yul du 'dren pa'i gnod byed do/ /dpung tshogs yongs su phungs pa'am/ /dpung 'dren srog dang 'bral ba'i rgyu/ /rnamapalngalasam dasan/ /zhes /zlokā rnyir ma bcus thabs su zad/ /(1)'chi bar nges pa gsod par sla/ /zhes pa ni/ spyir nan sung gi dmag dpon grags can g.yu'i h+phe'i zhes bya bas/ zhi dpon rgyu la mi dga'/ /drag dpon 'chi la mi 'jigs/ /zhes gsungs yod mod/'on kyang 'chi la mi 'jigs zhes pa de ni 'chi bar snang chung gis rang srog gang byung dang / don med du lceb par go mi rung / 'dir 'chi bar nges pa zhes pa ni rang srog la snang chung gis 'chi rgyu mi dran pa'i rang gshis la go dgos/ rang gshis de rigs dang ldan pa phal che ba rnams dpa' stobs che yang blo thabs dman pa dang / kha dbang rang shed che ba/ 'thab lag sprod rgyu kho nar rngams nas dmag 'thab byed khar rang srog snang med du gtong gi yod/ de'i phyir rang gshis de'i rigs ni/phas rgol gyis skabs bstun bkol spyod byed bde ba dang / srog thor god chag gi skyon 'byung sla'o/ /bkod 'doms pa'i ngos nas bshad na blo gros dang blo stobs gnyis ka ldan dgos shing / gcig thad nas 'chi bar mi skrag la/ gnyis thad nas rang srog la snang chung mi byed pa zhig yin dgos/ de ltar byas na dmag 'khrug gi zing cha dang / ༵༵'a

(1 ji tsam che yang sems rna' du phabs nas bkod 'doms byed thub (2)gson la nges pa bzung bar sla/ /zhes pa ni/ gson thabs kho na byed pa'i rang gshis dang ldan pa dag ni gson la zhen zhing /'chi rgyur 'jigs pa zhig yin gshis dka' nyen 'phrad skabs/ pha rol la mgo btud par sla zhes pa'i don dang / 'grel tshul gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ dpung mang la byang sems che drag pas/ dmar 'dzing byed nges pa'i skabs su babs na yang / dpung mang khrag 'don dmar 'dzing byed du 'jug mi phod pa des dmag 'thab la gnod skyon bzo bar go dgos pa'ang yod 'dug gang ltar na yang de gnyis ka gson la zhen pa'i rang gshes las bzos shing / rang gshis de'i rigs kyi bsam pa'i skul slong ngam dmigs yul ji ltar yin yang phas /lha gyis ngos nas bltas na/ tshang ma bslus thing bzung bar sla ba yin (2)khro zhing gtum pa brnyas bde zhing / /zhes pa'ang dmag dpon khro ngar che ba dag gis gnas tshul la dpyad zhib nan po mi bgyi bar gtum drag ngang blo thag bcad de 'os min nges med kyi bya spyod 'dzin zhing / phas rgol gyis dmag dpon gyi rang gshis de rigs la brten nas brnyas bcos byed pa dang / zang zing bzos te bkod 'doms byed phyogs 'khrugs par byas te mthar pham par byed pa'o/ /da~X na rgyal khab gsum gyi gtam rgyud nang kru'u ko li'ang gis kro'u yus

zhes pa ra khong khyo bslangs te kung cin de yi rkyen lam du 'chi ba dang /si ma dbyis la dmar rtsi'i sgyu thabs zhes pa 'don skabs/ si ma dbyis kyis kyang de dang 'dra bar mo chas spud pa dang byugs rdzas byugs nas ya lan ma byas pas/ kru'u ko li'ang khong khros rlung nad phogs pa lta bu tshang ma 'thab ya phyogs gnyis po'i bkod 'doms pa'i rang gshis 'gran pa'i 'khrug thabs shig yin pa red/de'i phyir sun wu'u yis/ rje bo khro zhing gtum pa las/ /dpung stobs 'phel ba bya mi rigs/ /dpung sna/ kā // kālda ༵ zlokhang ra yis/ /g.yul du bkol ba mi rigs so/ /(4)tshul spyod gtsang ba dma' 'bebs bde/ /zhes pa ni tshul spyod gtsang ba'i dmag dpon yin phyin/ dpung sde'i nang ming grags che zhing / de dang phyogs mtshungs rang nyid kyang rim gyis ming grags la dga' ba'i rang gshis dang ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur/ 'on kyang ming grags la ha cang dga' drags na de yang pha rol gyis skabs bstun bkol spyod byed bde po yod/ dper na 'chal gtam bzos te dma' 'bebs dang ming grags la skyon 'dogs pa sogs byed cing / 'di yi sanas skabs su bzod sems med na/ khro sems chen pos dmag 'dren pa dang pha rol gyi g.yo thabs 'og tu tshud srid/ des na tsha'o tsha'o yis/ tshul ldan skye bo dma' bde la/ /dma' ba'i rjes la gcun yang bde/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / li'i chon gyis nga rgyal can ni dma' 'bebs bde zhes gsungs yod/ / 131

zhes pa ra khong khyo bslangs te kung cin de yi rkyen lam du 'chi ba dang /si ma dbyis la dmar rtsi'i sgyu thabs zhes pa 'don skabs/ si ma dbyis kyis kyang de dang 'dra bar mo chas spud pa dang byugs rdzas byugs nas ya lan ma byas pas/ kru'u ko li'ang khong khros rlung nad phogs pa lta bu tshang ma 'thab ya phyogs gnyis po'i bkod 'doms pa'i rang gshis 'gran pa'i 'khrug thabs shig yin pa red/de'i phyir sun wu'u yis/ rje bo khro zhing gtum pa las/ /dpung stobs 'phel ba bya mi rigs/ /dpung sna/ kā // kālda ༵ zlokhang ra yis/ /g.yul du bkol ba mi rigs so/ /(4)tshul spyod gtsang ba dma' 'bebs bde/ /zhes pa ni tshul spyod gtsang ba'i dmag dpon yin phyin/ dpung sde'i nang ming grags che zhing / de dang phyogs mtshungs rang nyid kyang rim gyis ming grags la dga' ba'i rang gshis dang ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur/ 'on kyang ming grags la ha cang dga' drags na de yang pha rol gyis skabs bstun bkol spyod byed bde po yod/ dper na 'chal gtam bzos te dma' 'bebs dang ming grags la skyon 'dogs pa sogs byed cing / 'di yi sanas skabs su bzod sems med na/ khro sems chen pos dmag 'dren pa dang pha rol gyi g.yo thabs 'og tu tshud srid/ des na tsha'o tsha'o yis/ tshul ldan skye bo dma' bde la/ /dma' ba'i rjes la gcun yang bde/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / li'i chon gyis nga rgyal can ni dma' 'bebs bde zhes gsungs yod/ / 131

(5)'bangs la byams pa sun bde'o/ /zhes pa'ang / 'bangs la gces shing byams pa dang dmangs kyi tshe srog dang rgyu nor la gces pa ni bkod 'doms pa'i tshul spyod bzang po zhig yin pa dang / 'bangs mi ser la dgra phyogs kyi btsan gnod mi phogs pa bya rgyu ni dmag mi'i 'gan 'khri zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang krang yus zhes bya bas/ mi ser gces su 'os na yang / /phan gnod gnyis la dpyod par bya/ /zhes ste ma lus skyong ba dang / /nye ring gang la'ang rogs bgyis na/ /'thab ya'i thabs su tshud gyur nas/ /sun zhing ngal bar byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'bangs la gces pa ni dpung sde'i 'gan 'khri yin rung /dmag 'khrug gi skabs su las 'gan gtso bo ni gnas tshul la zhib dpyad gang legs byas te dmag 'thab byed pa dang dgra las rnam par rgyal ba byas te/ 'bangs la srung skyob dang gces skyong byed pa'i dmigs yul sgrub thub pa bya dgos pa las/ mnga' 'bangs gces srung bya phyir 'os min dang thal skyon gyi thog nas dpung stobs gang sar kha bkrams drags na/ phas rgol gyis rdab sig yang yang bzo ba'i g.yo thabs su tshud srid pa shes pa bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ /132

dpung 'jug pa dang bcas pa rnam par bshad pa/dpung tshogs phru ma btabs pa'am/ /yang na lam du chas pa dang / /dgra dang 'phrad pa ci rigs pa/ /ri sa 'grims shing gzhong sar brten/ /nyi phyogs lta bzhin sgang sar 'dug /sgang sa bzung ba'i 'thab zla la/ /gyen du bsgrun par mi rung ba/ /'di ni ri sa'i bkod thabs so/ /chu bo bcad de chu bo dang / /ring ba'i gnas su phru ma thobs /chu nang sgrun zla chu kha ru/ /sgug cing 'thab lag mi sprod par/ /chu phyed nyid du rgol ba legs/ /dgra dang 'thab par 'dod pa na/ / 133

dpung 'jug pa dang bcas pa rnam par bshad pa/dpung tshogs phru ma btabs pa'am/ /yang na lam du chas pa dang / /dgra dang 'phrad pa ci rigs pa/ /ri sa 'grims shing gzhong sar brten/ /nyi phyogs lta bzhin sgang sar 'dug /sgang sa bzung ba'i 'thab zla la/ /gyen du bsgrun par mi rung ba/ /'di ni ri sa'i bkod thabs so/ /chu bo bcad de chu bo dang / /ring ba'i gnas su phru ma thobs /chu nang sgrun zla chu kha ru/ /sgug cing 'thab lag mi sprod par/ /chu phyed nyid du rgol ba legs/ /dgra dang 'thab par 'dod pa na/ / 133

chu khar nye bar 'khrug mi bya/ /steng dang nyi sa bzung ba las/ /chu bo'i rgyun dang ldog mi bya/ /'di ni chu thog bkod thabs so/ /ba tshwa can dang na 'dam du/ /byu ra gyis gshegs la 'dug mi bya/ /ci ste ba tshwa 'dam sa ru/ /'thab lag sbyor ba'i skabs 'byung tshe/ /chu rtswar brten zhing nags su bsnyes/ /'di ni ba tshwa can dang ni/ /na 'dam khul gyi bkod thabs so/ /thang sa snyom sar 'dug pa bde/ /ltag phyogs mtho sar brten pa dang / /ltag mdun mtho dman yod par bya/ /'di ni thang gi bkod thabs so/ /spyi na dpung gi bkod thabs bzhi'i/ /phan yon 'di bzhin gong ma yis/ /mtha' bzhi'i rje las rgyal byed do/ /zhes bstan don gtso bo ni dpung tshogs 'gro ba dang bca' sdod byed pa'am yang na pha rol gyi gnas tshul la rtog zhib byed par nges par du ༵༵la sa'i sa bab la bsam zhib bya dgos pa dang / dmag 'khrug

nang 'thab ya phyogs gnyis ka yis ci nas kyang rang la phan pa'i dge sa 'dzin thabs bya tshul bstan yod/dpung tshogs bca' sdod dang dpung 'jug gam/ yang na dmag 'thab bcas tshang mar sa yi bar cha nges can zhig dgos kyi yod stabs/ rnam bshad 'di'i nang / thog mar sa bab nas 'go brtsams te/ ri sa dang chu klung / 'dam sa/ gzhung thang bcas rang byung gi sa bab mi 'dra ba ba'i dang de ba'in sa bab mi 'dra ba bzhi po bye/ ṭā /rdo /kālda kā/ 'dug byed phyogs dang / bkod sgrig bya thabs (1)ri sar dmag 'thab bya thabs ni/ la rgyab pa dang lung shur 'grims pa'i skabs dgra bo dang 'phrad tshe sngon la skabs thog la phan ṭ+wāṃ dī ṭ+wāṃ shā ༵ rdzu rdo / )gos/ gal te dgra bos mtho sa zin yod na gyen (2)chu thog tu dmag 'thab bya thabs ni/ gtso bo gtsang po dang chu bo rgyug khul la dmag 'thab byed stangs bstan yod/ de'ang spyi'i 'thab stangs ni gal te chu bo sgrol bsams na dpung sde chu'i 'gram du bcar mi rigs/ rgyang ring tsam du bsdad na phas rgol gyis rjes 'den dang 'gog rkyen bzo ba sngon 'gog byed chog par ma zad/ rang gi bsam jus kyang lkog gsang byed thub/ rgyal khab gsum skabs kyi khri pi g.yu la 'gyed ces pa'i nang / wu'u rgyal khab kyi dmag dpon hong ke yis tsha'o tsha'o yi dmag gru mer bsregs te rgyal kha blangs pa'i rdo 3rdon

gtso bo yang / tsha'o tsha'o yis rang gi dmag gru rnams 'bri chu'i 'gram du 'jog pa las chu phran ga'an la ba'ags nas sba gsang byas med pa des yin pa'o/ /gzhan yang dper na 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa 'i skabs su/ rgyal mang dpung sdes no man tir dpung 'jug bya rtsis byed skabs/ dmag gru tshang ma dpung 'jug byed sa dang bar thag cung nye ba'i dbyin ji'i mtsho 'gram gyi shar ngos dang lho ngos gru kha khag la ma gzhag par/ mtsho 'gram gyi nub ngos gru kha khag la gcig sdud byas pa de'i dmigs yul yang / sba gsang bya rgyu dang mkha' thog gi gtor brlag mi 'phog pa bya rgyu de yin pa red/ de bzhin chu bo'i 'gram du dmag 'thab byed skabs dgra dmag chu bor brgal nas 'ong tshe/'phral du phar rgol mi byed pa ra/ dgra dmag chu phyed ka tsam rgal ba'i skabs su phar rgol bya dgos/ de ltar byas na dgra bo'i dpung stobs pa/kā /lha ṭā sbya/ /lha /da pa dang / gnyis nas phyi bshol byed dka' ( 2)chu bo'i smad rgyud du 'thab gral sgrig skabs/ bab dang bstun bde ba'i sa bab mtho sa bzung ste/ phas rgol gyis chu drangs te rang dmag mi brlags pa byed dgos/ 'thab jus kyi thog nas rtog zhib byas na/ gtsang po dang chu bo'i stod rgyud du bsdad pa'i dpung sdes smad rgyud du bsdad pa'i dpung dmag la dmag 'thab byed skabs/chu'i rgyugs phyogs dang rlung bu'i ldang phyogs sogs rang byung mthun rkyen la sturdon nas rgol bde bo yod pa ni chos nyid cig yin mod/ 'on

kyang yongs su rgyal bar nges pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig ma yin/ dper na spyi lo'i sngon gyi 506lor wu'u yon dang sun wu'u yis wu'u rgyal khab kyi dpung sne drangs te khru'u rgyal khab kyi dpung dmag la chu po'i rgyugs phyogs dang ldog ste 'thab lag sprad na yang / mthar rgyal kha thob pa lta bu'i dpe mtshon yang mang po yod pa'o/ /(4)'dam sa'i rgyud du dmag 'thab bya thabs ni/ 'dam sar dgra dang 'phrad tshe 'phral du de nas kha 'bral te rtswa chu dang nags tshal /zlo tu brten nas yib bde ba dang 'dam rdzab nang mi bying ba bya dgos (5) yangs thang ngam bde sar dmag 'thab bya thabs ni/gzhogs ngos sam yang na rgyab phyogs su mtho sa zhig yod pa byas te/gcig nas rgyab brten bde ba dang / gnyis nas rgyang blta byed skabs mthong bde rnying ba bya dgo/ pa sokyisaspra na/ /ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ / / r+shabye /sna /rngo/ sa/ dor/ /nyin sa 'grims shing srib sa g.yol/ /dge sar ༷dug stegashā bar byed/ /༵༵༵ trī ༵༵༵ nā/ tā /sdir+sha bas/ /de'u 'bur la ni gzab zon bgyis/ /nges par de yi nyin sa bzung / / 137

g.yas kyi brten yang de la bcol/ /'di ko dpung gi mthun rkyen te/ /sa yis dpung gnyen bgyis pa'o/ /zhes spyir dpung bca' sdod byed skabs tshang ma mtho sa dang nyin phyogs su sdod rgyur dga' ba las dma' sa dang srib sar sdod rgyur mi dga' ba bstan pa dang / gzhan yang dge sar 'dug ste gso bar byed/ /ces dpung dmag gi dngos rdzas dang rgyags bye rigs 'bel sar bca' sdod byas thog 'tsho sdod kyi mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa bya dgos/ de 'dra byas na dpung mang gi gzugs gzhi bde zhing thang la rims nad sna tshogs byung mi srid/ rims nad med na dpung stobs mi nyams pa dang /de'ang g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba bya rgyur thad kur 'brel ba yod tshul bstan/ 'byung 'gyur gyi dmag 'khrug ni sngar bas gdug tsub che zhing /dug srin phra mo'i phra mo'i mtshan cha yang spyod res byed bzo yod na/dpung sde'i deng rabs kyi sman dang sman bcos mthun rkyen dang dpung mi'i 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gyi cha rkyen gang legs 'dzoms pa bya dgos/de ltar sun lu'u yis dpung mang gi sa bab la brten nas dpung mi'i gzugs bde thang yong ba dang / gzugs gzhi thang ba la brten nas pha rol las rgyal bar byed pa'i 'brel ba gsal por bstan pa 'di ni gal 'gangs shin tu che ba'i don gnad cig yin/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i nang / nub 'i bde rgya mtsho chen po'i thog dmag 'thab byed ma/nā a ri'i dmag mi'i nang 'dar nad phog pa'i dmag mi lnga 'bum lnga

khri zin pa dang / sman khang nang lus pa'i dmag mi'i grangs 'bor de rmas ma las ldab sum cus mang ba yod pa red/ spyi lo 1934lo'i zla ba 12pa ra/ a ri'i dmag dpung gis pu le ten gling tshom gsar pa'i ke la'o si the'i khug zur la dpung 'jug byas shing / sa cha de ni tsha drod che ba'i nags tshal khul yin/ dpung mang rnams kyis bshad srol ltar na/der gnam nas char ba babs na sa la 'dam rdzab kyis khengs pa dang /tsha drod che la gang sar dug 'bu mang ba/ nags gseb tu rul dri dang sems can r+sha ro'i dri yis khengs pa/ 'dar nad byung zhing tsha ba rgyas pa/ rkang par lhags nad phogs pa/ nyin mo dka' dub che la mtshan mo 'jigs skrag che ba/ zhigs pa nas dgong mo'i bar dka' sdug che bas dpung mang 'tsho thabs bral ba'i gnas shig yin par grags/der brten bkod 'doms pas 'thab mo'i 'go ma brtsam gong nges par du 'thab sa'i sa bab thad bsam zhib bya dgos pa dang / 'thab lag dngos spros skabs dpung mang gi bde thang la gnod srid pa'i rkyen 'gog / r+sha sdu sbyal legs par bsgrigs te dpung stobs ma nyams pa bya dgos pa gang zhig grog gzar gyong po dang / /btsan sa rtsi shing rgya dra can/ /'dam sa 'gag 'phrang bcas pa la/ /myur gyis gshesas la brten mi bya/ /rang dmag de las ring du bral/ / 139

phas rgol de la bcar du 'jug /rang dmag de la mdun phyogs shing / /phas rgol de la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /dpung gi lam trī ge/sa rkyen mchis/ /trī /sbya ṭ+wāṃ /kā ṭ+wāṃ /rterdo ༵ dang / /cis kyang so dogs yang yang gyis/ /'di ni myul ma yib pa'i gnas/ /chu stod char pa 'bab pa na/ /chu sdud dbu ba /phyo zhi/ bzhur/ /ṭ+wāṃ dī ༵ sna /shā /kā r+sha da na/ /zhes gsungs te/ grog gzar dang mtha' bzhi btsan pa'i sa gyong po sogs sa bab rigs drug las gang rung dang 'phrad tshe de nas myur du kha 'bral dgos pa dang / shin tu mi legs pa'i sa bab de rigs su phas rgol mtha' la bkar thabs byed pa las/ rang dmag de'i mtha' la mi tshud pa bya dgos zhes bstan/ sun wu'u yis rtsod cing len pa'i rnam bshad nang du'ang / nags ri btsan sa na 'dam sogs/ /mi dpogs dpung sne 'dren mi bya/ /phyogs kyi sne shan mi brten pa/ /de la dge sa dro ba mi 'gyur/ /ces gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang der thu/ sdud pa'o/ /

ga'an yang 'dir/ chu stod char pa 'bab pa na/ /chu smad sbya ba 'phyo zhing bzhur/ /chu yi pha mtha' sgrol 'dod na/ /sbya ba ma zhi bar du sgug /ces bstan yod pa 'di'i thog nas kyang / sun wu'u yis rang byung khams kyi tshul phra rags gang la dpyad zhib zhib phra gnang ba ma zad/phyi rol yul gyi 'pho 'gyur gyi chos nyid khong du chud pa mtshon yod pa'o/ /pas rgol nye zhing 'i ba gang / /'gag sar brten nas 'dug pa yin/ /ring nas bsgrun du 'ong ba gang / /rang sde mdun du 'dren par 'dod/ /'thab ya thang la sgar btab pa/ /rang la phan pa'i yon zhig mchis/ /ljon thing g.yo ba 'jab dmag ste/ /rtswa gseb bkag rgya 'khrul byed do/ / 'dab chags 'drogs te 'phur ba ni/ /gnas der skong dmag yod pa'i rtags/ /ri dgas 'drogs shing bros pa gang / /'thab ya khrems shing 'ong ba'o/ /sa rdul na/ mo bdu snang ma/ngas/'o/dī /kā dī ṭ+wāṃ ji /༷ kāpa —gas cing / /'gebs shing 'phyur ba rkang dmag 'ong / / 141

sa rdul tha thor 'phyur ba gang / /phas rgol bud shing 'thu ba'o/ /sa rdul zhung yang 'dzad med du/ /'phyur ba 'thab ya phru ma 'debs/ /skyung tshig smra bzhin 'thab gra sgrig /'di ni rgol bar 'dod pa dang / /brlang tshig smra bzhin rgol ba'i tshul/ /'dzin pa de ni bshol bar rtags/ /shing rta zur du 'don pa gang / /dpung gi ru gral sgrig pa'o/ /dus ma btabs par zhi 'cham bgyi/ /pho nya mngags pa g.yo sku'o/ /mi 'khor ru yi dpung gral dag /brel gyis sgrig pa 'thab grabs so/ /'thab yas rgol la ma rgol dang / /bshol la ma bshol bslu ba'o/ /skyungs tshig smra bzhin zhi gros su/ /bcar ba 'thab mtshams 'jog par 'dod/ /pha rol ngar zhing 'ong na yang / /don du 'thab lag mi sbyor la/ /142 phyir yang bshol bar mi byed na/ /

de la cis kyang zhib tu dpyod/ /go mtshon 'khar ba'i rten byas te/ /langs nas 'dug pa ltogs pa'o/ /khron chu bcus te rang nyid kyis/ /sngon du 'thung ba skom pa'o/ /khe zhig mchis pa mthong na yang / /len du mi bcar ngal ba'o/ /mtshan mo 'bod sgra mang ba 'di/ /dpung mi 'jigs shing skrag pa'o/ /dgra sde 'khrug cing zing ba ni/ /dpon gyi zil shugs dman pa'o/ /dmag dar zing du g.yo ba gang / /dpung gi ru bstar 'khrugs pa'o/ /dpung 'go khro zhing gtum pa ni/ /rab tu ngal zhing bsun pa'o/ /rta yis 'bru dang dpung mis sha/ /za dang chu snod med pa dang / /sgar du phyir log mi bgyi ba/ /thabs zad 'chi 'dzing byed par 'dod/ /smra ba mi bde gdong gi nyams/ /dmad cing kun dang bgros bgyi ba/ / 143

dmangs kyi gus sems shor ba'o/ /bdag rkyen yang du sbyin pa ni/ /ci bya gtol med gyur pa dang / /chad pa yang du gcod pa ni/ /mthu thabs yongs su 'dzad pa'o/ /dpung 'gyu rang gi dpuzlo mang la/ /shā / /spro bye/ bye / /'o gas/ /zhes gsungs te 'thab ya'i gnas tshul mi 'dra ba kha shas thig rgyas bshad gnang yod pa de'ang dum mtshams dang po'i nang phan tshun 'dzing grabs bgyi ba'i gnas skabs su 'thab ya'i gnas tshul la rtog zhib dang tshod dpag ji ltar bya dgos tshul bstan pa dang / dum mtshams gnyis pa'i nang rang byung gi snang tshul la blta zhib byas te pha rol gyi gnas tshul dpog pa bya rgyu'i thabs bstan pa/ dum mtshams gsum par 'thab ya dang 'brel gtug byed skabs/ pha rol gyi gtam dang bya spyod thog nas phas rgol gyi gnas tshul dpog thabs bya tshul bstan pa/ dum mtshams bzhi par pha rol dpung gi bya spyod kyi mngon tshul re 'ga'i thog nas phas rgol gyi gnas tshul dpog pa bya tshul bstan pa'o/ mdor na phyi yi mngon tshul thog nas phas gol gyis bya spyod gang 'dra zhig bzung grabs yod med dpog pa bya rgyu de yin zhing / mngon tshul thad bden thun gnyis ka yo/ 4sdod cing / der brten pha rol gyi gnas tshul la dbye zhib byed

skabs/ phyi yi mngon tshul kho nar blta mi rung bar/ da dung lta zhib bya thabs sna tshogs bzung thog dmag 'khrug gi rnam pa dang zung 'brel gyis/ phas rgol dmag dpon gyi dmag srid byang tshad dang /rgyun spyod 'thab jus/ sems khams kyi 'char tshul bcas gsal rtogs bya dgos pa ma zad/ shes rtogs byung ba'i pha rol gyi gsang 'phrin la zhib tu dpyad de dgra bo'i gnas tshul ngo ma gsal por dpog thub pa bya dgos pa yin/ gzhan yang gong du bstan pa'i rtsi shing dang ri dwags 'dabs chags la sogs pa'i rang byung gi mngon tshul thog nas phas rgol gyi bya spyod dpog par byed pa'i bya thabs thad deng rabs nas bshad na go mtshon sgrig chas dang lta rtogs yo byad sogs rtser son tshan rtsal la brten gyi yod de/ dper na le tā (r+sā7)dang sgra tshan 'phrul chas (zo )skud med glog rlabs (7lo 7)bcas bed spyad de pha rol gyi gnas tshul skog nyan dang dbye zhib tshod dpag byed kyi yod rung /// / sbya sdor+shasdu /lha de dag rbad de go ma chod pa min pas de'i thad zhib dpung tshogs ji tsam skug pa yis/ /de tsam legs pa ma nges shing / /dpa' dang blo khog kho na la/ /brten nas 'thab lag sbyor mi rigs/ /dpung shed gcig tu 'dums byas te/ /pha rol tshul rnams dpog pa na/ / 145

rang nyid de las rgyal ba'o/ /mno bsam zhib mos ma dpyad cing / /phas rgol snang chung byed pa de/ /nam zhig gzhan gyi dbang du lhungs/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dir bya thabs gsum bstan yod pa de'ang /gcig nas dpung stobs gcig sdud kyis bkol spyod bya dgos pa dang /sanyis nas pha rol gyi gnas tshul la tshod dpag yang dag pa bya dgos pa/gsum nas de lta bu'i las 'gan 'grub thub nges kyi bkod 'doms pa dang dpung dmag bkol spyod byed mkhas po dgos pa bstan pa ma zad/da dung 'dir mno bsam zhib mos ma dpyad cing / phas rgol la snang chung byed pa de/ /nam zhig gzhan gyi dbang du lhungs/ /zhes pha rol gyi gdengs tshod ma lon par snang chung mthong chung byas na mthar rang nyid dgra yi bzung dmag la 'gyur nges yin pa'ang bstan yod/ /dpung mis nye bar ma btud gong / /chad pa gcod pa mi bkur zhing / /mi bkur ba ni bkol bar dka'/ /dpung mis nye bar btud na yang / /dpung khrims dang du mi len pa/ /'di yang bkol du mi rung ngo / /zhi bas skul zhing 'doms pa'am/ /146 yang na drag pos gcig tu 'dums/ /

de ltar bgyis na rgyal bar nges/ /rgyun du khrims gshis nan po yis/ /dmangs la 'doms par byed pa na/ /dmangs kyis brtsi zhing bkur ba'o/ /rgyun du khrims gshis mi nan na/ /'doms kyang dmangs kyis bkur mi srid/ /rgyun du khrims gshes nan pa na/ /dmangs dang yongs su mthun pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / rnam bshad 'di'i nang dpung dmag bkod sgrig bya thabs kyi rtsa don dang / dgra dang kha gtad 'jog pa'i zhib phra'i bya thabs/ de bzhin dpung stobs gcig sdud dang pha rol gyi gnas tshul ji bzhin dpogs pa/ mthar 'thab ya las rgyal bar byed pa bcas kyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas lugs gsum bstan pa ma zad/ mjug tu da dung dpung mang la 'cham mthun dang slob gso gtong rgyu'i dgos pa bstan yod/ dpung sde'i dmag 'thab kyi stobs shugs che ru gtong rgyu de/ dpung dmag 'cham mthun yong ba bya rgyur brten dgos stabs/sun lu'u yis bkod 'doms pas dpung mang dang 'cham mthun bya dgos pa dang / de'ang zhi bas skul zhing 'doms pa'am/ yang na drag pos gcig tu 'dums zhes gzengs bstod dang nyes chad gnyis kha gsal nan drang yong ba bya dgos pa ma zad/ de'i thad dmag dpon rnams kyis rang dpe gzhan ston bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ / 147

sa bab rnam par bshadapa/sa bab la yang 'grol sa dang / /dpyangs gyes sa dos pa'i sa/ /nyen sa ring sa rnam pa drug /rang sde phar la 'gro sla zhing / /phas rgol tshur la 'ong sla ba/ /de la sgrol sa zhes su grags/ /sgrol ba'i sa na thog ma ru/ /steng sa nyin sa bzung bar bya/ /'bru lam chad du med pa na/ /g.yul ngor khe dang ldan pa'o/ /'jug par sla zhing ldog dka' ba/ /de la dpyangs zhes pa'o/ /gal te dpyangs sar pha rol dpung / /148 'thab pa'i grabs dang bral ba la/ /

rgol bar byed pa rgyal ba'o/ /pha rol zon gra ldan pa la/ /rgol na rang nyid pham pa'am/ /ldog par dka' bas mi legs so/ /rang gis rgol na mi mtshams la/ /phas kyis rgol yang mi 'tshams pa/ /'di la gyes pa'i sa zhes grags/ /phan tshun gyes pa'i 'thab sa na/ /dgra yis rang la phan pa'i cha/ /byin yang rang gis len mi bya/ /bshol ba'i tshul gyis phyir gshegs te/ /phas rgol 'phrang sa phyed thon rjes/ /ldog ste rgol ba legs pa'o/ /dog sa snga nas rang gis bzung / /'phrang sgo srung bzhin phas rgol ldog /gal te 'phrang 'gag pha rol gyis/ /sngon la bzung na rgol mi bya/ /gal te yongs su ma bzung na/ /rang gi dpung tshogs 'dren du chog /nyen sa rang gis snga nas bzung / /mtho sa nyin sa gnyis bzung nas/ / 149

pha rol dpung tshogs sgug cing sdod/ /gal te dgra yis snga sor du/ /bzung nas zin na bshol ba las/ /de la gyen du rgol mi bya/ /bar gyis ring du chod pa'i sar/ ༈mthu stobs phan tshun mnyam nyid dang / /'thab cing 'khrug par dka' ba na/ /'thab par rtsom pa mi legs so/ /spyi na don rnam drug po 'di/ /sa yi bab dang bstun thabs te/ /dpung 'go'i 'gan du gyur ba na/ /dpyad par mi bgyi thabs su dben/ /zhes sa bab mi 'dra ba drug bstan pa 'di dag tshang ma dmag 'thab kyi bya spyod dang thad kur 'brel ba yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas byi sna/ /zlo dro//sa pa yin zhing / sa bab de dag so so'i ming 'grel (1)'grol sa zhes pa ni sgang gshong yod rung rgya che zhing btsan 'gag med pas mi rta 'khor gsum gang yang 'gro bde ba dang dpung dmag bskong 'then byed bde ba'i sa bab la go ba yin/ sa bab de rigs la bca' sdod dang dmag 'thab byed tshe/ sngon la sa bab cung mardo 5sdu de bzung nas rgyang lta dang tshod 'dzin byed bde yong ba bya dgos/

pha rol dpung tshogs sgug cing sdod/ /gal te dgra yis snga sor du/ /bzung nas zin na bshol ba las/ /de la gyen du rgol mi bya/ /bar gyis ring du chod pa'i sar/ ༈mthu stobs phan tshun mnyam nyid dang / /'thab cing 'khrug par dka' ba na/ /'thab par rtsom pa mi legs so/ /spyi na don rnam drug po 'di/ /sa yi bab dang bstun thabs te/ /dpung 'go'i 'gan du gyur ba na/ /dpyad par mi bgyi thabs su dben/ /zhes sa bab mi 'dra ba drug bstan pa 'di dag tshang ma dmag 'thab kyi bya spyod dang thad kur 'brel ba yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas byi sna/ /zlo dro//sa pa yin zhing / sa bab de dag so so'i ming 'grel (1)'grol sa zhes pa ni sgang gshong yod rung rgya che zhing btsan 'gag med pas mi rta 'khor gsum gang yang 'gro bde ba dang dpung dmag bskong 'then byed bde ba'i sa bab la go ba yin/ sa bab de rigs la bca' sdod dang dmag 'thab byed tshe/ sngon la sa bab cung mardo 5sdu de bzung nas rgyang lta dang tshod 'dzin byed bde yong ba bya dgos/

gzhan yang phas rgol gyi bskor bcom mi 'phog pa bya phyir/ /nges par du gzhogs ngos dang rgyab phyogs la blta srung gang legs byas te rgyab phyogs kyisnan ༷to/ tshogro sdum sdur /tong thub pa bya dgos/ de ltar byas na dmag (ra/)re sdu ༷ sna ṭ+wāṃ zlo ṅge /sbyi/ra sa bab mi 'dra ba gnyis la go dgos te/ gcig ni 'jug sla yang bshol dka' ba'i thag thung ngu'i lam 'phrang dog po la go ba dang / gzhan zhig ni rang dmag mtho sar bsdad pa dang 'thab ya dma' sar bsdad tshe mar 'bab bde yang yar 'jogs dka' bas bar du thag pas dpyangs pa lta bur lus nyen che ba'i sa bab la go ba'o/ sa bab de rigs su 'thab lag spros skabs/ gal te 'thab ya grabs zon med tshe glo bur du rgol thub pa dang / gal te pha rol grabs zon byas yod tshe/ der rgol na mi legs te/ phyir bshol byed dka'/ 'dir sun wu'u yis dpyangs zhes pa ni skam sa'i thog gi sa bab kho na bstan rung / mtsho thog la dmag 'thab byed skabs/mtsho rlabs 'phel 'grib kyi 'gyur ba la brten nas mtsho thog la yang dpyangs lta bu'i sa bab yod srid/ dper na krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag thang 'thab dmag sde gsum pas spyi lo 1949lo'i zla ba 10par cing mon gling phran du dpung 'jug byed pa'i dmag 'thab nang / mtsho rlabs 'phar chags kyi dus tshod nges gtan ma shes stabs/mtsho rlabs chags pa'i skabs su dpung 'jug byas shing chu yis gru gzings ma 'khyog par sdod pa'i tshe phas rgol gyis spu gzings rtsa ba/sdus

btang / dpung rogs gtong bar gru gzings med pa dang / dpung pa/ga byas zin pa'i dpung sde phyir bshol byed ma thub pa bzos pa lta bu (2)gyes sa zhes pa ni rang dang 'thab ya phyogs gnyis gar srung thub nges kyi 'thab sa yod la/ phyogs gnyis po'i dbar gzhung thang ngam yang na chu bos so sor bar du bcad cing kha gtad du gnas pa'i sa bab zhig yin pa red/ sa bab 'di rigs thog phyogs gang gis sngon du rgol na yang khe bzang thob mi srid/ des na phas rgol gyis rang dmag mdun du 'dren thabs byed skabs/ mdun du thon nas dmag 'thab byed mi rung bar/ de las ldog ste mngon gsal thog phyir bcol byed khul gyis lkog tu 'jab dmag bzhags nas phas rgol —tshur thon du sna/ /lha ṭ+wāṃ rnyi lda sdor+shakā pa/na po zhig zin khom ma byung ba'i skabs su phar (4)dog sa zhes pa ni/ 'gag 'phrang dang gzhong sa'i mdo'am yang na chu bo chen po'i gru kha sogs dpung dmag brgyud dgos nges kyi dog sa yin/ gal te sa cha de rigs rang dmag gis sngon la bzung tshe/'gog srung btsan po byas te dog sa de nan gyis 'dzin dgos pa las/dgra bos tshur rgol bya rgyur go skabs sprod mi dung / de dang phyogs mtshungs rang gi rgyab phyogs kyi 'grim 'grul gzhung lam srung skyob gang nan byas nas 'jug bshol bde po yong ba bya dgos/ gal te 'thab sa de ༵༵ rgol gyis sngon du bzung te 'gog srung nan po byas yod tshe/

der dpung 'jug byed mi rung / gal te phas rgol gyis sngon la bzung yang 'gog srung byas med pa'am nan po byas med pas dpung 'jug gi go /dīsna // batshe bye/da snanas tshul dang bstun nas 'thab sa rtsod len gyi (5)nyen sa zhes pa ni/ nyen kha che la gal 'gangs che ba'i btsan 'gag la zer ste/ 'gag sar dpa' po gcig gis khri phrag bkag ces pa'i 'gag sa lta bu'o/ /gal te sa bab de rigs rang gis sngon la bzung na nges par du mtho sa bzung nas dgra yis tshur rgol bya rgyur sgug nas sdod dgos/ gal te pha rol gyis sngon la bzung na rang dmag de nas kha 'bral dgos pa las phar rgol byed mi rung / /(6)ring sa zhes pa ni/ spyir 'thab ya phyogs gnyis dbar bar thag cung ring la phan tshun gyi dpung stobs 'dra po yod pas dpung shed chod dka' ba la bya zhing / gal te sngon la sus dpung 'jug byas kyang pha rol la ngal med kyis ngal bar rgol ba'i go skabs 'byin srid pas sngon la 'thab pa mi legs/ gal te rang phyogs kyi dpung shed che ba yod na sngon la dpung 'jug byas kyang / pham pa'i nges pa med/ gal / /rngo /zlo gyi dpung shed che ba yod na/ 'thab jus gzhan zhig 'tshol dpung tshogs pham pa'i rgyu drug ni/ /byol dang bag g.yeng lhung ba dang / /khrims dang zing ba nyes pa'o/ / 153

'di rnams thams cad rang bzhin du/ /byung ba'i lan chags ma yin par/ /dpung 'go'i thal skyon nyid du nges/ /dpung shed yongs su mnyam na yang / /gcig gis bcu la rgol ba gang / /'di la byol ba'i rgyu zhes grags/ /dkyus dmag stobs dang ldan na yang / /dpung 'go shin tu gnyon chung ba/ /'di la g.yeng ba'i rgyu zhes grags/ /dpung 'go stobs dang ldan na yang / /dkyus dmag shin tu gnyon chung ba/ /'di la lhung ba'i rgyu zhes grags/ /'go gzhon khro gtum can gyis ni/ /gong la 'khang ras mi bkur zhing / /dgra dang 'phrad na rang dgar 'thab/ /dpung 'go rgan pas gzhon pa yi/ /mthu stobs ji yod mi dpog pa/ /'di la khrims pa'i rgyu zhes bya/ /dpung 'go gnyon chung mi nan la/ /'doms pa'i don rtsa mi gsal bas/ /154 'go gzhon dkyus dmag dang bcas par/ /

'di rnams thams cad rang bzhin du/ /byung ba'i lan chags ma yin par/ /dpung 'go'i thal skyon nyid du nges/ /dpung shed yongs su mnyam na yang / /gcig gis bcu la rgol ba gang / /'di la byol ba'i rgyu zhes grags/ /dkyus dmag stobs dang ldan na yang / /dpung 'go shin tu gnyon chung ba/ /'di la g.yeng ba'i rgyu zhes grags/ /dpung 'go stobs dang ldan na yang / /dkyus dmag shin tu gnyon chung ba/ /'di la lhung ba'i rgyu zhes grags/ /'go gzhon khro gtum can gyis ni/ /gong la 'khang ras mi bkur zhing / /dgra dang 'phrad na rang dgar 'thab/ /dpung 'go rgan pas gzhon pa yi/ /mthu stobs ji yod mi dpog pa/ /'di la khrims pa'i rgyu zhes bya/ /dpung 'go gnyon chung mi nan la/ /'doms pa'i don rtsa mi gsal bas/ /154 'go gzhon dkyus dmag dang bcas par/ /

srung bya'i rgyun srol ma mchis par/ /ru dpung 'khrug cing zing nge ba/ /'di la zing ba'i rgyu zhes grags/ /dpung 'gos 'thab ya ma dpog par/ /nyung bas mang bar rgol ba'am/ /zhan pas drag por rgol ba dang / /dpung stobs hrag sdud mi bgyi ba/ /'di la nyes pa'i rgyu zhes bya/ /spyi na don rnams drug po 'di/ /pham pa'i rgyu'am rkyen yin zhing / /dpog pa dpung 'go'i 'gan yin na/ /dpyad par mi bgyid thabs med lags/ / zhes gsungs te/ thog mar pham pa'i rgyu drug bstan zhing / rgyu drug po de dag kyang rang byung gi gnod byed ma yin par sbyar byung gi gnod byed de/ dmag dpon gyi nor 'dzol du nges pa bstan yod/gzhan yang rang dmag pham pa'i rgyu rkyen gzhan zhig ni dpung mang gi byang tshad dman pa 'dir thug cing / 'di ni dpung mi bkol spyod dang gso sbyong do dam sogs kyi las ka gang zab ma bgyi ba'i skyon lan du nges/ /'dir pham pa'i rgyu drug so so nas tshig 'grel tsam zhus na/ /(1)'dir byol ba zhes pa ni bros pa dang kha 'thor ba'i don yin te/ dpung mang gi grangs tshad dang spus tshad sogs 'thab ya da| 51dra

mtshungs yi na na yang / 'thab lag spros skabs/ bkod 'doms pas 'byed sdud kyi thabs jus 'dzin ma shes par rang dmag gcig gi stobs shugs kyis dgra dmag bcu'i stobs shugs la kha gtad stabs/rang dmag stobs shugs zhan pa'i snang tshul 'char pas rang shugs su pham te dpung mang rnams bros pa dang kha 'thor ba'i don yin pa'o/ /(2)bag g.yeng ba zhes pa ni 'dir g.yeng ba dang le lo sgyid lug sogs kyi don la go dgos te/ de'ang dpung mang gi byang tshad yag po yod pa dang / dmag 'thab kyi nus stobs chen po yod na yang /bkod 'doms par 'jon thang med cing / blo khog chen pos do dam byed mi nus pas sgrig khrims lhod yangs su gyur pa'am shin tu lhug pa dang / 'thab sa'i thog bkod 'doms byed mi mkhas pa dang gnyod chung nus med yin par go dgos so/ /(2)lhung ba zhes pa ni/ dgra yi dbang du lhung ba la bya ste/bkod 'doms pa'i byang tshad yag pa dang / 'jon thang che yang /dpung mang gi byang tshad zhan pa dang / dmag srid kyi sbyong brdar bya rgyu mi 'dang ba/ dmag 'thab kyi nus stobs dman pas/ dmag 'thab nang bkod 'doms pas sne khrid de gdong du mchongs na yang /dpung mang rjes su lus nas bkod 'doms pa rkyen lam du song ba dang sgrags dpung sde yang pham nyes su shor bar go dgos pa'o/ /(4)khrems pa zhes pa ni kha 'thor ba'i don te/ dpung 'go da~X su 'dren rwalan gyis gong rim gyi 'go dpon la 'khang ra byed pa

dang yid mi rangs par/ dgra bo dang 'phrad skabs 'khang ra dang bcas te rang mtshams kyis dmag 'thab byed pa dang / mthar kha lo bsgyur mi thub par kha 'thor du 'gro nges pa 'i don yin pa 'o/ /(5)zing ba zhes pa ni sgrig khrims dang sgrig lam med par zang zing du gyur ba'i don yin te/ dmag dpon 'jon thang chung zhing bkod 'doms thad drang nan dang byed phyogs kha gsal med pa/ dus rgyun nas dpung dmag la slob gso dang sbyong brdar byed rgyu mi 'dang ba bcas kyi khar/ dmag 'thab dngos su byed skabs chod sems nges gtan zhig med stabs/ dpung sno 'dren mkhan dang dpung mang gis rgyun gtan gyi 'thab jus dang 'char gzhir gzhigs te dmag 'thab byed thabs bral ba/ gzhan yang 'thab ya'i gnas tshul dngos dang sa bab ma rtogs par/ gang sar mchongs su bcug ste 'thab stangs la /sdu rnyi /shā sbya/sa med pa dang / ru gral zang zing du gyur na mthar (6)nyes pa ni pham nyes la go ba ste/ dmag dpon gyis phyi rol yul gyi gnas tshul dang bstun nas phas rgol gyi gnas bab dpog thabs mi bya bar/ dpung dmag nyung bas mang bar 'thab lag sprod pa dang /stobs zhan pas che bar 'thab lag sprod pa/ de bzhin bkod 'doms pa gso skyong mi byed pa dang / gtso shugs dpung sde hrag sdud mi byed par brten/ dgos nges dang 'gag rtsa'i skabs su las 'gan sgrub mi thub par mthar pham kha shor te bros byol byed rgyu khel bar go da~Xs

pa'o/ / dge sa rang gis bzung ba ni/ /'thab la phan pa'i dpung gnyen yin/ /pha rol dpog cing rgyal thabs 'don/ /bde nyen nye ring legs dpyod pa/ /dpung 'go'i 'gan du gyur ba'o/ /de dag shes shing dpung 'dren pa/ /rnam par rgyal bar nges pa dang / /de dag mi shes dpung 'dren pa/ /pham pa nyid du nges pa'o/ /de phyir 'thab mo'i chos nyid las/ /thob pa'i nges pa rnyed gyur tshe/ /rgyal rjes ma 'thab brjod na yang / /dpung 'gos nges par 'thab kyang chog /thob pa'i nges pa ma mchis tshe/ /rgyal rjes 'thab ces brjod na yang / /dpung 'gos ma 'thab chog pa'o/ /'jug pa ming don ma yin la/ /bshol ba nyes g.yol ma yin par/ /'bangs kyi phan bde srung ba dang / /158 rgyal rje'i khe dang mthun bgyi ba/ /

zhes zlo/ /ra kha ṭā /ba spyi ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ sdo/ nā/sa /rgyal bar byed par phan pa'i mthun rkyen tsam yin pa las rgyu rkyen gtso bo ma yin pa bstan pa ni shin tu bden te/ dper na/ cang ce hri dmag dpung gis spyi lo 1947lor bcings 'grol sa khul gtso bor dmigs te dpung 'jug byed skabs/hran tung du dmag mi bzhi 'bum gcig sdud byas pa dang / hran zhi'i byang rgyud du dpung mang nyis 'bum 'dus te/ krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag rma chu'i 'bab phyogs kyis chags pa'i 57 sa dbyibs kyi nang du mtha' bkag btang nas rtsa brlags gtong rtsis byas/de'i sa bab ni mgo mjug gnyis btsan pa dang / dkyil du gu yangs pas/ rma chu'i rong shur btsan pa yis/ /'bum phrag bzhi yi dpung tshogs bkags/ /zhes grags/ 'on kyang bcings 'grol dmag thang 'thab dpung sde gnyis pa'i dpung shugs gtso bo'i gzhung sgrig ru khag bzhis spyi zla 6tshes 30nyin rma chu'i btsan 'gag de brgal thengs gcig ༵ trī sdidī thub pa byung bas rma chus dpung chen po zhig gi nus pa thon med shādir pha rol dpog cing rgyal thabs 'don/ /bde nyen nye ring legs dpyod pa/ /zhes pa ni/ rang dang gzhan gyi gnas tshul dang /sa bab/ gnam gshis bcas phyogs ci thad la zhib 'jug dang /phan gnod dang thob shor gang yod dbye zhib byas rjes/ gzhi nas bya spyod gang 'dra bzung rgyu'i thag gcod dgos pa bstan yod/ / 159

sbyi lo 1942lo'i zla ba 2par/ 'i bde rgya mtsho chen po'i dmas 'khrug nang / a ri'i dmag dpung gis ljar pan gyi mtsho dmag dmas gru ru khag gcig pu le tī gling phran gsar pa nas phi si ma'i mtsho brgyud/ku'i ne ya gsar pa'i phyogs su dpung 'jug bya rtsis yod pa shes rtogs byung rjes/ a ri'i lho zhi bde rgya mtsho chen po'i mkha' dmag gi dmag spyi khen nyis bka' ltar lngar pan gyi dmag gru bkag 'gog byas/skabs der/ mkha' thog gi myul zhib dpung sde btang nas ljar pan gyi dmag gru gang mgyogs su rnyed pa byas thog dmag 'thab kyi dus tshod nar 'gyangs gtong thabs bya rgyu ni gal 'gangs che zhing / der brten a ri'i dpung dmag gis pu le twe gling phran gsar pa nas ku'i ni ya gsar pa'i bar lho byang gi lam gnyis yod pa de'i bar thag nyin gsum gyi lam thag yin pa dang / de bzhin nyin gsum gyi gnam gshes sngon brdar bltas na/ byang ngos kyi gru lam rgyud du gnam 'thibs pa'am char pa 'bab rgyu dang / lho ngos kyi gru lam rgyud du gnam dngas rgyu yin pa bcas la gzhigs nas/ gsham gsal gyi 'thab jus bton ste/ /dang po gal te ljar pan gyi dmag gru gru lam byang ma nas bskyod tshe/(1)mkha' thog 'tshol zhib dpung sde'i gtso bo gru lam byang mar bkod sgrig byas na/ spyir gnam gathis yag po med pas de tsam gsal po ma mthong yang / 'tshol zhib dpung sde gcig sdud btsal 'tshol byas na/nyin gcig gi nang lngar pan gyi dmag gru ru khag rnyed thub pa dang /da/sdu 'thab kyi dus tshod nyin gnyis yod pa red/ /

(2)mkha' thog gi 'tshol zhib dpung sde gtso bo gru lam lho mar bkod sgrig byas na/ gru lam byang mar myul zhib byed mkhan gnam spu nyung shas las med pas/ 'tshol zhib nyin gnyis byas na ma gtogs // sna/ / ༵༵py-i dgru pa rnye/da mi thub stabs/ dmag 'thab kyi dus tshod gnyis pa/ gal te lngar pan gyi dmag gru ru khag gru lam lho ma nas skyod tshe/ (2)mkha' thog gi 'tshol zhib dpung sde gtso bo gru lam byang mar bkod sgrig byas na/ gru lam lho mar myul zhib gnam gru nyung shas las gtong mi thub rung / gru lam lho mar gnam gshis dwangs bas nyin gcig gi nang ljar pan gyi dmag gru rnyed thub pa dang / dmag 'thab kyi dus tshod nyin gnyis yod pa red/ /(4)mkha' thog 'tshol zhib dpung sde gtso bo thu lam lho mar bkod sgrig byas na/ ljar pan gyi dmag gru mgyogs por rnyed bzo yod pa dang / dmag 'thab kyi dus tshod nyin gsum yod pa red/ /gong gsal gyi gnas tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi'i nang nas/ a ri'i dmag dpung gi ngos nas bshad na bzhi pa de mtshams shos yin zhing /lngar pan gyi dmag gru'i ngos nas bshad na/ gnam gshis 'thibs pa dang char pa bab tshe a ri'i myul zhib gnam grus mthong dka' bas/ gru lam byang ma nas skyod na cung yag po yod pa red/ der brten dmag dpon khen nyis mthar mkha' thog 'tshol zhib dpung sde gtso bo de gru lam byang mar bkod sgrig byas shing / lngar pan gyi dmag gru yang khe/ ༵ yi

(2)mkha' thog gi 'tshol zhib dpung sde gtso bo gru lam lho mar bkod sgrig byas na/ gru lam byang mar myul zhib byed mkhan gnam spu nyung shas las med pas/ 'tshol zhib nyin gnyis byas na ma gtogs // sna/ / ༵༵py-i dgru pa rnye/da mi thub stabs/ dmag 'thab kyi dus tshod gnyis pa/ gal te lngar pan gyi dmag gru ru khag gru lam lho ma nas skyod tshe/ (2)mkha' thog gi 'tshol zhib dpung sde gtso bo gru lam byang mar bkod sgrig byas na/ gru lam lho mar myul zhib gnam gru nyung shas las gtong mi thub rung / gru lam lho mar gnam gshis dwangs bas nyin gcig gi nang ljar pan gyi dmag gru rnyed thub pa dang / dmag 'thab kyi dus tshod nyin gnyis yod pa red/ /(4)mkha' thog 'tshol zhib dpung sde gtso bo thu lam lho mar bkod sgrig byas na/ ljar pan gyi dmag gru mgyogs por rnyed bzo yod pa dang / dmag 'thab kyi dus tshod nyin gsum yod pa red/ /gong gsal gyi gnas tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi'i nang nas/ a ri'i dmag dpung gi ngos nas bshad na bzhi pa de mtshams shos yin zhing /lngar pan gyi dmag gru'i ngos nas bshad na/ gnam gshis 'thibs pa dang char pa bab tshe a ri'i myul zhib gnam grus mthong dka' bas/ gru lam byang ma nas skyod na cung yag po yod pa red/ der brten dmag dpon khen nyis mthar mkha' thog 'tshol zhib dpung sde gtso bo de gru lam byang mar bkod sgrig byas shing / lngar pan gyi dmag gru yang khe/ ༵ yi

sngon dpag ltar gru lam byang ma nas skyod stabs a ri'i dmag dpung gis sngon gtan 'khel ba'i 'thab sa'i thog 'thab res drag po thug pa red/dpe mtshon des gnad don gnyis gsal bshad thub pa ste/ gcig ni nges par du 'thab jus kyi rtog zhib gang zab byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog dmag 'thab kyi jus gzhi phan tshun bsdur ba byed dgos pa dang /gnyis ni gnas tshul tshod dpag byed skabs so so'i khe phan dang mtshams pa'i gnas tshul kho nar brten nas bya spyod 'dzin mi rung / rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ dgra bo yang bsam blo gtong thub mkhan zhig yin pas cis nas kyang rang gi khe phan dang bstun nas bya spyod 'dzin gyis yod pa'i phyir des na nga tshos dgra bo'i gnas tshul dpog pa byed skabs/dgra yi phyogs su bsdad nas dgra yi gnas tshul dpogs thabs bya dgos pa'o/ de ltar a ri'i dmag dpung gis nyin gsum gyi dmag 'thab dus tshod brtson len ma byas par/ nyin gnyis kyi dmag 'thab dus tshod 'gan len byas pa de'i thog nas dgra bo'i gnas tshul la tshod dpag ha cang 'tshams po zhig byas pa mtshon pa'o/ /dpung mang byis pa ji bzhin skyong / /g.yang gzar mnyam du 'bab pa'o/ /dpung mang rang gi bu bzhin gces/ /'chi lam zung du 'grims pa'o/ /ji ltar dge bar bskyangs na yang / /162 de ltar bkol du mi rung zhing / /

rdo ltar byams spyang gces na yang / /bye ༈ // sna/na slong ṭ+wāṃ /ku/ra/ ba/ /༷// zlo zloshā spya kā kā/rdo phug ste/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di'i thog nas dmag dpon gyis dmag dmangs la gces skyong byed pa gang zhig gces langs ma shor ba bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ lo rgyus thog srol lugs mi 'dra ba'i rgyal khab gang 'dra zhig yin rung / tshang mas bya thabs de ni dpung mang dang 'cham mthun dang dpung mang la 'go khrid byed pa'i bya thabs gal chen zhig tu 'dzin gyi yod cing / rtsa ba'i re ba ni dpon dmag gcig mthun dang /skyid sdug mnyam myong bya dgos pa dang / dmag dpon gyis dpe ston gyi nus pa thon pa bya dgos pa yin/ gna' rabs kyi legs bshad nang / /dpung gi khron chu ma don bar/ /dmag dpon skom skad skyon mi rung / dpung gi me thab ma grubs bar/ /dmag dpon ltogs skad skyon mi rung / /dpung gi gur khang ma 'phubs bar/ /dmag dpon snga na gzim mi rung / /zhes pa ltar/ dmag mang la sems khur dang gces skyong bya rgyu ni dpung sde 'cham mthun yong ba'i bya thabs 'gangs chen zhig dang dpung 'gro'i tshul spyod bzang min gyi mtshan rtags sheg yin pa'o/ /rang sdes rgol rung rtogs pa las /gzhan sdes rgol du mi rung ba/ / 163

mi rtogs pa ni rgyal ba phyed/ /ga'an sdes rgol rung rtogs pa las/ /rang sdes rgol du mi rung ba/ /mi rtogs pa yang rgyal ba phyed/ /gzhan sdes tshur la rgol rung la/ /rang sdes phar la'ang rgol rung ba/ /rtogs kyang sa yi bab kyis ni/ /'thab tu mi rung mi rtogs pa/ /de yang rgyal ba phyed shas tsam/ /dpung tshogs 'degs par mkhas dag gis/ /'jug pa'i cha la the mi tshom/ /thabs kyi 'phrul la thog pa med/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka dpog pa na/ /rgyal ba'i cha la ngal ba med/ /yul dus ji bzhin dpogs pa na/ /rgyal bar nges zhes yongs su grags/ /zhes gsungs zhing / 'dir gtso bo pha rol las rgyal bar byed par nges par du rang gzhan dang yul dus sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi gnas tshul phra rag shes pa bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ deng rabs kyi dmag 'khrug nang / dper na cha 'phrin smra ba dang / tshod 'dzin smra ba/164rgyud rim smra ba zer ba sogs dang / de bzhin tshad mtho'i rang

mi rtogs pa ni rgyal ba phyed/ /ga'an sdes rgol rung rtogs pa las/ /rang sdes rgol du mi rung ba/ /mi rtogs pa yang rgyal ba phyed/ /gzhan sdes tshur la rgol rung la/ /rang sdes phar la'ang rgol rung ba/ /rtogs kyang sa yi bab kyis ni/ /'thab tu mi rung mi rtogs pa/ /de yang rgyal ba phyed shas tsam/ /dpung tshogs 'degs par mkhas dag gis/ /'jug pa'i cha la the mi tshom/ /thabs kyi 'phrul la thog pa med/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka dpog pa na/ /rgyal ba'i cha la ngal ba med/ /yul dus ji bzhin dpogs pa na/ /rgyal bar nges zhes yongs su grags/ /zhes gsungs zhing / 'dir gtso bo pha rol las rgyal bar byed par nges par du rang gzhan dang yul dus sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi gnas tshul phra rag shes pa bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ deng rabs kyi dmag 'khrug nang / dper na cha 'phrin smra ba dang / tshod 'dzin smra ba/164rgyud rim smra ba zer ba sogs dang / de bzhin tshad mtho'i rang

sgul can sogs gnas tshul shes rtogs bya thabs sna tshogs pa gong 'phel byung nas yod stabs/ 'thab ya phan tshun gyi sanas bab dang/'thab jus/ srid don dpal 'byor/ tshan rtsal sogs dang bcas pa'i spyi'i stobs shugs dang / de bzhin rgyal spyi'i 'brel ba dang gnam gshis/ sa khams/ mtsho thog gnas tshul bcas tshang ma 'dzam gling yongs kyi cha 'phrin thog nas shes thub par ma zad/ glog rdul lag rtsal gyis dmag 'thab jus gzhi dang 'char 'god sna tshogs dpe ris thog mthong ba lag rtser pon pa bzhin bkod kyi yod pa 'di ni dpung ji bkod 'doms pas gnas tshul phra rags 'thus tshang dang gting mtha' lon pa/ yang dag pa/ dus thog bcas kyi sgo nas shes bas bya rgyu'i mthun rkyen dpe med cig yin pa red/ des na bkod 'doms par deng rabs kyi tshan rig shes bya dang / skabs 'phral du 'pho 'gyur 'gro tāX sdu/ kā shārdo /sna /zlo 'oche rigs mtha' thag gcod thub pa'i 'jon 165

sa dgurnam par bshad pa/spyir na 'thab mo'i 'thab sa ru/ /khrems sa rtsod sa ldog sla'i sa/ /bsnol sa 'brel sa ldog dka'i sa/ /dka' sa bskor sa 'chi sa'o /rgyal phran rang gi mnga' sa ru/ /'thab ra sprod la khrems sa zhes/ /rang gis bzung na khe mchis la/ /phas kyis bzung yang khe ldan pa/ /de la rtsod sa zhes pa'o/ /gzhan sar 'jug cing mi zab pa/ /de la ldog sla'i sa zhes bya/ /rang sde gshegs su chog pa dang / /pha rol 'ong du chog pa la/ /166 bsnol ba'i sa zhes zer ba'o/ /

rgyal phran gsum gyi sa 'brel zhing / /sngon du gshegs na gnam 'og gi /ra mda' sbon par bde ba la/ /de la 'brel ba'i sa zhes bya'o/ /dgra yi yul du bsdad drag cing / /grong mang rgyab tu chod pa la/ /ldog dka'i sa zhes bya ba'o/ /ri nags 'gag 'phrang na 'dam sogs/ /bgrod par dka' la dka' sa zhes/ /shul lam dog cing ldog thag ring / /'thab ya nyung yang rang sde la/ /rgol bar bde ba'i gnas dag la/ /bskor ba'i sa zhes bya ba'o/ /myur gyis 'thab na gson pa dang / /ma 'thab rang sar 'chi ba la/ /'chi ba'i sa zhes bya ba'o/ /de phyir khrems sar 'thab mi bde/ /ldog sla'i sa ru sdod mi bya/ /rtson sar rgol du mi rung la/ /bsnol sar bar du gcod mi bya/ /'brel sar mthun zhing 'grogs pa dang / / 167

rgyal phran gsum gyi sa 'brel zhing / /sngon du gshegs na gnam 'og gi /ra mda' sbon par bde ba la/ /de la 'brel ba'i sa zhes bya'o/ /dgra yi yul du bsdad drag cing / /grong mang rgyab tu chod pa la/ /ldog dka'i sa zhes bya ba'o/ /ri nags 'gag 'phrang na 'dam sogs/ /bgrod par dka' la dka' sa zhes/ /shul lam dog cing ldog thag ring / /'thab ya nyung yang rang sde la/ /rgol bar bde ba'i gnas dag la/ /bskor ba'i sa zhes bya ba'o/ /myur gyis 'thab na gson pa dang / /ma 'thab rang sar 'chi ba la/ /'chi ba'i sa zhes bya ba'o/ /de phyir khrems sar 'thab mi bde/ /ldog sla'i sa ru sdod mi bya/ /rtson sar rgol du mi rung la/ /bsnol sar bar du gcod mi bya/ /'brel sar mthun zhing 'grogs pa dang / / 167

ldog dka'i sa ru 'phrog cing bcoms/ /dka' ba'i sa na mur gyis 'dengs/ /bsdir ba'i sa na sbya thabasna 'don/ /sdo bye trī dī kāshā kā /kā kātā par bya/ /dpung mang bsam sems sgril bar byed/ /ldog sla'i sa ru 'brel zhing mthud/ /rtsod sar dpung gi rgyab nas 'ded/ /bsnol sar nan gyis srung bar byed/ /ldog dka'i sa ru bza' bca' dag /'dzad pa'am chad pa med par byed/ /dka' sar myur gyis gshegs pa dang / /bskor sar bros lam 'gog par byed/ /'chi sar mi gson 'thab lag sbyor/ /dpung mi'i sems kyi rang gshis ni/ /dgra yis bskor na 'gog pa dang / /thabs su zad na 'chi yang 'thab/ /nyen du lhungs tshe ngang gis bkur/ /ces sun wu'u yis mi rnams kyi khor yug mi 'dra ba las byung ba'i sems khams mi 'dra bar zhib tu dpyad pa'i khar/ gnas bab mi 'dra ba sdu/ dang der dmigs pa'i 'thab jus mi 'dra ba dgu dpe mtshon du

ston yod rung / don dam du rgya skad du grangs dgu zhes par mang po'i // ༵༵ ༵ k+ṇi ṭ+wāṃ /ga la //ga 'khrug gi gnas bab dang sa bab mi 'dra ba dmag 'khrug gi chos nyid dgu po de rigs mig snga'i char yang mkho don gal chen ldan mus yin pa/ dper na spyi lo 1939lo'i zla ba 9par 'jar man h+pha shi sis 'thab jus de rigs la brten nas pho lan gyi mnga' khongs yongs rdzogs btsan bzung byas pa dang / gzhan yang spyi lo 1941lo'i zla ba 6tshes 22nyin 'jar man gyis de snga'i su'u lan la dpung 'jug byed 'go brtsams shing / spyi zla 1tshes 9nyin la slebs skabs/ su'u lan gyi sa khongs su thad kur bar thag spyi le 300—600bar dpung 'jug byas pa de'i thog nas ldog sla'i sa ru sdod mi bya zhes pa'i 'thab jus bzung yod pa mtshon gyi yod/ 'dir tshig 'grel kha shas zhus na/ ldog sla'i sa ru 'brel zhing mthud/ /ces pa ni rgyal khams gzhan gyi sa khongs su gang tsam 'dzul zin na rgyab phyogs kyi 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren lam bu bar mtshams mi chad par 'brel mthud thub pa byapa te/ ru/ba sdigs hā kha gsab dang rogs snon stabs bde yong ba bya da sa /lha ra sa/ bye nā sna bye/ tha/ bas 'don/ /zhes pa ni rang dmag phas rgol gyis mtha' bskor ba na sgyu thabs la brten nas sems brtul ba'i 'thab jus bzung thog pas rgol kha bral dang thor gzhig tu gtong thabs byed pa dang / bsru thabs kyis phas rgol 'thab nas kha 'bral du sturtag

ston yod rung / don dam du rgya skad du grangs dgu zhes par mang po'i // ༵༵ ༵ k+ṇi ṭ+wāṃ /ga la //ga 'khrug gi gnas bab dang sa bab mi 'dra ba dmag 'khrug gi chos nyid dgu po de rigs mig snga'i char yang mkho don gal chen ldan mus yin pa/ dper na spyi lo 1939lo'i zla ba 9par 'jar man h+pha shi sis 'thab jus de rigs la brten nas pho lan gyi mnga' khongs yongs rdzogs btsan bzung byas pa dang / gzhan yang spyi lo 1941lo'i zla ba 6tshes 22nyin 'jar man gyis de snga'i su'u lan la dpung 'jug byed 'go brtsams shing / spyi zla 1tshes 9nyin la slebs skabs/ su'u lan gyi sa khongs su thad kur bar thag spyi le 300—600bar dpung 'jug byas pa de'i thog nas ldog sla'i sa ru sdod mi bya zhes pa'i 'thab jus bzung yod pa mtshon gyi yod/ 'dir tshig 'grel kha shas zhus na/ ldog sla'i sa ru 'brel zhing mthud/ /ces pa ni rgyal khams gzhan gyi sa khongs su gang tsam 'dzul zin na rgyab phyogs kyi 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren lam bu bar mtshams mi chad par 'brel mthud thub pa byapa te/ ru/ba sdigs hā kha gsab dang rogs snon stabs bde yong ba bya da sa /lha ra sa/ bye nā sna bye/ tha/ bas 'don/ /zhes pa ni rang dmag phas rgol gyis mtha' bskor ba na sgyu thabs la brten nas sems brtul ba'i 'thab jus bzung thog pas rgol kha bral dang thor gzhig tu gtong thabs byed pa dang / bsru thabs kyis phas rgol 'thab nas kha 'bral du sturtag

ste/ de rjes rtsa brlags gtong dgos pa'i don yin/ de bzhin snol sa ni phyogs gang sar lam yod pa'i 'thab sar go ba dang 'brel sa ni phyogs gang sar 'go lam yod pa dang rgyal khab kha shas khyim mtshes sam nye 'brel du gnas pa'i sa cha la go ba'o/ /dpung tshogs 'dren par mkhas dag gis/ /'thab ya snga phyi mthun mi thub/ /mang nyung ra zla spron mi bya/ /dpon dmag phan tshun skyob mi thub/ /gong 'og phan tshun 'du mi thub/ /dpung mang khrems shing zlums mi thub/ /khe dang mthun na 'thab pa dang / /mi mthun rang sor 'jog pa'o/ /phas rgol dpung gi bstar bsgrigs nas/ /rgol du 'ong ba'i skabs 'byung tshe/ /ji ltar bya zhes 'dri ba na/ /thog mar dgra yi gces sa bcoms/ /zhes pa lan du 'debs par byed/ /'thab mo'i tshul ni myur ba gtso/ /mi khoms stabs dang bstun pa dang / /snang med lam du gshegs nas kyang / /170 bon med gnas su rgol bar bya/ /

zhes gsungs pa'i don phal mo che go sla zhing / 'dir bstan pa'i thog mar dgra yi gces sa bcoms zhes pa ni gna' rabs su dmag 'khrug byung skabs dgra yi dmag dpon gyi nang mi spun mchen btsan khrid byas te mi gtar nyar srol yod pa der go dgos mod/ 'on kyang bya thabs de kho nar ma nges te/ dper na u ru su'i dmag dpon khu thu tso'u rgyus na pho lun dpung dmag gi 'bru lam bkag rjes/ na pho lun gyi dpung dmag rang 'gul ngang mo si kho nas phyir 'then mi byed thabs med byung ba ltar pha rol gyi 'gag gnas bzung nas 'thung chu dang 'bro lam bkags te/ phas rgol mgo bo ma btud thabs med bzo ba'i don la yang go dgos/ deng rabs kyi dmag 'khrug nang / rgyal khab khag gi dpal 'byor gyi rten gzhir gyur pa'i thon khungs dang / dmag 'thab la nges par mkho ba'i dmag don bzo las dang de bzhin 'grim 'grul gyi 'gag rtsa sogs tshang ma pha rol gyi gces sa yin pa'o/ /dper na spyi lo 1990lo'i zla ba 8tshes 2nyin dbyi rag gis kha we the btsan bzung byas par brten/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs nas bkag sdom gros chod la gros 'cham byas te/ dbyis rag gi rdo snum phyir gtong byed sa'i lcags mdong bcad pa dang / skam sa dang mtsho thog gi skyel 'dren byed sa'i lam bkags te/ dbyi rag gi rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi 'gag gnad la gtor bzhig btang mthar dbyi rag bka' gsungs ci sgrub ma zhus thabs med bzo rtsis byas pa 'di yang thog mar dgra yi gces sa bcom zhes pa'i bya thabs shig yin la/ dbyi rag /sdu mi

gta' bkag nyar byas te a ri'i dpung 'jug gi dus tshod nar 'gyangs gtong ba'am bkag 'gog bya rtsis byas pa de'ang thog mar dgra yi gces sa bcom pa'i bya thabs yin pa'o/ /spyi na rgyal khams pha rol du/ /dpung tshogs btegs pa'i srol ka yang / /zab tu 'jug na bsam sems sgril/ /'thab yas ya lan 'jal bar dka'/ /dge sa bzung zhing 'phrog pa na/ /dpung gi bza' bca' 'dzad mi 'gyur/ /dpung mang bde bar gso ba las /ngal dang dub pa mi 'byung bar/ /dpa' stobs gcig tu zlums par byed/ /dpung tshogs thabs kyis bkol bgyis te/ /phasakyisgo bsami dpogs bya/ //sdu sdu/ bye/ pa/ /rdosna tsa na/ /dpung mi 'chi bar mi 'jigs na/ /'thab lag ci nus sbyor bar byed/ /ci ste nyen du lhungs na yang / /skrags dang bred pa ma mchis shing / /172 gang zhig thar du med pa'i gnas/ /

gang las blo rtsa brtan pa'o/ /ji ltar zab tu 'jug pa gang / /de ltar bstun sems che ba dang / /thabs su zad na 'thab par byed/ /de phyir dpung mir ma skul yang / /zon gral rang gis sgrig pa'am/ /ma dris rang gis zhu ba dang / /'jom med mdza' zhing mthun pa'am/ /bka' med ngang gis bkur ba dang / /rmongs sems spangs shing som nyi med/ /'chi yang 'thab kyis byol mi srid/ /nga yi dpung mir rgyu dang nor/ /'phro ma med pa'i rkyen 'di bzhin/ /rgyu la 'khu bas ma yin la/ /'chi lam 'grim par phod pa yang / /gson la 'khu bas ma yin no/ /g.yul gyi bka' brda 'bebs pa'i nyin/ /dpung mang tsog pur 'dug pa'i tshe/ /mchi mas gos kyi thu ba brlan/ /rgyab kyis nyal tshe ngo gdong brlan/ /thar med lam du mngags pa na/ / 173

zhes //ngagāzhu pa rdo'o shā'i /sna ṭ+wāṃ sdo dīpa /dri/ gyi/ sa khongs su dpung 'jug byas te sa cha gang tsam zin rjes mu mthud dpung 'jug byed dka' ba dang tha na rang dmag pham kha shor nyen che ba'i skabs dang 'phrad tshe dpung mang gi sems khams kyi 'char snang dang / bkod 'doms pas rgyab phyogs la mkho ba'i 'bru gzan go tshon la sogs pa chad 'gyangs med par 'don sprod bya thabs dang / dpung mang gi ngar sems 'phel ba bya //sdo /yod/de /bzhin thabs dang jus la byang zhing mkhas pa bya rgyu sogs 'dir dge sa bzung zhing 'phrog pa na/ /dpung gi za bca' 'dzad mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni gna' rabs kyi ngag rgyun du 'bru gzan snga na 'dren zhes brjod pa ltar 'bru gzan ni dpung sde'i rgyal pham dang 'chi gson gyi 'gag gnad yin pa mtshon zhing / der brten sun tsis dge sa bzung zhing 'phrog pa na zhes sa chu lo tog 'dzom pa'i sa cha bzung rjes de ga'i yul mi'i lag nas za 'bru btsan 'phrog byas te dpung mi'i za 'bru 'dang nges yod pa bya dgos tshul bstan pa dang / de'ang le'u gong mar/ go mtshon rang gi khab nas 'don/ /za ma dgra yi lag nas len/ /zhes 'khod pa'i don dang gcig mtshungs yin pa'o/ /dpung mang gi za 'bru 'dang nges shig yod pa bya rgyu ni gal 'gangs shin tu che zhing / dper na spyi lo 1933lor dmag dpon rlung yus zhang gis krang tsā stus ru yul mi sgrig 'dzugs kyis lngar pan gyi btsan 'dzul dmag la

(gog rgol byas rung mthar pham nyes su shor ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yang 'bru rigs ma 'dang ba des yin pa red/ /'dir/ g.yul gyi bka' brda 'bebs pa'i nyin/ /dpung btsog pur 'dug pa'i tshe/ /mchi mas gos kyi thu ba brlan/ /rgyab kyis nyal tshe ngo gdong brlan/ /thar lam med sar mngags pa na/ /kron kru'u tsa'o ku'i dpa' dang mnyam/ /zhes pa ni phas rgol dang 'thab lag sprod rgyu'i skul slongs byed skabs/ sngon la dgra bo'i sdug tsub che ba'i bya spyod rab rim dang / de la brten nas rang dmag dpung 'jug ma byed thabs med thug pa'i skor rgyas par bshad nas dpung mang rnams skyo gdung chen pos mig chu dbang med du shor ba dang / khong khro chen pos dgra dang dmag 'thab bya rgyu'i chod sems rab tu ldan pa bya dgos pa'i don bstan yod/ dper na bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug skabs/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis sdug bsngal 'ther 'don gyi las 'gul zhes pa spel nas spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin sa bdag gis ngal rtsol mi dmangs la sdug tsub chen pos bshu gzhogs btang ba'i sdig nyes 'ther 'don gyis dpung mang gi dmag 'thab bya rgyu'i chod sems dang blo stobs 'phel bar byed pa lta bu dang /kron kru'u tsha'o ku'i dpa' dang mnyam zhes pa ni/ khrun chi'u rgyal rabs kyi wu'u rgyal khab kyi dpa' rtul kron kru'u dang lu'u rgyal khab kyi dpa' rtul tsha'o ku'i dpa' stobs ltar de'i don du 'chi yang 'gyod med gzi brjid du 'dzin pa'i blo stobs dang ldan pa bya dgos zhes pa'i do/ 7din

pa'o/ / dpung 'go 'dren par mkhas pa na/ /dpung tsho sbrul gyi gzugs gshis bzhin/ /mgo bo gnon na mjug ma 'degs/ /mjug ma gnon na mgo bo 'degs/ /dkyil du gnon na sne gnyis 'degs/ /dpung gi bkod pa sbrul ji bzhin/ /bgyis na 'grigs sam zhes 'dri na/ /'grigs zhes lan du btabs su chog /wu'u yu'o gnyis kyi skye bo dag /phan tshun 'khu sems ldan na yang / /gru bo gcig tu 'dug pa'i tshe/ /drag po'i rlung dang 'phrad gyur na/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon ji bzhin du/ /phan tshun nyen nas skyob par byed/ /rta 'dogs shing 'khor sba ba yis/ /dmag mang bros pa 'gog mi thub/ /dpa' sems gcig tu sgril ba ni/ /skyong ba'i thabs la brten pa yin/ /drag zhan gnyis ku'i mthu nus dag /176 'don te thon par gyur pa gang / /

sa yi bab dang bsnun pa'i phyir/ /des na dpung 'go mkhas pa yis/ /skye bo gcig bzhin kun 'du ba/ /thabs su zad pa'i rkyen gyis so/ /zhes gtso cher dmag 'khrug gi chos nyid bstan zhing / de'ang dper na rta 'dogs shing 'khor sba ba yis dmag mang bros pa 'gog mi thub ces rta phur par btags pa dang shing 'khor sa dong nang sbas te dpung mang bros dka' pa bzo ba 'di ni thabs shes brtan po zhig ma yin zhes bstan yod/ dper na dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs/ h+pha ran si'i ma chi nor 'gog srung 'thab sa dang / glen lan gyi man na lin 'gog srung 'thab sa dgra sdes bzung skabs/ mtha' ma'i blos 'gel sa ni dpa' sems gcig tu sgril ba dang / skye bo gcig bzhin kun 'du ba'i dpung dmag rang la thug pa dang / gang 'dra byas te dpa' stobs gcig tu bsgril thub pa byed dam zhe na/ de'i lan du skyong ba'i thabs la brten pa yin zhes pa 'di rang gis 'thus/ gzhan yang sun wu'u yis lu'u yu'i gnyis kyi skye bo dag /phan tshun 'khu sems ldan na yang / /gru bo gcig tu 'dug pa'i tshe/ drag po'i rlung dang 'phrad pa na/ lag pa g.yas g.yon ji bzhin du/ /phan tshun nyen nas skyob par byed/ /ces gnas tshul nges can zhig gi 'og 'gal ba ni 'brel bar bsgyur srid pa bstan pa dang / phan tshun bsgyur du yod pa'i rgyu mtshan der gzhigs te/ sun lu'u yis dmag dpung yang sbrul gzu/sta kyi

rdo/ nyid ltar 'gog srung gi thabs dang blo stobs ldan dgos tshul bstan dpung gi bkod pa 'doms pa'i las/ /rnal du phab ste nan drang bgyis/ /dpung mi'i mthong dang thos pa zung / /sgrib cing gsang bas rmongs par bya/ /dmigs don yang du bsgyur ba dang / /thabs 'phrul zhar zhir brje ba yis/ /phas kyis rtogs thabs bral bar bya/ /sgar sa yang du bsgyur ba dang / /shul lam bskor nas 'grims pa yis /dmigs don phas kyis mi dpogs bgyis/ /dpung 'gos dmangs la bkur ba'i 'gan/ /mtho po'i steng du 'dzegs pa'i rjes/ /skas ka 'then dang mtshungs par bya/ /dpung 'gos gzhan la dpung 'dren tshe/ /skabs su bstun te rgol ba dang / /gru bo sreg cing za snod gcig /lug khyu bzhin du phar tshur 'ded/ /gang 'gro'i cha phyogs mi shes bya/ /178 las ni 'gan du bkur ba las/ /

bkur ba'i don ni brjod mi bya/ /dge ba tshur bzhin bstan pa las/ /mi dge de bzhin bstan mi bya/ /khrims las 'das pa'i gnang sbyin bstsal/ /srol las 'das pa'i bka' brda 'bebs/ /dpung tshogs gcig tu 'dus byas te/ /nyen sar mngags shing gtong ba ni/ /dpung 'go'i bya ba yin pa'o/ /sa dang bab kyi 'gyur ba dang / /rgol dang srung ba'i khe gyong ngam/ /dpung mi'i sems kyi 'char sgo sogs/ /brtags par ma bgyid thabs med lags/ /zhes dpung tshogs g.yul la 'dren skabs bkod 'doms pa'i bkod jus thad kyi gzhi rtsa'i khyad chos dang re ba/ de bzhin spyir btang gi rtsa 'dzin sogs bstan yod/ lhag par du sun wu'u yis 'dir btsan skul dang dmigs bsal gyi bya thabs kha shas ston pa de'ang /(1)dpung mi'i mthong dang thos pa zung / /sgrib cing gsang bas rmongs par bya/ /zhes gsungs nas zhib phra'i 'thab jus dang bya spyod kyi dmigs yul cis nas kyang gsang ba zab mo bya dgos pa bstan yod/spyir gna' rabs su 'thab jus de rigs la dpung mi rmongs pa'i 'thab jus zhes grags kyang / don dam du deng kyi char yang dmigs ba~X gyi
