dgos pa 'i 'og dmas 'khrug gi dmigs don dngos dang ngo bo ni rgyu mtshan sang legs la la g.yar te gsang ba byed pa las dpung mang la sasal po thod kyi med/ gal te gsang ba de gzhi rim dang dpung mang /kā spraX ṭ+wāṃ /sdong mang gi bsam blo zang zing bzo ba sogs kyi skyon mang (2)dper na/ lug khyu bzhin du phar tshur 'ded/ /gang 'gro'i cha phyogs mi shes bya/ zhes thabs jus dang bya spyod gal che rigs dpung mang la yo ngas bsgrags mi byed par lug rdzis lug khyu 'ded pa ltar dpung mang rnams shar la btang na shar dang / nub tu btang na nub tu 'gro pa'i bkod jus dang len bya dgos tshul bstan yod/ /(2)dper na/ las ni 'gan du bkur ba las/ /bkur ba'i dmigs don brjod mi bya/ /dge ba tshul bzhin bstan pa las/ /mi dge debazhin bstan mi bya/ /zhes dmag 'khrug gi las 'gan gang zhig dka' rkyen ga tshod che yang dpung mi btang nas nges par du sgrub dgos shing/las 'gan de bkod sgrig byed skabs/ las 'gan de sgrub dgos pa dang / ji ltar sgrub dgos tshul shod pa las/ sgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dmigs yul shod mi rung ba dang / gzhan yang las 'gan de sgrub par gtong skabs mthun rkyen nam bzang ba'i cha rnams bshad de dpung mang la 'thab sems 'phel ba byed dgos pa las/ 'gog rkyen nam mi legs pa'i cha rnams shod mi rung / de ltar byas na dpung mang gi sdu/ba sems la dka' rkyen bzos nas las 'gan sgrub mi thub pa

bstan di//sa/ bab dang / 'gyur ba dang / rgol dang srung ba'i khe gyong ngam/ dpung mi'i sems kyi 'char sgo sogs/ brtags par ma bgyid thabs med lags/ zhes dmag 'khrug skabs sa bab dang chab srid kyi khor yug la 'gyur ldog byung ba dang bstun nas dpung mi'i sems khams la yang 'gyur ba dang tha na zang zing 'byung srid pa bstan yod/dper na spyi lo 1990lo'i zla ba 8tshes 2nyin dbyis rag gis khe we ther btsan 'dzul byas shing / don rkyen des a she ya dbus shar gyi gnas bab tsam ma zad 'dzam gling yongs la shugs rkyen bzos stabs/ rgyal khab mang pos skabs der so so'i khe gyong la bltas nas skad cha bshad kyi yod/ dpe mtshon 'dis sun tsi'i bong gsal gyi 'thab jus la go ba len rgyur phan thog yod pa'o/ /pha rol sgyu thabs mi dpogs par/ /nye zhing 'brel ba ci phyir rung / /ri nags nyen sa na 'dam sogs/ /rgyud med dpung sne 'dren mi rigs/ /k+to shan /gsajo su r+sha brten pa/ /wa ṅgi sdo /sna da dro lnga // ṭ+wāṃ// //mi shes gcig las ma mchis kyang / /btsan po'i dpung du mi grags so/ / 18

btsan po'i dpung zhes bya ba ni/ /rgyal khams chen mor dpung bshams tshe/ /pha rol sgril du mi 'jug cing / /spral tāng /gas kyis gnon pa dang / /bye ༵༵༵ bye/ trī /trī (shā bya/ /de bzhin gang dang gang la yang / /dpung shed skyong ba'i gnyen mi bgyis/ /rang 'bangs dge bar skyong ba dang / /pha rol zil gyis gnon par bya/ /phas kyi mkhar rdzong bcom pa dang / /rgyal sa rdul du brlags su chog /zhes gtso bo rgyal khab gzhan dang 'brel ba byed phyogs bstan yod cing / sbyir rgyal spyi'i phyi 'brel byed sgo'i nang / dgra gnyen dang nye ring gang yang yod pa ni chos nyid yin gshes rtsa don ni rang rgyal khab kyi khe phan dang mthun pa bya rgyu ga'i rtsar 'dzin dgos/ dmag gi 'khrug pa med pa'i dus skabs su rgyal khab gang 'dra zhig yin rung phyi 'brel gyi las la'i nang / dpal 'byor dang rig gnas/ tshan rtsal/ 'du shes 'dzin stangs sogs kyi 'gran rtsod brgyud rang rgyal khab kyi chab srid dmigs yul sgrub par byed pa dang / de'ang zhi ba dang drag po/ bslu bri/ slong btsan shed sogs bya thabs mi 'dra ba gang zhig bzung yang de'i

chab srid kyi dmigs yul ni rang rgyal khab dang mi dmangs la phan pa bya rgyu de yin/ der brten rgyal khab gzhan gyi thabs jus la dpyad zhib byed skabs/ nges par du rig pa dngas gsal gyis phyi'i rnam rdzun la mgo mi 'khrul ba bya gal che zhing / de ltar byas tshe phyi 'brel byed sgo'i nang gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig 'phrad rung bde blag ngang ya lan 'jal thub/ rgyal spyi'i 'khrug 'dzing gi lo rgyus thog nas ra 'phrod byung bar/rno ngar dang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i 'khrug 'dzing nang / rgyal khab khag tshang mas rang rgyal gyi khe phan gtso cher bzung ba 'dis/ sngar gyi mna' 'brel rgyal khab la yang yid rton du mi rung ba ni mthong chos su grub/dper na/ spyi lo 1939lor 'jar man gyis pho lan la btsan 'dzul byed skabs/ h+pha ran si ni pho lan gyi mna' 'brel rgyal khab yin rung 'gag rtsa'i skabs su rgyab skyor byas med pa dang / de las ldog ste su'u lan mna' 'brel rgyal khab ma yin rung dpung dmag btang te pho lan la rgyab skyor byas shing / don dngos thog su'u lan yang rang rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags srung skyob kyis rang gi mnga' khongs su dpung 'jug byed srid pa sngon 'gog byed pa zhig yin pa red/ de bas na sun tsis 'dir/ de phyir gang dang gang la yang / /nye 'brel rtsod cing mi 'gug la/ /de bzhin gang dang gang la yang / /dpung shed skyong ba'i gnyen mi bgyi/ /zhes sogs gsungs nas gtso bo rang stobs rang spel byed pa las nye 'brel gyi rogs skyor kho na la brten mi rung ba dang / lhag par du nor shugs dang dngos shugs mi shugs bcas kyi thog nas rgyadi 8sdub

gzhan la thal drag pa'i zur skyor bya mi rung / skyong rogs byas drags na mthar dashā spyar 'gyur pa'i nyen kha yod ces bstan/ /bye ṅge r+sha py-i zlo r+sha ༵ ṣ+ṭṛ trī ṭā byes////'thab mo'i don gyi zhib jus 'dings/ /dgra thabs brdzus kyis bstun nas kyang / /go hrag gcig tu bzlums pa dang / /sa phyogs gcig nas dpung drangs na/ /le dbar stong du chod na'ang / /dgra yi dpung 'go gsod du chog /'di la thabs kyis don sgrub ces/ /dpung tshogs 'degs pa'i nyin mo la/ /'gag sa bkags shing pho nya dag /lam yig 'khyer yang gtong mi bya/ /pha sde zon gra bral ma thag /de bstun dpung tshogs 'jug par bya/ /thog ma dgra yi gces sa bzung / /dgra dang dus ni ma btabs par/ /jus kyi gzhi dang skabs bab la/ /bstun bzhin 'thab mtha' chod par bya/ /184 thog mar mo gsar ji bzhin snyings/ /

pha rol zon gyis lhod par bya/ /de rjes bros shor ri bong bzhin/ /phas kyis 'gog thabs bral bar bya/ /zhes 'dir yang gtso bo dmag 'khrug skabs sems khams kyi 'gyur ba la gzhigs nas dmag 'khrug la zhib 'jug bya dgos tshul bstan yod pa dang / gzhan yang dmag 'khrug 'bo 'dzugs grabs kyi skabs su 'gag sa'am 'gag lam bkags nas rgyal khongs nas phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed mkhan tha dag bkags te/ rgyal khab kyi sasang ba dang / lhag par du dmag don gyi gsang ba srung skyob byed dgos pa/de bzhin mo gsar bab cing snying ba'i rang gar+shas dang / ri bong nyen las thar te bros 'gro ba'i skabs kyi sbyang spung dpe ru drangs nas sngon la gnyon chung dang nyams chung gi brdzus thabs brten nas pha rol zon med bag phebs su bsdad du bcug pa dang / de rjes phral las myur du skur rgol byas te/ 'gog thabs bral ba bzo dgos tshul bstan/ /185

me yis 'a brnam par bshadapa/me yis rgol ba rnam pa lnga/ /mi sreg 'bru sreg 'dren byed sreg /mdzod sreg ru sreg bcas pa'o/ /sreg par rtsom pa'i mthun rkyen yang / /me chas sta gon gdod nas bgyis/ /me yi rgol bar dus ldan la/ /sreg pa'i skabs su nyin tshes yod/ /dus ni skam shas che ba dang / /nyin tshes /sa pa zla ba'i bgrod/ // ṭ+wāṃ / tram̐ ༵ tā tram̐ / // zlo la/ bya// /rgyu skar de bzhi'i 'phrod sbyor nyin/ /zhe te drung bu ldang ba'i nyin mor nges/ /186 sa /

(1)me sreg ces pa ni sgar gnas sogs la me sbar te/ phas rgol gyi dpung mang sreg par bya ste/ dper na/ sbyi lo 73lor han rgyal rabs kyi blon chen to'u ku'u zhes bya bas pan khro'o dang bcas pa dpung mi gtso 'khor 36hran hran rgyal khab tu pho nyar mngags shing /hran hran rgyal pos dang thog thugs 'dogs chen pos sne len zhus yod rung / mi ring bar gzigs stangs rbad de 'gyur/ pan khra'o yis don der bsam zhib byed skabs/ skabs der zhung nu'u byang ma'i (4'idzismo)pho nya yang der slobs yod pa 'di nyid kyis dbyen sbyor byas pa yin nges par thag bcad thog da ko nged tshang ma nyams nyen gyi gnas su lhungs bzhin 'dug pa dang / gal te zhung nu'i pho nya dang bcas pa gsod bzung ma byas tshe/ tshang ma srog mgo mi thon zhes gros skul byas mthar/ zhung nu'i pho nya sdod sar lkog mtha' bskor te/ me rgyab nas pho nya dang bcas pa dpung mi 30rkyen lam du btang ba dang / mthar hran hran rgyal pos yang gus bkur ma zhus thabs med bzo pa lta bu dang /gzhan yang shin si cun dmag dpung gi yan lag dpung sde dang pos smyu lo 1938lo'i zla ba 7par shin h+pheng me 'khor 'bab tshugs la 'jab rgol byed skabs/ dgra bo'i bya ra ba dpung mi bcu grangs mtha' bskor nas rtsa brlags btang ba dang / mi grangs bzhi bcu khang pa'i nang nas phyir ma don par 'gog rgol byed pa de dag la/ mgo btags zhu dgos pa'i bslab bya byas kyang ma nyan stabs/ khang par me rgyab ste bkrongs pa lta bu dang / de bzhin spyi lo 1967lo'i zla ba 6par e ceb dang /spya si

ral bar gyi dmag 'khrug nang / dbyi si ral dmag dpung gis e ceb kyi dmag dpung su'u dbyi hri'u chu bo brgal ba sngon 'gog byed ched/ chu ngos la 'bar snum gtor te chu bo yongs la me 'bar ba byas nas pha rol gyu ༵༵༵ /sdo cho~X / blon bu pa tshasdod ma med rgyab ste pha rol gyi dpung dmag (2)'bru sreg ces pa ni/ skabs de'i ngos nas bshad na gtso bo phas rgol gyi 'bru dang gzan rtsa bud shing bcas kyi phung po me ru sreg par go ba dang / da cha dmag 'khrug gi mkho mas dper na/ mtshon cha dang rdzas mdel/ lag rtsal sgrig chas/ snum rgyu/ bza' bca'/gyu/ chas/ sman rdzas sogasa'ajog sa tshang ma me rgol gyi dmigs sa yin (2)mdzod sreg bya ba ni/ phas rgol gyi dmag spyod mkho rdzas 'jog sa'i bang mdzod me ru bsregs pa la bya ba yin/ gna' rabs su dmag spyod dngos rdzas cung stabs bde yin la/ bang mdzod kyang —stabs bde po yin pa red/ deng rabs mdzod sreg ces pa'i go don rgya che ru phyin yod cing / de'i nang dmag spyod dngos rdzas 'jog sa'i bang mdzod tsam ma zad/ da dung dmag don rten gzhi dang bzo grwa/dmag spyod dngos rdzas thon skyed byed sa'i bzo grwa sogs tshud yod/dper na spyi lo 1996lo'i zla ba 9tshes 3nyin gyi tho rengs su/ a ris dbyi rag byang rgyud du yod pa'i bde 'jags khul zhes pa'i khur te rigs kyi/ :zung ba'i byang rgyud grong khyer du dmag dpung btang ba de rgyu mtshan

du bzung nas dbyi ras gi pa 7 ta'i sa khul gyi dmas don dmigs tshad la dus tshod skar ma 45nang bskor skyod me shusas 'phur mdel 27dbyugs te mi lnga bsad yod pa dang mi bcu dgur mas skyon bzos yod pa red/ skabs de'i dmag don dpung 'jug nang a ris 'bar mdel gnam gru gnyis dang me shugs 'phur mdel 'phen byed mtsho bskor dmag gru gcig / de bzhin dmag grur srung skyob byed pa'i dmag 'thab gnam gru bcu gnyis btang / de'i nang nas 'bar mdel sanam spu gnyis ni zhi bde rgya mtsho chen po'i bon ta'o gling phran gyi a ri'i dmag dpung rten gzhi nas btang ba dang / me shugs 'phur mdel ni dmag gru'i stengs nas dbyugs pa red/mtsho leganu/bye(5——— /bye khro ta —cor tab/ r+shadī)ba ———theg na(aris dbyirag la 'jabasgolabyasapa'imatshonari'abu〉 mthe(spyilo1996lo'i zla ba 9tshes 3nyinagyi tho rengs/)skabs der mkha' thog nas gnam grus 'bar mdel dbyugs pa dang / gru thog nas 'phur mdel 'phangs pa'i 'jab rgol da~Xs

du bzung nas dbyi ras gi pa 7 ta'i sa khul gyi dmas don dmigs tshad la dus tshod skar ma 45nang bskor skyod me shusas 'phur mdel 27dbyugs te mi lnga bsad yod pa dang mi bcu dgur mas skyon bzos yod pa red/ skabs de'i dmag don dpung 'jug nang a ris 'bar mdel gnam gru gnyis dang me shugs 'phur mdel 'phen byed mtsho bskor dmag gru gcig / de bzhin dmag grur srung skyob byed pa'i dmag 'thab gnam gru bcu gnyis btang / de'i nang nas 'bar mdel sanam spu gnyis ni zhi bde rgya mtsho chen po'i bon ta'o gling phran gyi a ri'i dmag dpung rten gzhi nas btang ba dang / me shugs 'phur mdel ni dmag gru'i stengs nas dbyugs pa red/mtsho leganu/bye(5——— /bye khro ta —cor tab/ r+shadī)ba ———theg na(aris dbyirag la 'jabasgolabyasapa'imatshonari'abu〉 mthe(spyilo1996lo'i zla ba 9tshes 3nyinagyi tho rengs/)skabs der mkha' thog nas gnam grus 'bar mdel dbyugs pa dang / gru thog nas 'phur mdel 'phangs pa'i 'jab rgol da~Xs

tshad nang / dbyi rag gi lī tā sa tshugs dang / mkha' dmag bkod 'doms lte gnas/ me shugs 'phur mdel 'phen gtong rten gzhi sogs tshud yod/ a ri'i dmag phyogs nas mkha' thog dang gru thog 'jab rgol de'i spyi ming la bye thang gi rgol rdung zhes grags pa dang / de ni spyi lo 1992lo'i mtsho khug dmag 'khrug nang gi bye thang gi phub ces pa'i bya spyod bzung rjes kyi dpung 'jug byed thengs gnyis pa red/der brten a ris bye thang i rgol rdung zhes pa'i dpung 'jug nang mdzod sreg ces pa'i 'thab jus 'di bzung yod pa gsal por mtshon thub/(4)'dren byed sreg ces pa ni/ phas rgol gyi dpung spyod dngos rdzas 'dren byed kyi gru gzings dang shing 'khor sogs 'dren byed ci rigs me ru bsregs pa la bya ste/ dper na spyi lo 200lor tsha'o tsha'o yis kon tu'u g.yul 'gyed nang yon hra'o dmag dpung gi 'bru 'dren shing 'khor me sreg thengs gnyis btang ba de'ang / thengs dang po ni zla ba dgu par tsha'o tsha'o yis zhu'u hwang dang ho lhun btangs te kon tu'u la yon hra'o dmag dpung gi shing 'khor che gras stong phrag kha shas me ru bsregs pa dang / thengs gnyis pa ni zla ba bcu par tsha'o tsha'o yis rta dmag gi dpung sne drangs te kus hri dang nya'o khra'o ru yon hra'o dmag dpung gi thing 'khor che ba khri phrag me ru bsregs pa dang sbrags yon dmag gi za 'bru yang tshang ma mer sreg pa red/ deng rabs dmag 'khrug nang dmag spyod dngos rdzas shing 'khor gyis 'dren mi dgos par rla sdu 'khor dang me 'khor/ skyel 'dren spu gzings/ mkha' 'dren

/na gru soXs kyis 'aXn skyel byed kyi yod pas de dag tshang ma me rgol 4 dpa/sdu ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wā r+sha sdi kāX kā/la/ gyi dmag 'khor dang dmag gru/ dmag sgar/ mkhar rdzong bsregs te pha rol gyi dpung stobs che rigs pham par byed pa la zer zhing / dper na spyi lo 208lor li'u pe yis kro'u yus rogs su brten te tsha'o tsha'o yi dmag sabasregs pa'i byang dmar dmag 'khrug ces pa dang / spyi lo 222lor lu'u rgyal khab kyi dmag dpon lu'o shun gyis li'u pe yi sgar dang mkhar rdzong bzhi bcu lhag tsam sreg thengs gcig la bsregs pa'i dbyi ling dmag 'khrug ces pa sogs tshang ma ru sreg gi dpe mtshon yin pa'o/ /(6)gna' rabs su me rgol gyi 'bar rdzas nang mkhan pa dang 'dam rtsa'i rigs/ bud thing / sgron shing rigs/ mu zi sogs yod cing / me sbar chas su me mdel dang me dmag me phyugs/ me bya sogs yod pas de dag dus rgyun nas gra sgrig gang legs bya dgos/deng rabs kyi dmag 'khrug nang bed spyod byed pa'i me chas ni spyir btang gi me chas ma yin te/ nye ring gang sar 'phen byed kyi nying rdul tsha mo'i mtshon cha dang / mkha' thog 'bar mdel/ 'bar mdel/ me lce 'phen chas/ snum mkhreg mde'u sogs yod/ deng rabs kyi 'bar chas de dag bed spyod bya thabs dang / gnam gshis la bstun nas bed spyod bya rgyu sogs tshang ma mtshon cha dang sgrig chas kyi nus pa mi 'dra bar gzhigs nas bed spyod bya dgos pa yin/ / 191

(7)me rgol gyi dus tshig dang nyin mo ni/ spyir gnam gshis skam shas che ba dang / lhas phyogs 'os mtshams su 'khel ba bya dgos/gna' rabs pa rnams kyis dus yu na ring po'i nang gnam gzhis la zhib dpyad kyis zla ba dang rgyu skar rigs bzhi ste chu stod dang chu smad/ dbo/me bcas bzhi'i 'phrod sbyor la brten nas rlung bu ldang ba'i 'brel ba rtogs par byed pa dper na/ chu stod gal te spar kha brgyad kyi nang tshan kham la 'khor ba dang de'i mjug tu zla ba 'khor yo da tshe/ shar lhag dang byang lhag ldang nges pa dang / gal te chu smad spar kha brgyad kyi nang tshan khen la 'khor ba dang de'i mjus tu zla ba 'khor yod tshe nub lhag dang byang lhag ldang bar nges pa lta bu'o/ de ni gna' rabs kyi nyams myong la brten nas gnam gshis dpyad thabs shig yin pas yongs su 'thigs min gyi nges pa ma mchis shing / da cha gnam gshes rig pa ni gtso cher tshan rig la brten gyi yod thog 'khor skar sogs lta chas dang dpyad chas rtsis chas sna tshogs yod pas gnam gshes kyi sngon brda cung 'thigs bo yod/ gnam gshis lta dpyad ni dmag dpung gi las ka 'gangs chen zhig yin te dpung 'jug dang 'thab 'khrug mtsho skyod/ 'phur skyod bcas tshang ma chu rlabs dang gnam gshis la bstun dgos kyi yod/ dper na dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs no man tir dpung 'jug byed pa'i dmag 'khrug nang / a'i seng ho wer gyi dpung sde'i bkod 'doms khang du gnam gshis zhib 'jug tsho chung zhig yod pa de/9/2skabs der nyin bstud mar gnam gshis yag po med rung /

dpung 'jug bya rgyur mtshams pa'i gnam gshis yag po 'khyug tsam zhig bstan rgyu yin pa sngon dpags byas pa ltar/ a'e seng ho wer gyis gnam gshis legs pa'i go skabs 'khyug tsam de dam 'dzin gyis no man tir dpung 'jug byas pa ma zad/ dpung 'jug gi dmigs yul yang bde blags ngang grubs/ skabs der 'jar man dpung sde'i gnam gathis mkhas pas kyang gnam sashis yag po 'khyug tsam zhig bstan rgyu yin pa sngon dpags thub yod rung / dus tshon 'khyug tsam de'i nang mna' 'grel dmag gi dpung chen rang phyogs su 'dren mi thub par pa/sa nas grabs zon med par bsdad stabs pham kha shor ba lta bu spyi na me yi rgol thabs kyang / /me rgol rnam lnga'i 'gyur ba la/ /bstun bzhin skabs kyi sbyor ba rtsom/ /dgra yi sgar nang me sbar na/ /dpung mang phyi ru bca' zhing sgug /me chen 'bar kyang phas kyi dpung / /zhi bar 'dug na brtags pa las/ /'jug cing rgol ba bya mi rigs/ /me chen rab tu 'bar ba'i tshe/ /rgol du rung dang mi rung ltos/ /me ni phyi nas sbar chog na/ / 193

nang nas 'bar ba mi sgug par/ /skabs su dmigs te me chen spor/ /me chen stengs nas sbar ba na/ /'og nas rgol ba ma rigs so/ /nyin mo rlung bu'i rgyun ring na/ /mtshan mo rlung bu zhi ba'o/ /me lnga'i 'gyur ba rtogs pa'i mthar/ /chos nyid srung bzhin rgol bar bya/ /gang zhig me chen rgol byed kyi/ /ra zlar brtan pa blo gros mchog /gang zhig chu bo rgol byed kyi/ /ra zlar brten pa stobs su rdzogs/ /chu yis phas rgol 'gog nus kyang / /pha rol dpung shed bcom mi nus/ /zhes gtso bo gna' rabs su me la brten nas phar rgol bya thabs zhib tu bstan pa 'dir gsal 'grel zhu dgos don ma mchis shing /deng rabs kyi me rgol dang me rgol 'gog pa'i 'thab jus nang / rdul phran mtshon cha dang rdzas 'gyur mtshon cha bed spyod byed kyi yod/ dper na a ri'i dmag dpung gis tshod lta 'di 'dra zhig byed myong ba ste/chu'i steng rdo snam mthugs tshad li smi 0 3zin pa bshos thog / der me spa/ 9rdo chu'i drod tshad 100chokhul slebs shing / sngon dpags byed glu

skabs/ bar thag spyi khri 200nang tshun du yod pa'i mi yi mgrin pa maskams pa dang / spyi khri pya zhanang tshun du yod pa'i mi tshang ma'i lus po'i sha 'tshigs pa/ spyi khri 10nang tshun du yod pa'i gyon chas go thal du 'gyur ba ma zad/ me chen 'bar ba'i du sprin nang dug rlangs yod stabs bar thag spyi khri 1000nang tshun gyi mi rnams lus shugs nyams nas dmag 'thab byed mi thub pa bzo thub kyi yod pa lta bu red/ /'thab te thob dang bzung na yang / /byas pa'i rjes la mi bstod pa/ /nyams pa'i nyen dang nye ba na/ /de la 'bad pa don med ces/ /de phyir dpyod ldan rje bo yis/ /de don thugs su 'dzin pa dang / /dpung 'go mkhas pas zhib tu brtags/ /khe don med na dpung mi 'dren/ /rgyal ba med na g.yul mi bshams/ /rje bo khro bas dpung ma 'dren/ /dpung 'go sdang bas 'thab mi bya/ /khe don mchis na 'dren pa dang / /ma mchis rang sor 'jog par byed/ /khro ba spro bar 'gyur srid la/ /sdang ba dga' bar 'gyur yang srid/ / 195

'thor ba'i khab ni slar ni grub/ /'chi ba 'das log 'byung mi srid/ /de phyir rje bo blo ldan gyis/ /cis nas de la nan gyis dpyad/ /dpung sne 'dren par mkhas pas kyang / /nges par de la gzab zon gyis/ /de ni rgyal khams bde ba'am/ /dpung tshogs srung ba'i thabs kyi mchog /ces gtso bo 'thab lag sprad de rgyal kha thob pa dang / pha rol gyi grong khyer dang mkhar rdzong la sogs pa bzung na yang / byas rjes can la bya dga' gzengs bstod kyis dpung stobs dang srid dbang sra zhing brtan pa ma bzos na nyams nyen shin tu che ba dang 'bad pa don med yin zhes bstan/ mkhas dbang mang che bas 'di ni me rgol gyi mjug bsdu'i don tsam du 'dod kyang / kru'u cun gyis dmag 'thab spyi'i gzhung lugs lag len du bzung thabs kyi mjug bsdu'i skad cha zhig yin par bzhed pa de'ang / sun tsi'i dmag gi bstan bcos la rnam bshad bcu gsum yod pa las sngon gyi khag drug ni gtso cher dmag 'khrug gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs rgyas bshad byas yod pa dang / rtsod cing len pa'i rnam bshad nas me rgol gyi rnam bshad bar gtso cher 'thab lag dngos su sbyor ba'i skabs kyi bya spyod rgyas bshad byas yod/ gzhan yang me /sdu dang chu rgol gyi rnam bshad ni dmigs bsal gyi 'thab stangs shig

yin stabs mjug tu bzhag yod cing / byu la ma gtong thabs ni dmas 'khrus gi mthun rkyen du med du mi rung ba zhig yin rung / zhi ba'i 'khrug thabs shig las/ dras po'i 'khrug thabs shis ma yin pas rnam bshad 'di zur du bzhags yod/ der brten me rgol rnam bshad kyi mjug tu/ 'thab te thob dang bzung na yang / /byas pa'i rjes la mi bstod pa/ /nyams pa'i nyen dang nye ba dang / /de la 'bad pa don med ces bya ba 'di ni rnam bshad gong ma /cu gnyis kyi da'amag 'khrug bi'i pa/dī ༵ /lha / sdo ༵༵༵ sdu// //sa rin du bzung ba' mjug bsdu'

myul ma gtong thabs rnam par bshad pa/'bum sde'i dpung gi tshogs drangs te/ /le dbar stong du lhags pa na/ /'bangs dang gzhung gi zad gron dag /nyin re la yang shin tu che/ /phyi nang kun tu zing zhing 'khrug /mi rnams lam du ngal zhing dub/ /dud khyim bdun 'bum bsod nams kyi/ /las la 'jug pa'i go skabs dben/ /de ltar lo mang bsrings pa'i don/ /nyin mo gcig gi rgyal pham ched/ /khe snyan tsam la chags pa las/ /phas rgol tshul spyod mi rtogs pa/ /g.yul gyi gdong sne 'dzin po 'am/ /198 rje bo'i dpung gnyen ma yin la/ /

myul ma gtong thabs rnam par bshad pa/'bum sde'i dpung gi tshogs drangs te/ /le dbar stong du lhags pa na/ /'bangs dang gzhung gi zad gron dag /nyin re la yang shin tu che/ /phyi nang kun tu zing zhing 'khrug /mi rnams lam du ngal zhing dub/ /dud khyim bdun 'bum bsod nams kyi/ /las la 'jug pa'i go skabs dben/ /de ltar lo mang bsrings pa'i don/ /nyin mo gcig gi rgyal pham ched/ /khe snyan tsam la chags pa las/ /phas rgol tshul spyod mi rtogs pa/ /g.yul gyi gdong sne 'dzin po 'am/ /198 rje bo'i dpung gnyen ma yin la/ /

rgyal ba'i bdag nyid can yang min/ /mkhas shing mdzangs pa'i rje bo dang / /'thu thabs bzang ba'i dpung 'go yis/ /'thab pa tsam na rgyal ba dang / /rgyal 'bras gzengs su smin pa gang / /dgra tshul snga na rtogs pa'i phyir/ /snga na /gas para'adodapa'i don/che/ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ // sdo/ ṭ+wāṃ dī// dī rī lda su gad/ /rtsis su shags pas don mi bden/ /phas rgol tshul spyod dpogs pa yi/ /skye bo dag las rtogs par gyis/ /zhes dpung tshogs 'bum phrag g.yul du drangs na nyin ma re re'i gzhung sger gyi 'gro gron yang shin tu che bas de lta bu'i 'gro gron spyir btang rgyal khab kyis gtong thabs dka' ba bstan yod cing / deng rabs kyi dmag 'khrug nang de bas 'gro gron chen po gtong dgos pa dper na/ spyi lo 1990lor a ris dbyi rag gi 'thab yar langs nas po sim tsho khug la bye thang gi phub ces pa'i khri tsho'i dpung chen 'dren skabs/ nyin re'i 'gro gron a sgor bye ba gcig nas bye ba gcig dang sa ya lnga tsam gtong dgos pa dang / dngos su 'thab ra spros skabs nyin re'i 'gro gron a sgor dung phyur bcu 'gro gi yod/ 'dir snyi 9spyang

kun tu zing 'ing 'khrug / mi rnams lam du ngal zhing dub/ /dung khyim bdun 'bum bsod nams kyi/ /las la 'jug pa'i go skabs dben/ /zhes pa ni gna' rabs dmag 'khrug nang rgyab phyogs la dka' rkyen ji tsam bzo tshul gsal por bstan yod pa dper na/ dpung tshogs 'bum phrag gcig gi dmag bshams pa'i tshe/ nges par du dud khyim 'bum phrag bdun gyis rgyab phyogs su za 'bru dang rmas ma bsu 'dren byed rgyu la sogs pa 'gan du len dgos pas phyi nang gang sar zang zing che zhing gnas bzod mi bde ba dang / bsu 'dren byed mkhan rnams ngal dub che bas lam zur du sdod pa dang / rgyun ldan gyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ༵ ñcā sdu ༵ /bye / py-i /sa/ rgyal khab dang mi ser la dka' khur chen po sngagazhan yang g.yul ngor rang phyogs rgyal bar byed pa la cis nas kyang phas rgol gyi tshul spyod phra rags ji bzhin du gsal rtogs bya dgos pa dang / lhag par yang pha rol gyi skabs 'di ga'i gnas bab dang bsam jus dpyis phyin rtogs par bya rgyu gal 'gangs che/ pha rol gyi bab dang bsam jus rtogs thabs bya rgyu de yang pha rol gyi tshul spyod ci rigs cha rgyus che ba'i skye bo la brten dgos shing / cha rgyus che ba'i mi de 'dra zhig rang phyogs kyi myul mar bkol spyod byed par rgyu dngul 'bor chen gtong dgos pa'i khar/ myul zhib kyi las 'gan legs par grubs rjes/ da dung 'os mtshams kyi go gnas sprod dgos tshul yang ba/spya yod/ de'i thog nas myul ma bkol spyod byed skabs/ 'thab

sa'i thog thad gar myul zhib byed mkhan gtong dgos pa tsam ma zad/da dung spyi tshogs dang dgra bo'i sgar dang mkhar rdzong sogs kyi nang ming grags che ba dang / go bab mtho ba'i mi sna rang phyogs kyi gsang ba'i myul zhib las ka byed du 'jug dgos pa dang / mi de rigs bkol spyod byas na gzhi nas dgra phyogs kyi zhi drag dpon rigs rnams kyi gangs don shes rtog thub pa mtshon gyi yod/ dper na ljar pan gyis krung gor btsan 'dzul byed skabs/ go min tang gi nang go bab mtho ba'i 'go dpon wang cing we bslu spyod byas pa lta bu red/ gzhan yang dper na ñju byi 1985lor rgyal spyi'i thog myul ma'i gyod gzhi che rigs khag lnga byung (1)nor we'i phyi 'brel pu'u yi mtho rim phyi 'brel dpon rigs ar ne the le hor gyis de lnga'i su'u len gyi gsang myul byed sgo'i nang the bzhugs byas yod tshul khrims sbyor zhu gtugs byas mthar/ lo nyi shu btson du 'jug rgyu'i khrims thag bcad pa dang /(2)'jar man rgyal phran mnyam 'brel sbyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mtho rim myul bsher ba tan si ti te ko ngo log bros byol du song ba dang //dro hār+sha /spra ṭ+wāṃ hā /da dpon 'ga' dang tsung li'i gzhung las khang gi (2)de snga'i su'u len gyi dmag don gsang 'phrin dpon rigs sher gas po han ngo log nas bros byol du phyin rjes/ si ri yar yod pa'i su'u len gyi gsang 'phrin byed sgo khrom bsgrags byas pa/ / 201

(4)de snga'i su'u len gyi khe ke po'i dpon rigs yo'u ar chin khe su'u len la ngo log nas a rir bros pa dang / a rir su'u len gyi //rdo ṭā /mas brtol rjes slar yang a rir ngo log nas su'u len la ga (5)lo der rgya gar dang / su'u len dang / a ri/ h+pha ran si/ pho lan/ 'jar man bcas la yang gsang 'phrin btsong ba'i gnas tshul byung ba de dag gi thog nas gcig nas gsang nyung gi las ka la cha rgyus yod pa dang go bab mtho ba'i mi snas ma gtogs byed dka' ba dang / gnyis nas 'cham zhing mthun pa'i rgyal khab bar la yang myul ma /rdong res byed pa ni yongs khyab kyi mngon tshul zhig yin pa mthong myul zhib bya byed thad nas bshad na/ deng rabs kyi mthong thos gnyis kyi myul zhib yo byad ha cang sngon thon yin pa dper na spyi lo 1995lor mu ru su'i dmag dpung gis khre khreng gi drag dpung 'go gtso tu'u ta ye spru rkyen lam du gtong skabs/ tu'u ta ye rgyu'i lag tu rgyal spyi'i thog shar gtong thub pa 'i lag 'khyer kha par dmigs bsal zhig 'khyer rgyu yod pa de u ru su'i dmag phyogs nas srung skar gyi brda bsdu'i dpyad chas brgyud sa phyogs dang nye ring gang 'dra zhig la yod pa gsal rtogs thub kyi yod cing / dang thog u ru su'i dmag phyogs nas kha par yod sar me shugs 'phur mdel mdel 'phangs te tu'u ta ye dru ga~X rtsis thengs shas byas kyang / kha par khong gi lag tu khyer med

pa'i stabs dang 'khel nas me shugs 'phur mdel dbyugs tshod ma zin pas bsod ma thub pa dang / mthar spyi lo 1995lo'i zla ba mtshes mo'inyin khong gis grong khyer gyi mtha' khul zhig tu kha par de khyer nas bar 'dum pa dang zhi gros byed bzhin pa'i skabs/ u ru su'i dmag phyogs kyis srung skar brda bsdu'i lan cha ltar gnad la 'khel ba'i me shugs 'phur mdel 'phangs te bkrongs 'dug pa 'di ni sngon thon gyi mthong thos yo byad la brten mas bkrongs pa zhig red/ spyir na deng rabs kyi myul zhib yo byad ha cang tshan rig can dang rtser son yin rung / mi la rams 'degs tsam las mi yi 'thab tshab yongs su byed mi thub/ /spyi lo 1990lo'i zla ba 8tshes 2nyin nas 'thab 'go 'tshugs pa'i mtsho khug dmag 'khrug nang / a ris thabs nus ji yod kyis dbyi rag gi gsang 'phrin 'tshol bsdu byas shing / skabs der myul zhib par len rgyu skar 6dang / 'phrin skyel rgyu skar 2/ rgyang tshor 'khor skar 2/ mkha' thog brda skyel gnam gru 6bcas btang ba ma zad/ sa ngos su gsang 'phrin sa tshugs kha shas btsugs yod/ spyir a ri'i deng rabs kyi myul thib yo byad de dag gis dbyi rag phyogs kyi gsang 'phrin mtshams med du mkho 'don byed kyi yod rung / dbyi rag gi bsam jus zhib phra ji ltar yin pa rtogs dka' bas a ris mi btang nas myul zhib byas yod/gzhan yang dper na sbyi lo 1986lor a ris skam dmag dang mtsho dmag gnyis zung 'brel thog li pi yar 'jab rgol byed skabs/ 'jab rgol bya yul du gyur ba'i tsung thung las shag la cung gnad la 'phegasdu 0pa'i

ngang mkha' thog gi 'bar mdel dbyugs pa de'i thog nas kyang a ris rgyun par nas gsang 'phrin myul zhib dang 'tshol bsdu byas te dmigs tshad gtan la 'bebs pa mtshon/ de ltar a ris tsung thung las shag la 'bar mdel gnad la 'phigs pa dbyugs 'dug kyang / tsung thung khā kra blus gnas gang du bzhugs yod tshul gsal rtogs thub med pa de'i thog nas/ sun lu'u yis phags rgol tshul spyod dpogs pa yi/ /skye bo dag las rtogs par gyis/ /’ zhes gsungs pa 'dir deng rabs nas bltas kyang don snying ldan pa mthong thub/ /myul ma'i rigs la rnam pa lnga/ /yul myul nang myul ldog pa'i myul/ /'chi myul gson myul so sor nges/ /de rigs khrigs se bkol ba na/ /lkog chos sus kyang mi dpogs pas/ /'di ni mtshar ba'i chos nyid dang / /mi rje'i gnyen gyi dam pa'o/ /yul gyi myul ma zhes pa ni/ /dgra yi yul mi bkol la bya/ /nang gi myul ma zhes pa ni/ /dgra rje'i dpon mi bkol bar bya/ /ldog pa'i myul ma zhes pa ni/ /204 phas kyis mngags pa'i myul ma dag /

ldog ste rang gis bkol bar bya/ /'chi ba'i myul ma zhes pa ni/ /gsang don rdzun ma phyir sgrog cing / /rang sdigapa myul mas rtogs byas te/ //shā bye ༵ ༵ rdzu / /sna/ pa/ bya/ /khab tu los nas zhu bar bya/ / zhes spyir myul ma la rigs su dbye na yul gyi myul ma dang / nang gi myul ma/ ldog ste spyod pa'i myul ma/ 'chi ba'i myul ma/ gson pa'i myul ma bcas lnga yod cing / rigs lnga po 'di dag yongs su tshang na/ myul zhib kyi byed sgo ha cang lkog gyur yin pas rtogs thabs bral ba dang / bkol thabs dang myul thabs kyi rnam pa mang la stabs stun yin pa dang / khyab rgya che la gting zab pas pha rol gyis ji ltar bkags kyang 'gog mi thub pa dang / myul zhib kyi chos nyid de bas kyang dpogs thabs gtan nas med pas ha cang ngo mtshar che zhing /// / mthu rab ldan pa'i rgyal rje'i dpung gnyen lta bu zhig yin zhes myul ma rigs lnga'i go don gsas 'grel zhu dgos don ma mchis kyang / 'chi ba'i myul ma la 'grel tshul mi mtshungs pa gnyis yod 'dug ste/ rang phyogs kyi myul ma brgyud phas rgol gyi rna bar skyel bar 'dod pa'i rdzun bzo'i don gtam dag yang snying phas rgol gyi rna bar skyesdu snyohāb

min dang / gal te skyel thub kyang der yid rton byed min sus kyang kha tshon gcod dka' ba gang zhig gson pa'i myul ma dang mi 'dra bas de'i cha nas 'chi ba'i myul ma zhes bya ba dang / gcig shos niskabs re phas rgol rmongs byed kyi rdzun gtam phyir bsgrags te gsang don ngo ma yin khul gyis gsang brtol byed de brtsad gcod dang tha na srog chad btang ste/phas rgol gyis rdzun gtam de gsang don ngo ma yin par snyams pa'i yid ches skye bar byed pa de yin/ /dper na kun go'i dus rabs su kren wu kung (rgyal po'i ming )gis hu'u rgyal khab la dpung 'jug bya phyir/sngon la rang gi bu mo hu'u rgyal khab la bag mar bzangs ba dang / de rjes rang gi blon po rnams la nga dpung 'jug byed 'dod pas rgyal khab gang du byed na legs zhes dris par kon si chi'i zer/ hu'u rgyal khab tu byas na legs zhes lan btabs/ der wu kung gis khong khro tshad med skyes khul gyis kon si chi'i rang sar bsad de hu'u rgyal khab ni gnyen nye'i rgyal khab yin pas lan 'di 'dra 'debs mkhan shin tu mi rung ba zhig yin na srog chad gcod ces bshad/ tshul 'di hu'u rgyal khab kyi rje bos go thos byung rjes/ kren rgyal khab kyis rang nyid gnyen nyer brtsi bango mar sems te dogs zon gang yang med par bsdad/ kren rgyal khab kyis go skabs de dang bstun nas dpung tshogs drangs te hu'u rgyal khab la bde blags ngang 'jab rgol byas shing / 'di yang 'chi ba'i myul ma'i rigs su gtogs pa'i bya thabs shig yin zhes grags/ /206 de phyir dpung gi bya ba'i nang / /
